entries.en: Born in the subterranean cities of Calth, Uriel Ventris went on to earn the command of the Chapter's 4th Company and Fleet, and became one of the Ultramarines' greatest heroes.
entries.zh: 乌列尔·文特里斯出生于卡尔思的地下城市，后来获得了战团第四公司和舰队的指挥权，成为极限战士最伟大的英雄之一。

entries.en: Little is hidden from Tigurius' sight. Even to the Chapter's Captains he is a figure of mystery, possessed of a knowledge well beyond the Imperium's towering archives.
entries.zh: 提古里乌斯的视线几乎无所不及。即使对战团的连长来说，他也是一个充满神秘的人物，拥有远超帝国高耸的档案库的知识。

entries.en: Ever since the times of the Great Crusade, the Ultramarines have been amongst the most renowned of the Imperium's forces, accruing uncountable battle honours through the millennia.
entries.zh: 自大远征时代以来，极限战士一直是帝国军队中最著名的部队之一，经过千年的积累，获得了无数的战斗荣耀。

entries.en: The return of Guilliman during one of Mankind's darkest times returned a glimmer of hope to the hearts of humanity, kindling a light that would guide the Imperium into a new era.
entries.zh: 在人类最黑暗的时期，基利曼的归来给人类的心中带来了一丝希望，点燃了一盏引导帝国进入新时代的灯。

entries.en: The Ultramarines strict adherence to the Codex Astartes is what makes the Chapter amongst the most highly organized forces in the Imperium.
entries.zh: 极限战士严格遵守阿斯塔特圣典，这使得战团成为帝国中组织最严密的力量之一。

entries.en: After Guilliman's revision of the Codex Astartes, the rank of Lieutenant was reintroduced. Lieutenants now lead their battle-brothers as they did during the Horus Heresy.
entries.zh: 在基利曼修订阿斯塔特圣典后，副官的职务被重新引入。副官现在像荷鲁斯之乱期间一样领导他们的战斗修士。

entries.en: Though famed as a general, Marneus Calgar is no stranger to personal valour. The Lord Macragge leads by example, inspiring his warriors from the heart of the enemy's lines.
entries.zh: 尽管马涅乌思·卡尔加以将军的身份闻名，但他对个人勇气并不陌生。马库拉格领主以身作则，从敌人的阵线中心激励他的战士。

entries.en: Calgar is often regarded as Mankind's will to endure and triumph made flesh. Staunch and determined, he will lead the fight from the front until the stars turn cold.
entries.zh: 卡尔加常被视为人类坚韧不屈和胜利的意志的化身。他坚定决心，将从前线领导战斗，直到星星变冷。

entries.en: Since earning his monicker by disfiguring Krugg the Tyrant in a bout for leadership, Grukk's utterly brutal way of fighting has only worsened, to the terror of his enemies.
entries.zh: 自从在一场争夺领导权的战斗中毁了暴君克鲁格的面孔，赢得了他的绰号后，格鲁克的战斗方式变得更加残暴，令他的敌人恐惧。

entries.en: To prove their worth before the eyes of their brutal and cunning gods, the mighty Ghazghkull has gathered the largest Waaagh recorded in millennia.
entries.zh: 为了在他们残暴而狡猾的神面前证明自己的价值，强大的碎骨者召集了数千年来最大的Waaagh。

entries.en: Strength and brutality are paramount in Ork kultur, where any argument is bound to cause a fight. Ghazghkull is the greatest ork debater, having never lost a discussion.
entries.zh: 力量和残暴在欧克蛮人文化中至关重要，任何争论都可能引发战斗。碎骨者是最伟大的欧克蛮人辩论家，从未输过一场讨论。

entries.en: Ork Warbosess who revere Mork, the more cunning of Ork gods, occasionally think through their battle plans before plunging headlong into battle.
entries.zh: 崇拜摩克的欧克蛮人战争首领们，摩克是欧克蛮人神中更狡猾的一个，他们偶尔会在冲进战斗前思考他们的战斗计划。

entries.en: Orks never stop growing. Bigger orks tend to rule over smaller ones, having achieved victory in many battles and survived violent challenges to their position.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人永远不会停止成长。更大的欧克蛮人往往统治着更小的欧克蛮人，他们在许多战斗中取得了胜利，并在对他们地位的暴力挑战中存活下来。

entries.en: Orks believe that Ghazghkull receives messages from Gork and Mork themselves, and that with him in command of 'Da Great Waaagh' they will turn the stars green.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人相信碎骨者接收到来自格克和摩克的信息，他们相信在他的指挥下，他们将把星星变成绿色。

entries.en: After Ghazghkull's many fights with Commissar Yarrick on Armageddon, Ghazghkull left the world infested with scattered greenskins and vowing to one day return.
entries.zh: 在哈米吉多顿与政委亚瑞克的许多战斗后，碎骨者离开了这个世界，这个世界充满了散落的绿皮兽人，他们发誓有一天会回来。

entries.en: Known as simply 'Da Boss' to his Vulcha Squad, Zagstruk inspires close to fanatical awe among Stormboyz, who queue up to follow his bellowed commands.
entries.zh: 札格斯查克在他的飞鹰小队中被简单地称为"老大"，他在风暴小子中激发了近乎狂热的敬畏，他们排队跟随他的吼叫指令。

entries.en: It is the simple and resilient nature of Ork society that raises them from a civilisation of mere thuggish beasts to a world-conquering, nigh on unstoppable threat.
entries.zh: 正是欧克蛮人社会的简单和坚韧性质，将他们从一种仅仅是粗暴的野兽的文明提升到了一个能够征服世界，几乎无法阻挡的威胁。

entries.en: Mekboyz and Painboyz can get really collaborative. Mekboyz fashion combat walkers known as Deff Dreads, then the Painboyz work with them to wire ‘volunteers’ into the war engines.
entries.zh: 机械男孩和疼痛男孩可以非常合作。机械男孩制作出被称为死亡无畏机甲的战斗步行机，然后疼痛男孩与他们一起将"志愿者"接入战争引擎。

entries.en: The stars speak of what is to come. Reading them, Orikan has divined the future of the Necrons, and once they are in proper alignment, he will finally embrace his true destiny.
entries.zh: 星星讲述了即将来临的事情。通过阅读它们，奥利坎预测了太空死灵的未来，一旦它们处于正确的排列，他将最终接受他的真正命运。

entries.en: The words and actions of Chronomancers bear vast weight, as knowledge of the future flows through them. The future is fickle, but the stars will guide the Necrons to a new golden age.
entries.zh: 时间巫师的言行具有巨大的重量，因为未来的知识通过他们流动。未来是变幻莫测的，但星星将引导太空死灵进入一个新的黄金时代。

entries.en: Uncountable legions and war machines at their command, ready to devastate the enemy in the blink of an eye. Thus shall Necron Overlords reclaim the Galaxy.
entries.zh: 无数的军团和战争机器在他们的指挥下，准备在一眨眼之间摧毁敌人。这样，太空死灵霸主将重新夺回银河系。

entries.en: Entombed for millions of years, the Necrons slumbered through the aeons. Now stirring back to life across the galaxy, their unstoppable Legions are rising.
entries.zh: 埋葬了数百万年，太空死灵通过世纪的沉睡。现在在银河系各地回归生活，他们无法阻挡的军团正在崛起。

entries.en: Aeons ago, a great war against the Aeldari forced the Necrons into a period of slumber. Now it comes to an end, and so shall the ancient ruling dynasties be restored.
entries.zh: 数千年前，一场对抗艾达灵族的大战迫使太空死灵进入了一段沉睡期。现在它结束了，古老的统治王朝将被恢复。

entries.en: Imotekh's aims to restore the Necron Empire to its former glory. Only when the dynasties are united as one will Necron dominance over inferior beings begin anew.
entries.zh: 伊莫特克的目标是恢复太空死灵帝国的昔日辉煌。只有当王朝统一为一体时，太空死灵对劣等生物的统治才会重新开始。

entries.en: After taking the thron from a nobility focused on their own petty squabbles, Imotekh shaped the destiny of his awakening dynasty, ensuring their dominance over the lesser races.
entries.zh: 在从一个专注于自己小打小闹的贵族手中夺取王位后，伊莫特克塑造了他觉醒的王朝的命运，确保他们对低等种族的统治。

entries.en: The title of nemesor is a weighty one. Even after the strain of revivification, Zahndrekh still stands as one of the greatest Sautekh strategists, and a champion of its dynastic code.
entries.zh: 复仇之王的头衔是一个沉重的。即使在复活的压力之后，扎恩德雷克仍然是索泰克最伟大的战略家之一，也是其王朝法典的捍卫者。

entries.en: Through their advanced knowledge of science and technology, Necron Crypteks manipulate many of the universe's primordial forces to produce seemingly sorcerous effects.
entries.zh: 通过他们对科学和技术的深入了解，太空死灵的墓穴技师操纵了宇宙的许多原始力量，产生了看似魔法的效果。

entries.en: The arrival of the Worldclaimer heralds certain doom to any foe. It is he who proclaims the death of worlds, and he who drives his spear through citizen and warrior alike.
entries.zh: 世界宣告者的到来预示着任何敌人的必然灭亡。他宣告世界的死亡，他用长矛穿透公民和战士。

entries.en: True to his Word Bearers origins, Sylar's gift with words goes beyond mortal imagination. With his incantations, Hexscorn channels daemonic powers to those under his command.
entries.zh: 忠于他的怀言者起源，希拉的言辞之才超越了凡人的想象。他的咒语，Hexscorn将恶魔的力量传递给他的指挥官。

entries.en: The Black Legion was formed from the hosts of many warbands and warlords. All would swear allegiance to Abaddon, who leads them with absolute dominion.
entries.zh: 黑色军团由许多战队和战将的主力组成。所有人都向阿巴顿宣誓忠诚，他以绝对的御天使领导他们。

entries.en: The Eye of Terror became the sanctuary of the traitor Legions after the Horus Heresy, and a place for the Black Legion to gather its forces in preparation for a Black Crusade.
entries.zh: 恐惧之眼在荷鲁斯之乱后成为叛乱军团的避难所，也是黑色军团为黑色远征准备力量的地方。

entries.en: From shame and shadow recast, in black and gold reborn. In Abaddon, the forces of Chaos saw a new Warmaster to lead them to claim the final victory they were denied so long ago.
entries.zh: 从羞耻和阴影中重塑，在黑金中重生。在阿巴顿，混沌力量看到了一个新的战帅，带领他们赢得他们很久以前被剥夺的最后胜利。

entries.en: The latest of Abaddon's Black Crusades ended with the destruction of Cadia and the opening of the Great Rift, a massive tear in reality that broke the Imperium in two.
entries.zh: 阿巴顿的最新一次黑色远征以卡迪亚的毁灭和大裂隙的开启结束，这是一个巨大的现实撕裂，将帝国一分为二。

entries.en: After the 13th Black Crusade, Abaddon became the master of the sundered half of Humanity's realm that was, he said, far more territory than Horus ever conquered and held.
entries.zh: 在第13次黑色远征后，阿巴顿成为了人类领域被撕裂的一半的主人，他说，这比荷鲁斯曾经征服和控制的领土要多得多。

entries.en: There was a time in which the Eye of Horus represented the Emperor's eternal vigilance. Those days are long gone, and this is now a symbol of dread and despair.
entries.zh: 曾经有一段时间，荷鲁斯之眼代表了帝皇的永恒警戒。那些日子已经过去，现在这是一个恐惧和绝望的象征。

entries.en: Since the end of the Horus Heresy, Abaddon has gathered the scattered forces of Chaos under his banner. He is determined to claim vengeance against the False Emperor.
entries.zh: 自荷鲁斯之乱结束以来，阿巴顿已经将混沌的散落力量集结在他的旗帜下。他决心对假帝皇进行复仇。

entries.en: Anvirr's prescient abilities brought him to Vigilus, where he struck an unlikely alliance with Marneus Calgar to fend off a Chaos armada that threatened the future of the Aeldari.
entries.zh: 安维尔的预知能力带他来到警戒星，他与马涅乌思·卡尔加结成了不太可能的联盟，以抵挡威胁艾达灵族未来的混沌舰队。

entries.en: Protector of the Craftworld, Ghaelyn has risen her spear against shadow and flame time and again, commanding Saim-Hann's forces in defence of Aeldari sanctuaries and Maiden Worlds.
entries.zh: 方舟世界的保护者，盖琳一次又一次地举起她的长矛对抗阴影和火焰，指挥萨姆-罕的力量保卫艾达灵族的圣地和处女世界。

entries.en: Each member of a Saim-Hann Wild Host longs to be the first into the fight, the one to claim first blood's glory. Nothing will stand between them and their quarry.
entries.zh: 萨姆-罕野性骑士团的每个成员都渴望成为第一个参战的人，成为第一个获得初杀荣誉的人。没有什么能阻挡他们和他们的猎物之间。

entries.en: The stars are aligned, and the crimson moon tells the hour of blood and clashing blades has come. It is time for the Wild Host to rise and ride, time for the serpent to bite.
entries.zh: 星星已经排列，深红的月亮告诉我们血和冲突的时刻已经到来。是时候让野性骑士团崛起，让蛇咬人了。

entries.en: All Aeldari can manipulate psychic energies to a degree. Much of their wargear is crafted is empathically linked to the user, who can activate it with a mere thought.
entries.zh: 所有艾达灵族都能在一定程度上操纵精神能量。他们的大部分战争装备都是与使用者有共感链接的，使用者只需一个念头就能激活它。

entries.en: Saim-Hann symbology is reminiscent of the Cosmic Serpent, the creature believed to exist in both the material and the psychic universes at the same time in Aeldari Myth.
entries.zh: 萨姆-罕的象征符号让人想起宇宙灵蛇，这是艾达灵族神话中被认为同时存在于物质和精神宇宙的生物。

entries.en: Nearly all Saim-Hann belong to a Wild Rider clan, who ride in jetbike squads comprised of blood relatives, sporting banners with their clan runes as they cut down enemy lines.
entries.zh: 几乎所有的萨姆-罕都属于野性骑士氏族，他们骑着喷气摩托组成由血亲组成的小队，挥舞着带有他们氏族符文的旗帜，削减敌人的阵线。

entries.en: It is a painful irony that, in the Aeldari's endless quest for survival, the very civilians the warhosts fight to protect are all too often forced to take up arms themselves.
entries.zh: 艾达灵族为了生存的无尽追求中，痛苦的讽刺在于，那些战队努力保护的平民往往被迫自己拿起武器。

entries.en: With shocking agility and precision, the warhosts of Eliac Zephyrblade rain down like the spears of Khaine against the heart of those who dare harm the Craftworld.
entries.zh: 以惊人的敏捷和精准，伊莱亚克·泽菲尔刃的战队如凯恩的矛一般对敢于伤害方舟世界的人心脏猛烈砸下。

entries.en: Psychic prowess made form, the Neurothrope acts not only as a synapse node, but as a pulsing psychic nexus, channeling eldritch forces to leech the life of its foes.
entries.zh: 神经虫不仅作为突触节点，还作为脉动的心灵中心，将奇异的力量引导出来，吸取敌人的生命。

entries.en: Tervigons make sure that the onslaught never ends, awakening the dormant Termagants they carry in their abdomen, and tearing enemies apart with their claws.
entries.zh: 母虫确保攻击永不停歇，唤醒它们腹部中携带的休眠枪虫，并用它们的爪子撕裂敌人。

entries.en: The hardened chitin that frames the forms of the tyranids has proven unnaturally durable. Few can stop the swarm once it is determined to devour a planet.
entries.zh: 泰伦虫族的坚硬外壳证明了其超自然的耐久性。一旦虫群决定吞噬一个星球，几乎无人能阻止。

entries.en: Hive Fleet Leviathan has spread its tendrils through the Galaxy, ready to consume all in its path. All who encounter them fear that there is no stopping the Great Devourer.
entries.zh: 利维坦虫巢舰队已经将其触须伸向了整个银河系，准备吞噬其路径上的一切。所有遇到它们的人都害怕无法阻止这个大吞噬者。

entries.en: Settling like a vast and terrible pall across countless worlds, the Shadow in the Warp is a nightmarish phenomenon that heralds the coming of the Tyranid hive fleets.
entries.zh: 亚空间阴影如同无尽世界上的巨大恐怖遮盖，这种噩梦般的现象预示着泰伦虫族虫巢舰队的到来。

entries.en: The Hive Mind is the gestalt collective consciousness of its species, an unfathomable intelligence created by the psychic presence of billions of Tyranids all connected to each other.
entries.zh: 虫巢意志是其物种的集体意识，由数十亿泰伦虫族相互连接的心灵存在创造的无法理解的智慧。

entries.en: The Swarmlord's characteristic weapons can slice through adamantium and protective fields as if they were nothing. They lash out with such speed that few even get a chance to strike.
entries.zh: 虫群领主的特征武器可以像切蛋糕一样切开金属钛和保护场，它们以如此快的速度挥舞，很少有人有机会反击。

entries.en: A uniquely powerful galactic threat, the Swarmlord is the most powerful synapse creature ever known, undying and as old as the Tyranid species itself.
entries.zh: 作为独特的强大银河威胁，虫群领主是已知最强大的突触节点生物，不朽且与泰伦虫族本身一样古老。

entries.en: The first warning most worlds have of the Tyranids’ approach is the Shadow in the Warp. This psychic signal rolls ahead of the hive fleets like a smothering metaphysical fog bank.
entries.zh: 大多数世界对泰伦虫族的接近的第一次警告就是亚空间阴影。这种心灵信号像一团压抑的超物质雾气一样在虫巢舰队前滚动。

entries.en: A Tyranid attack is a harrowing spectacle to behold. Vast swarms of ravenous monsters flow across the land, slaughtering all in their path.
entries.zh: 泰伦虫族的攻击是一场令人惊骇的景象。大量的狂饿怪物在陆地上流动，屠杀他们路径上的所有生物。

entries.en: From the darkness between the stars they flow, a tide of living nightmares. Their shadow is the funeral shroud of civilisations. Their hunger is the death of worlds.
entries.zh: 他们从星星之间的黑暗中流淌出来，像活着的噩梦一样的潮汐。他们的阴影是文明的丧葬之衣。他们的饥饿是世界的死亡。

entries.en: The T’au Sept is the blazing beacon for the light of the Greater Good and their greatest seat of culture and wisdom, as well as a byword for military excellence.
entries.zh: 钛家门是上上善道之光的炽热信标，是他们最大的文化和智慧之座，也是军事优秀的代名词。

entries.en: The XV8 Crisis provided the prototype chassis for several more advanced battlesuits, including the XV86 Coldstar with its trans-atmospheric flight capabilities.
entries.zh: XV8危机为包括具有跨大气层飞行能力的XV86冷星在内的几种更先进的战斗服提供了原型底盘。

entries.en: Adherents of the T'au'va gladly expend incredible efforts, endure shocking hardships and lay down their lives without a second thought for the furtherance of the Greater Good.
entries.zh: 钛帝国的信徒愿意付出巨大的努力，忍受惊人的困难，甚至毫不犹豫地献出生命，以推进上上善道。

entries.en: The T'au believe the message of the Greater Good must be brought to all, so they keep growing their empire’s borders and establishing new colonised systems called septs.
entries.zh: 钛帝国认为上上善道的信息必须传达给所有人，所以他们不断扩大帝国的边界，建立新的殖民系统，称为门派。

entries.en: Developed in secret upon J'ka'vo Station and each piloted by a handpicked Shas'vre, Ghostkeel Battlesuits embarked upon numerous covert operations before their official unveiling
entries.zh: 在J'ka'vo站秘密开发，并由精选的Shas'vre驾驶，鬼船战斗服在正式公开前执行了许多秘密行动。

entries.en: The Kroot are warlike and bloodthirsty warriors. Although their primitive aggression is viewed with distaste by the T’au, such inherent savagery makes them effective shock troops.
entries.zh: 克鲁特人是好战且嗜血的战士。尽管他们的原始侵略性被塔乌人视为不齿，但这种内在的野蛮使他们成为有效的冲锋军队。

entries.en: The Ethereal Caste stand apart from their people. They rule the T’au as a wise and patient adult might guide spirited, wayward youths to realise their truest potential.
entries.zh: 以太氏族与他们的人民保持距离。他们像明智而耐心的成年人引导活力四溢、任性的青年，帮助他们实现自己的最大潜力。

entries.en: Shadowsun has rendered the advanced XV22 Stalker Battlesuit iconic, becoming so adroit at operating it that it is to her now like an armoured second skin.
entries.zh: 影阳使先进的XV22潜行者战斗服成为了标志性的装备，她操作它的技巧如此娴熟，以至于现在对她来说，它就像是一副装甲的第二层皮肤。

entries.en: The Galaxy is merciless. If one seeks to survive its dangers, one must be prepared to overcome countless challenges. Will you withstand the whims of fate?
entries.zh: 银河系是无情的。如果一个人想要在其危险中生存，就必须准备好克服无数的挑战。你能否抵挡命运的变幻莫测？

entries.en: Every advancement in warfare requires a proper field test, and those willing to aid in pushing the boundaries of what is possible will rise in the Omnissiah's grace.
entries.zh: 每一次战争的进步都需要一个适当的实地测试，那些愿意帮助推动可能性边界的人将在欧姆尼塞亚的恩典中崛起。

entries.en: History is ruled by cause and effect. The ripples sent by events from eras long gone can still be felt all through the Galaxy. Will your deeds also echo through eternity?
entries.zh: 历史由因果主宰。来自很久以前的事件所产生的涟漪，仍然可以在整个银河系中感觉到。你的行为是否也会在永恒中回响？

entries.en: Some traitors have given themselves entirely to the service of the Dark Gods, and they are so lost to damnation that they barely resemble the warriors they once were.
entries.zh: 有些叛徒已完全投身于黑暗诸神的服务，他们如此深陷诅咒，几乎无法辨认出他们曾经的战士身份。

entries.en: The Dark Apostle’s prayers fill his followers’ hearts with hatred as they lash out with fanatical strength to tear down their foes in the Dark Gods’ names.
entries.zh: 黑暗使徒的祷告充满了他的追随者们的心，他们以狂热的力量发泄出的仇恨，以黑暗诸神的名义撕裂他们的敌人。

entries.en: The Warp exists as a source of both limitless power and eternal damnation. Such power has ever tempted the unwary, the desperate and the ambitious into its bottomless depths.
entries.zh: 亚空间存在为无尽的力量和永恒的诅咒的源泉。这样的力量总是诱惑着那些不谨慎的，绝望的和有野心的人进入其无底的深渊。

entries.en: The most tainted conjurations can be achieved with daemonic energy. Sorcerers may have been psykers from birth; others may be warriors granted such power by a daemonic patron.
entries.zh: 最邪恶的召唤可以通过恶魔能量实现。巫师可能从诞生开始就是灵能者；也可能是由恶魔赞助者赋予这种力量的战士。

entries.en: The Sisters of the Order of Our Martyred Lady are the deliverers of the God-Emperor’s holy justice, the dreaded instruments of his will to whom no sacrifice is too great.
entries.zh: 殉教圣女修会的修女们是神皇圣洁正义的拯救者，是他的意志的可怕工具，对他们来说，没有什么牺牲是过大的。

entries.en: For the Adepta Sororitas the act of fighting in defence of their faith, against the foul heretics that would tear it down, is itself deemed a hallowed honour.
entries.zh: 对于修女会来说，为了保卫他们的信仰而战斗，对抗那些想要摧毁它的邪恶异端，本身就被视为一种神圣的荣誉。

entries.en: The Adepta Sororitas are a crusading military force that crushes the enemies of the Imperial Creed wherever they fester, illuminating the Emperor’s realm as a beacon of faith.
entries.zh: 修女会是一支十字军军队，粉碎帝国信仰的敌人，无论他们在哪里滋生，都会照亮帝皇的领域，成为信仰的灯塔。

entries.en: It is said that the blood of martyrs is the seed of the Imperium. Where it falls, repugnance and vengeance blossom, and the furious reprisals of the faithful thrive.
entries.zh: 据说，殉道者的血是帝国的种子。在它落下的地方，厌恶和复仇星盛开，信徒们的狂怒反击蓬勃发展。

entries.en: In the sepulchre of battle, they are the God-Emperor’s holiest warriors. In the reliquary of war, where saints are made and faith burns brightest, they are His will made manifest.
entries.zh: 在战斗的墓穴中，他们是神皇最神圣的战士。在战争的圣物库中，圣人诞生，信仰最明亮，他们是他的意志的体现。

entries.en: Shapers instinctively recognise desirable or detrimental biological traits in defeated foes, guiding their kindred's evolution and adaptation to future challenges.
entries.zh: 克鲁特人拥有一种变形生物学，使他们能够从他们吞噬的肉体中吸收遗传特征。塑形者对这种能力有一种本能的理解，以及如何最好地利用它。

entries.en: Necrons replaced their fleshly weakness with enduring forms of living metal aeons ago. However, the biotransference also devoid most Necrons of their free will.
entries.zh: 太空死灵在亿万年前就用生命金属的坚韧形态替换了他们肉体的弱点。然而，生物质转移也剥夺了大部分太空死灵的自由意志。

entries.en: The Emperor protects the faithful from the corruption that lurks in the darkness. It is under His light that the Sororitas are driven onwards with indomitable will.
entries.zh: 帝皇保护信徒免受潜伏在黑暗中的腐败。在他的光辉下，修女们以坚不可摧的意志向前推进。

entries.en: Declared by the reigning ecclesiarch of the Adeptus Ministorum, Wars of Faith are often called to seek the conquest of new territory or purge Heretics to the Imperial Creed.
entries.zh: 由国教教会现任教皇宣布，信仰之战通常是为了寻求新领土的征服或清除帝国信仰的异端。

entries.en: The tenets of the Orders joyously proclaim the blood of martyrs is the life force of the Imperium, making the sacrifice of their fallen Sisters shine brightest in the darkest hour.
entries.zh: 教团的教条欢快地宣告，殉道者的鲜血是帝国的生命力，使他们堕落的姐妹在最黑暗的时刻最为耀眼。

entries.en: After the defeat of the Old Ones, when the C’tan were at their weakest following that titanic conflict, the Necrons took their revenge, shattering and imprisoning the duplicitous star gods.
entries.zh: 在古圣被击败后，在那场巨大战斗中，C'tan最虚弱的时候，太空死灵进行了复仇，粉碎并囚禁了狡诈的星神。

entries.en: Chaplains are fiery, strict and quickly roused to anger by the hated enemy. For all their grim demeanour, Chaplains care deeply for the spiritual well-being of their brothers.
entries.zh: 牧师们性格火爆、严厉，面对仇敌时容易愤怒。尽管他们外表严肃，牧师们却非常关心战友们的精神健康。

entries.en: Battle Companies are frequently split into two demi-companies each under the direct command of a Lieutenant, an extremely able tactician and highly skilled warrior.
entries.zh: 战斗连队经常被分成两个半连队，每个半连队由一名副官直接指挥，他是一位极其出色的战术家和高超的战士。

entries.en: Bolt weapons have been synonymous with the Space Marines since before even the Great Crusade. Countless foes have been laid low by their explosive rounds, known as bolts.
entries.zh: 自大远征之前，爆矢武器就与星际战士密不可分。无数敌人被其爆炸弹药击倒，这些弹药被称为爆矢。

entries.en: To the 4th Company falls the duty of defending wider Ultramar from the predations of the countless heretics, aliens and monstrosities who would see it torn down in flames.
entries.zh: 第四连队肩负着保卫整个奥特拉玛的职责，抵御无数异端、外星人和怪物的掠夺，他们企图将其焚毁殆尽。

entries.en: Proud allies of the T'au Empire, the Kroot's rustic equipment and savage countenance perfectly depict their fearsome skill in combat.
entries.zh: 作为钛帝国的骄傲盟友，克鲁特人粗犷的装备和野蛮的外表完美地展现了他们在战斗中的可怕技能。

entries.en: "Give praise to the Star Children! Give praise to the Master Below! Give praise for deliverance, and freedom, and ascension!"
entries.zh: 赞美星辰之子！赞美下界之主！赞美解放，赞美自由，赞美升华！

entries.en: Genestealer Cults are dominated by a Patriarch via the synaptic link known as Broodmind. As the Cult grows, its Broodmind becomes a psychic beacon for the Tyranid hive.
entries.zh: 基因窃取者教团由通过称为群体心灵的突触链接统治。随着教团的壮大，其群体心灵成为泰伦虫族巢都的心灵灯塔。

entries.en: In shadow they lurk, insidious, patient. Day by day they spread their curse. They syphon strength and dig their tendrils ever deeper, until by their word blood and horror unfolds.
entries.zh: 他们在阴影中潜伏，狡猾而耐心。日复一日，他们传播诅咒。吸取力量，深入根须，直至血与惧妖在他们的命令下展开。

entries.en: Each gene-sect spontaneously spawns remarkable individuals with focused skills whose presence smoothens the road to ascension, each moulded by the world and culture it parasitises.
entries.zh: 每个基因窃取者教团自发产生具有专长的杰出个体，他们的存在使升华之路更加顺畅，每个个体都被其寄生的世界和文化所塑造。

entries.en: Since the first infection, successive generations will be born within the cult. Offspring born to the fourth generation are Purestrain Genestealers that will start the cycle anew.
entries.zh: 自首次感染以来，后续几代将在教团内出生。第四代出生的后代是纯种基因窃取者，他们将重新开始循环。

entries.en: Through cunning and fortune, Genestealer Cults send their questing tendrils writhing into even the highest ranks of the military forces that should be standing guard against it.
entries.zh: 通过狡诈和幸运，基因窃取者教团将其探索的触须伸入本应防范它们的最高军事力量中。

entries.en: As the uprising bursts out, the Patriarch leaves its throne amidst its bubbling genesis pools and emerges from the shadows. The monstrous, parasitic demigod leads the final assault.
entries.zh: 随着起义爆发，虫群族长离开了它那沸腾的起源之池中的王座，从阴影中现身。这位怪物般的寄生半神领导了最后的攻击。

entries.en: Offspring born to the fourth generation are Purestrain Genestealers. Their parents perceive their nightmare progeny as blessed cherubs, and would die for them in a heartbeat.
entries.zh: 第四代出生的后代是纯种基因窃取者。他们的父母将这些噩梦般的后代视为受祝福的智天使，并愿意为他们瞬间献身。

entries.en: The people of the craftworlds adhere to a set of strictures known as the Path, or the Ai’elethra, mastering their whims through the rigid emotional discipline of the Path.
entries.zh: 方舟世界的人民遵循一套被称为之道或Ai’elethra的严格规定，通过之道的严格情感纪律掌握他们的心愿。

entries.en: Meks are driven to constantly tinker and experiment with new ideas. They will gladly do kustom jobs for other Orks in return for payment in teef or looted scrap.
entries.zh: 技师们总是被驱使着不断修补和试验新点子。他们乐意为其他欧克蛮人做定制工作，以换取牙齿或掠夺来的废料作为报酬。

entries.en: A skilled warrior on the battlefield, Titus' duty often sets him against impossible odds, with only his fury, resolve, and honed fighting abilities seeing him through.
entries.zh: 作为战场上的熟练战士，Titus的职责常常让他面对不可能的困难，只有他的愤怒，决心和磨练的战斗能力才能让他挺过来。

entries.en: Due to their failure to protect the dynastic codes by the end of the War in Heaven, Triarch Praeotrians were charged to watch over the slumbering tomb worlds during the Great Sleep.
entries.zh: 由于在天堂之战结束时未能保护王朝法典，三圣 Praeotrians 被指派在大休眠期间监视沉睡的墓穴世界。

entries.en: Ramatekh exudes a soul-sapping presence. The promise of life’s end is so explicit in its chilling gaze that few can muster the strength of will to evade it.
entries.zh: Ramatekh散发出吸魂的气息。生命终结的承诺在其冰冷的凝视中如此明确，以至于很少有人能够鼓起意志来避开它。

entries.en: Crypteks amass whole armies of artificial constructs and soulless soldiery to achieve their goal. Blindly loyal followers, these automata are guided by their masters’ ancient genius.
entries.zh: 墓穴技师集结整个人工构造物和无魂士兵的军队来实现他们的目标。这些自动机是由他们主人的旗手天才引导的，忠诚无比。

entries.en: Regiments and their worlds of origin glorify the noble victories, last stands and epic crusades of their warriors by embroiding them in glorious, awe inspiring tapestries.
entries.zh: 各团及其起源世界通过绣制光荣、令人敬畏的挂毯，赞美他们的战士们的贵族胜利、最后的阵地和史诗般的十字军东征。

entries.en: The Imperium is faced with many horrors. The soldiers of the Astra Militarum are the Hammer of the Emperor, and by their deeds shall the enemies of Mankind be destroyed.
entries.zh: 帝国面临着许多惧妖。星界军的士兵是帝皇之锤，他们的行为将摧毁人类的敌人。

entries.en: Obliterating the enemies of the Imperium with explosive shells, armoured regiments are a punishingly effective and sometimes excessive response to invasion and insurrection.
entries.zh: 用爆炸性的炮弹消灭帝国的敌人，装甲团是对入侵和起义的有效且有时过度的回应。

entries.en: They are the grist upon which the Imperium’s war machine turns. They are the anvil upon which victories are forged. They are the shield behind which Humanity shall endure.
entries.zh: 他们是帝国战争机器的磨粉。他们是锻造胜利的铁砧。他们是人类将要忍受的盾牌。

entries.en: During The Forging, as systems were brought into the Imperial fold, the Shock Troops of Cadia imparted their discipline and military doctrine to the leaders of newly colonised worlds.
entries.zh: 在锻造时期，当各个星系被纳入帝国的版图时，卡迪亚的震撼军队将他们的纪律和军事教条传授给新殖民世界的领导者。

entries.en: With rifle, cannon and Human grit they throw back nightmarish horrors. They are the soldiers of the Astra Militarum, and in their unrecorded deaths is unsullied duty made manifest.
entries.zh: 他们用步枪、大炮和人类的勇气抵挡着噩梦般的惧妖。他们是星界军的士兵，他们无名的死亡是职责的纯洁体现。

entries.en: The Galaxy is merciless, yet the fearless few rise to claim their place in it. Given to those who commanded their decks to victory during the Early Access stage of Warpforge
entries.zh: 银河系是无情的，但无畏的少数人却在其中占据了一席之地。这是给予那些在Warpforge早期访问阶段指挥他们的卡组取得胜利的人。

entries.en: Cadians have faith in Humanity's strength, yet they rely not solely on prayers for salvation. In their darkest hour, they face evil not pleading, but firing their weapon to the bitter end.
entries.zh: 卡迪亚人对人类的力量有着坚定的信念，然而他们并不完全依赖祈祷来寻求救赎。在他们最黑暗的时刻，他们并不是乞求，而是坚持到底，用他们的武器对抗邪恶。

entries.en: Most Asuryani eventually join the war voluntarily. Known as Warrior Aspects, each branch of the Path has its own unique fighting style and reflects a unique facet of the god Khaine.
entries.zh: 大多数的阿苏瑞安尼最终会自愿加入战争。被称为战士面相的他们，每个之道的分支都有其独特的战斗风格，并反映出凯恩神的独特面貌。

entries.en: Howling Banshees announce their arrival with a blood-chilling scream amplified by their Banshee masks, inflicting severe damage to the central nervous systems of their foes.
entries.zh: 狂嚎女妖通过他们的女妖面具放大了血腥的尖叫声，宣告他们的到来，对敌人的中枢神经系统造成严重伤害。

entries.en: When Asurmen raised the original Aspect Warriors he became the first of the Asurya. First to learn under his tutelage was Jain Zar, an Aeldari swordmaiden famed for her speed and ferocity.
entries.zh: 当阿苏门创立原始的支派武士时，他成为了第一位阿苏亚。首位在他的指导下学习的是詹·扎尔，一个因其速度和凶残而闻名的艾达灵族剑女。

entries.en: The Human race bears deep scars upon their collective psyche from the Age of Strife. Mankind survived its ravages fragmented and desperate, emerging as a species much changed.
entries.zh: 人类种族在纷争纪元中对他们的集体心理留下了深海般的伤疤。人类在其破坏之后生存下来，分裂且绝望，作为一个发生了巨变的物种浮现出来。

entries.en: Wreathed in holy light and possessed of divine serenity, the Sisters of the Sacred Rose are the calm at the centre of a violent storm.
entries.zh: 笼罩在神圣之光中，拥有神圣的宁静，神圣玫瑰修女就是暴风雨中心的宁静。

entries.en: Sisters of the Sacred Rose reflect the serene demeanor of their Matriarch, Arabella, renowned for her calm nature even in the face of horror.
entries.zh: 神圣玫瑰修女会的修女们体现了她们的修女长阿拉贝拉的安详风度，即使面对惧妖，她的冷静自然也享有盛名。

entries.en: The Orders of the Adepta Sororitas are divided amongst the Convent Sanctorum, based on Ophelia VII, and the Convent Prioris, which was built within the Ecclesiarchal Palace upon Holy Terra.
entries.zh: 修女会的各个教团分布在至圣修道院，该修道院位于欧菲利亚VII，以及在神圣泰拉的国教宫内建造的Prioris修道院。

entries.en: The Adepta Sororitas execute anyone who expresses doubt in the security of the Imperium. The Sisters of the Sacred Rose have fought the enemies of the faith with resoluteness of spirit.
entries.zh: 修女会处决任何对帝国安全表示怀疑的人。神圣玫瑰修女会的修女们以坚定的精神与信仰的敌人战斗。

entries.en: A revered relic sword once held by Saint Arabella herself, Aveline Aboyé now wields the Thorn of the White Rose with resolve against the foes she was sworn to vanquish.
entries.zh: 一把由圣女阿拉贝拉亲自持有的尊敬的遗物剑，现在阿维琳·阿博耶誓言用白玫瑰的刺对她发誓要消灭的敌人坚决使用。

entries.en: The Adeptus Astartes are heavily augmented post-humans; products of years of arduous training, agonising surgery and psycho-indoctrination which not all inductees will survive.
entries.zh: 阿斯塔特修会是经过重度增强的后人类；他们是多年艰苦训练、痛苦手术和心理灌输的产物，不是所有的新兵都能活下来。

entries.en: The towering storm shields of the Bladeguard are the work of many generations of serfs, and the force field generators they contain protect the bearer’s soul as much as their flesh.
entries.zh: 剑卫的高大风暴盾是许多世代农奴的作品，他们包含的力场发生器保护着持有者的灵魂，就像保护他们的肉体一样。

entries.en: Among the bloody fates of a Chaos champion is internment in the sarcophagus of a Helbrute, a looming engine of carnage with the firepower of a tank and the bloodlust of a daemon.
entries.zh: 混沌冠军的血腥命运之一是被困在地狱兽的棺柩中，这是一个满载杀戮的巨大引擎，拥有坦克的火力和恶魔的嗜血。

entries.en: On every tier of their Chapter’s organisation the Dark Angels have a baffling array of ancient rites and traditions led by the Dark Angels Chaplains, such as the Feast of Malediction.
entries.zh: 在他们战团的每个级别上，黑暗天使都有一系列令人困惑的古老仪式和传统，由黑暗天使的牧师领导，如诅咒之宴。

entries.en: Rededicated to serving the Imperium after eluding its heavy scrutiny, the Dark Angels enacted a plan to ensure the Legion survived. No one could doubt their resolve or commitment.
entries.zh: 在成功躲过帝国的严格审查后，黑暗天使发起了一项计划，以确保军团的生存。没有人能怀疑他们的决心或承诺。

entries.en: Believing their traitorous brothers perished in Caliban’s destruction, Dark Angels Librarians later discovered the psychic signatures of the Fallen, revealing they still lived.
entries.zh: 黑暗天使智库原以为他们的叛逆兄弟在卡利班的毁灭中死去，后来发现了堕天使的精神签名，揭示他们仍然活着。

entries.en: After the destruction of Caliban, the Dark Angels thought themselves to be wholly guilty, and that should anyone learn of what had occurred, the First Legion would be declared Excommunicate Traitoris.
entries.zh: 在卡利班被毁后，黑暗天使认为自己完全有罪，如果有人了解到发生的事情，第一军团将被宣布为异端审判。

entries.en: Since the times of the Great Crusade, the sons of Caliban have been at the forefront of some of the galaxy’s most significant wars, and have bled their foes in numerous war zones.
entries.zh: 自大远征时代以来，卡利班的子民一直在银河系的一些最重要的战争中处于前沿，他们在众多战区中让敌人流血。

entries.en: The Dark Angels’ deepest history is shrouded in mystery, not merely due to being thousands of years in the past, but also by Dark Angels’ Masters and Veterans deliberately obscuring it.
entries.zh: 黑暗天使的深层历史被神秘所笼罩，不仅仅是因为它在几千年前，而且还因为黑暗天使的主人和老兵故意模糊了它。

entries.en: The proud warriors of the Dark Angels stubbornly refuse to accept defeat. Descendants of the First Legion, they stand foremost amongst the Space Marine Chapters.
entries.zh: 黑暗天使的骄傲战士们坚决拒绝接受失败。作为第一军团的后裔，他们在星际战士战团中处于最前沿。

entries.en: The Dark Angels outfit their entire 1st Company – the Deathwing – with Terminator armour, lightning-wreathed power weapons and towering relic shields.
entries.zh: 黑暗天使将他们的整个第一公司 - 死翼 - 配备了终结者装甲，闪电环绕的能量武器和高耸的遗物盾牌。

entries.en: The Dark Angels were the First Legion. No other Space Marine brotherhood has served the Emperor for as long as they have. Staunch defenders of Mankind, they are merciless in the attack and stubborn in the defence.
entries.zh: 黑暗天使是第一个军团。没有其他的星际战士兄弟会像他们一样长时间地为帝皇服务。他们是人类的坚定防御者，在攻击中无情，在防御中顽强。

entries.en: Foremost in the Jackal's efforts is the Jackal Alphus. They possess the constitution to travel for days, planning and executing the perfect shot to eliminate key targets.
entries.zh: 豺狼的努力中，豺狼猎首最为突出。他们有足够的体质能够连续行走数日，策划并执行完美的一击，消灭关键目标。

entries.en: Whether hewing riches from hellish pits or toiling in forges, the faithful have become experts in handling the outsized industrial tools they now wield as weapons.
entries.zh: 无论是在地狱深渊中开采财富，还是在锻造厂中辛勤劳作，信徒们已经成为了操纵他们现在作为武器的超大型工业工具的专家。

entries.en: The Patriarch's telepathic urging implants the true goal in its broodkin: breach enemy lines and amass vital military intelligence. Then, the cult wreaks havoc with contrived wreckage.
entries.zh: 族长的心灵催促将真正的目标植入其巢族：突破敌人的防线并收集重要的军事情报。然后，教派用精心设计的破坏引发浩劫。

entries.en: Shock assault troops without peer, Tempestus Scions are elite soldiers used to enact missions that the regular Imperial Guard cannot accomplish alone.
entries.zh: 无与伦比的冲锋军队，忠嗣暴风兵是精英士兵，用于执行常规帝国卫队无法独立完成的布道所。

entries.en: From youth, Tempestus Scions are indoctrinated on loyalty and the swift execution of their duties. They possess the tenacity to undertake the toughest missions and get the job done.
entries.zh: 从年轻时起，忠嗣暴风兵就被灌输忠诚和迅速执行职责的教义。他们具有承担最艰难布道所并完成任务的坚韧。

entries.en: Aquilons are trained to drop right into the thick of fighting. Their extensive conditioning allows them to stay focused even during the most ferocious insertions.
entries.zh: 阿奎隆被训练成直接投入战斗的中心。他们的广泛训练使他们即使在最猛烈的插入中也能保持专注。

entries.en: Some Orks are driven to leave their tribes and explore the wilds. Isolated Ork enclaves often devolve to a more primitive state and taken to squig-breeding, becoming Beast Snaggas.
entries.zh: 一些欧克蛮人被驱使离开他们的部落，探索荒野。孤立的欧克蛮人飞地经常退化到更原始的状态，并开始养跳跳，成为豢兽师。

entries.en: The untameable squig; the Badbeast of Skrapmud– Big Chompa became Mozrog’s steed with a reputation for being the meanest and most savage creature ever to crawl from the drops.
entries.zh: 难以驯服的跳跳；斯克拉普泥的恶兽——大嘴成为莫兹罗格的坐骑，以最凶残、最野蛮的生物的名声从滴落中爬出来。

entries.en: Swallowed whole, half-digested, yet still krumpin', Mozrog Skragbad doesn't just hunt beasts. With an impressive tally of trophies, he is always driven to seek bigger quarry.
entries.zh: 整个吞下，半消化，但仍在猛击，莫兹罗格·斯夸格巴德不仅狩猎野兽。他有一堆令人印象深刻的战利品，总是驱使他寻找更大的猎物。

entries.en: Beast Snaggas breed countless varieties of squigs: squigs for riding; squigs for eating; squigs from which to squeeze oil; squigs to send with hastily scrawled message glyphs...
entries.zh: 豢兽师养了无数种跳跳：骑行的跳跳；吃的跳跳；可以挤出油的跳跳；带着草率涂鸦的信息符文的跳跳...

entries.en: Dangerous and unstable, Wurrboys are treated like oracles. Rarely lucid, they rant about visions of prey and lose themselves in the senses of their warband’s squigs.
entries.zh: 危险且不稳定，战争小子被当作神谕对待。他们很少清醒，他们咆哮着对猎物的幻觉，并在他们的战队的跳跳的感觉中失去自我。

entries.en: After ten millennia, the fractured Emperor's Children still prey upon the galaxy in vibrant warbands of imperious skill, extravagant firepower, and ruinous desires.
entries.zh: 经过一万年，破碎的帝皇之子们仍以充满活力的战队在银河系中猎食，他们拥有傲慢的技巧、令人颤栗的火力和毁灭性的欲望。

entries.en: Warfare is a blood-drenched art. Each battle is a fresh canvas upon which the superiority of Fulgrim's scions is depicted in gore, viscera and the agonised screams of the enemy.
entries.zh: 战争是一种浴血的艺术。每一场战斗都是一块新的画布，福格瑞姆的子嗣们在其中以血肉、内脏和敌人的痛苦尖叫描绘出他们的优越性。

entries.en: The Emperor's Children's ingrained desire for sensation in all its forms sees them move rapidly across the battlefield to satiate their never-ending hunger for fresh experience.
entries.zh: 帝皇之子们对各种形式感觉的根深蒂固的渴望使他们在战场上迅速移动，以满足他们对新体验的无尽渴望。

entries.en: When the Emperor's Children go to war, it is to the excruciating shriek of an array of outlandish sonic weaponry that splinters reality and rasps at the nerves of all who hear it.
entries.zh: 当帝皇之子们去战斗时，他们会发出一种奇特的音波武器的剧烈尖叫，这种武器会分裂现实，让所有听到的人都感到神经紧张。

entries.en: Excess and obsession are the domains of Slaanesh. Unfulfilled desires and compulsive dreams are the cracks through which Slaanesh whispers' slip, luring mortals into their worship.
entries.zh: 过度和迷恋是色孽的领域。未满足的欲望和强迫性的梦想是色孽的耳语滑过的裂缝，引诱凡人加入他们的崇拜。

entries.en: Born of Fulgrim’s gene-seed, the III Legion sought perfection in war. Hardened by a lifetime of ceaseless conflict, their pursuit of excellence slid into excess and damnation.
entries.zh: 福格瑞姆的基因种子孕育出了第三军团，他们在战争中寻求完美。经过无尽冲突的磨砺，他们对卓越的追求滑向了过度和诅咒。

entries.en: The Emperor's Children pursue exotic essences to feed their obsessions. Found in flesh, mind, and soul, they harvest torment to distill exquisite substances.
entries.zh: 帝皇的孩子们追求异国精华以满足他们的痴迷。他们在肉体、心灵和灵魂中寻找，收割折磨以提炼出精致的物质。

entries.en: Seeking to commit ever more depraved atrocities to fulfill their monstrous desires, a warband's warriors may flay the skin from their victims with sharp blades or scintillating empyric sorcery.
entries.zh: 寻求犯下更多堕落的暴行以满足他们的怪物般的欲望，战队的战士可能会用锐利的刀刃或闪耀的帝国魔法剥去他们受害者的皮肤。

entries.en: Whether bending a daemon to their will or dominating an enemy champion, Lord Exultants revel in displaying their superiority and expose their foe's unforgivable flaws.
entries.zh: 无论是弯曲恶魔以服从他们的意志，还是统治敌人的冠军，尊贵的领主都喜欢展示他们的优越性，并暴露出敌人的不可饶恕的缺陷。

entries.en: Lhykhis embodies Khaine's willingness to risk all to defeat the foe. She is amongst the most active Phoenix Lords, travelling far and wide in defence of the Asuryani.
entries.zh: 利基斯体现了凯恩冒险一切以击败敌人的决心。她是最活跃的凤凰领主之一，为保护阿苏里亚尼而远行。

entries.en: Warp Spiders brave the Warp to defend the living, just as the tiny warp creatures to which they owe their name materialise near the Infinite Circuit to protect the dead.
entries.zh: 次元蜘蛛勇敢地穿越亚空间来保护生者，就像他们的名字来源于的微小亚空间生物在无尽电路附近物化来保护死者一样。

entries.en: The souls that pilot Asuryani wraith constructs experience reality as a dream, where their thoughts, feelings, and those of other Aeldari are as tangible as steel.
entries.zh: 驾驶阿苏里亚尼幽冥构造体的灵魂将现实视为梦境，在那里他们的思想、感情以及其他艾达灵族的感觉都像钢铁一样实在。

entries.en: The proud warriors of the Dark Angels stubbornly refuse to accept defeat. Descendants of the First Legion, they stand foremost amongst the Space Marine Chapters.
entries.zh: 黑暗天使的骄傲战士们坚决拒绝接受失败。作为第一军团的后裔，他们在星际战士战团中处于最前沿。

entries.en: Ghazghkull Mag Uruk Thraka is a mighty prophet of the Waaagh! He is the most influential greenskin in the galaxy, and commands billions to war.
entries.zh: 碎骨者·斯拉卡是Waaagh的强大先知！他是银河系中最有影响力的绿皮怪，指挥无数欧克蛮人参战。

entries.en: Boss of a band of Stormboyz, Zagstruk is known for his ambition and his temper. He has a pair of bionic legs called Da Vulcha’s Klaws, which he uses to rip his foes apart.
entries.zh: 札格斯查克是风暴小子的一群头目，以其野心和脾气而闻名。他有一对名为秃鹫之爪的仿生腿，他用它们撕裂敌人。

entries.en: Grukk Face-Rippa is huge, even by Ork warboss standards. He is known for his giant power klaw and a temper that has started countless wars.
entries.zh: 格鲁克·脸撕者巨大，即使按照欧克蛮人战争头目的标准。他以他的巨大能量爪和引发无数战争的脾气而闻名。

entries.en: Cannon fodder, living shields, mine-field sweepers, emergency rations... A cunning Grot will always have a place and opportunities in Ork society.
entries.zh: 炮灰，活动盾牌，扫雷者，紧急口粮... 在欧克蛮人社会中，狡猾的地精总会有一席之地和机会。

entries.en: Ghazghkull's official banner-waver. Makari is considered the luckiest grot alive, after surviving nine whole years next to Ghazghkull and being reincarnated multiple times.
entries.zh: 碎骨者的官方旗手。玛卡里被认为是最幸运的地精，因为他在碎骨者旁边活了整整九年，并且多次转世。

entries.en: In a rare flash of genius, the Orks discovered that the only thing needed to make Squigs more destructive was to fit as many explosives as possible on them.
entries.zh: 在一次罕见的天才闪现中，欧克蛮人发现，让跳跳更具破坏性的唯一方法就是在它们身上装上尽可能多的炸药。

entries.en: Rough and tough to their core, Ork Boyz are the mainstay of Ork Mobs. At the shout of "WAAAGH!" these mobs will charge forward against the enemy in a flurry of gore and violence.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人小子粗糙而坚韧，是欧克蛮人暴群的主力。在"WAAAGH!"的呼喊下，这些暴群会在血腥和暴力的风暴中冲向敌人。

entries.en: Tough and determined, these Orks are carried by Trukks, heavy transport vehicles capable of dropping whole mobs where they can do their best choppin'.
entries.zh: 坚韧和坚决，这些欧克蛮人乘坐蛮人卡车，这些重型运输车辆能够将整个暴群投入战斗，他们可以砍杀敌人。

entries.en: Stormboyz use rokkit packs to hurl themselves into battle. Braking systems are rare in Ork gadgets, so they will only stop when hitting an enemy, a wall or running out of fuel.
entries.zh: 风暴小子使用火箭背包投身战斗。欧克蛮人的装备中很少有刹车系统，所以他们只有在撞到敌人、墙壁或者燃料耗尽时才会停下来。

entries.en: Capable of both chopin' and shootin', these versatile boyz charge while unleashing a flurry of bullets with their Sluggas and finish the job up close and personal.
entries.zh: 这些多功能的小子在冲锋时用短铳发射一阵子弹，然后在近战中完成任务。

entries.en: The Hornhelmz were one of the battle-hardened mobs at the core of Ghazghkull’s Waaagh! during the first invasion of Armageddon.
entries.zh: 号角盔小子孩是碎骨者的Waaagh中最有经验的暴群之一，在哈米吉多顿的第一次入侵中处于核心地位。

entries.en: Even if they disregard marksmanship, there is nothing orks love more than good "dakka". This is likely due to their enjoyment of the violent noise and recoil of automated gunfire.
entries.zh: 即使他们忽视了射击技巧，欧克蛮人最喜欢的还是好的"达卡"。这可能是因为他们喜欢自动枪火的暴力噪音和后坐力。

entries.en: Due to their aggressive nature it is inevitable for Orks to receive many scars. Veteran Orks show off their scars with pride and arrogance as a symbol of status.
entries.zh: 由于他们的侵略性，欧克蛮人不可避免地会受到许多伤疤。老兵欧克蛮人以骄傲和傲慢的态度展示他们的伤疤，作为地位的象征。

entries.en: Lootaz steal and scavenge enemy weaponry to gather bits and pieces for the Meks, who use this material to build, among other things, the Deffguns that Lootas use in battle.
entries.zh: 这些欧克蛮人偷窃和搜刮敌人的武器，为技师收集零碎的材料，技师用这些材料制造了许多东西，包括战利品者在战斗中使用的死亡之枪。

entries.en: The most respected Nobs carry the warband's banner into battle. Banner Nobs are inspiring and fearsome in combat, especially when they learn the banner can be used as a weapon.
entries.zh: 最受尊敬的强蛮人在战斗中携带战队的旗帜。旗帜强蛮人在战斗中鼓舞人心，令人畏惧，尤其是当他们学会可以将旗帜用作武器时。

entries.en: Mekboys are in charge of creating the greatest "dakka" and mantaining all of the Ork's vehicles and weaponry. Without them, Orks would lack much of their fighting power.
entries.zh: 技师小子负责创造最大的"达卡"并维护所有欧克蛮人的车辆和武器。没有他们，欧克蛮人将失去他们的大部分战斗力。

entries.en: The Orks that other Orks are scared of. Burna Boyz are lunatics that will set anything or anyone on fire for the simple joy of watching them "do the burny dance".
entries.zh: 其他欧克蛮人都害怕的欧克蛮人。喷火小子是疯子，他们会为了简单的看他们在火焰中跳舞的乐趣而点燃任何东西或任何人。

entries.en: Orks prefer direct solutions, such as huge, armoured, hydraulic killing-klaws. Orks who get obsessed with this way of war are known as Big Krumpaz.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人更喜欢直接的解决方案，比如巨大的，装甲的，液压杀手爪。对这种战争方式着迷的欧克蛮人被称为大克朗帕兹。

entries.en: Orks will only seek help from Painboyz when they have no other choice. Returning to the battlefield is often more appealing than a Painboy's anesthesia, also known as a concussion.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人只有在别无选择的时候才会寻求痛苦小子的帮助。返回战场通常比痛苦小子的麻醉更具吸引力，也就是所谓的脑震荡。

entries.en: The smallest of Ork combat walkers. After a volunteer Grot is forced into a Killa Kan and feels the rush of power, they often seek Orks that tormented him in the past for a rematch.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人战斗步行机器中最小的一种。当一名自愿的地精被强行塞进杀戮机甲并感受到力量的冲击后，他们常常寻找过去折磨他的欧克蛮人进行复仇。

entries.en: After a thunderous headbutt from Ghazghkull, Ugrak saw the light (many lights, actually) and decided to pledge his red power klaw to the hardest-hitting Warlord he had ever met.
entries.zh: 在碎骨者·斯拉卡的一次雷鸣般的头槌后，乌格拉克看到了光明（实际上是很多光明）并决定将他的红色能量爪献给他所遇到的最强大的军阀。

entries.en: Thrill-seeking Orks will never be satisfied by ground-based exhilaration. These individuals, considered unstable by other Orks, take to the skies in search of greater euphoria.
entries.zh: 寻求刺激的欧克蛮人永远不会满足于地面上的兴奋。这些被其他欧克蛮人认为不稳定的个体，会冲向天空寻找更大的快感。

entries.en: Only the hardest of the hard have what it takes to join Da Goff Guard of Ghazghkull Thraka. To spot 'Ardshell Gurk in battle, just look for the second biggest bloodbath.
entries.zh: 只有最强硬的战士才有资格加入碎骨者·斯拉卡的戈夫卫队。要在战场上找到硬壳格尔克，只需寻找第二大的血战即可。

entries.en: Most Orks hate being knocked out before chopping a git during battle. Battlewagons solve that issue, carrying them into the front lines while shrugging off enemy fire.
entries.zh: 大多数欧克蛮人讨厌在战斗中砍敌人前被击倒。战斗堡垒解决了这个问题，他们在抵挡敌人火力的同时将欧克蛮人带入前线。

entries.en: Fairly compared to an armour-plated mountain covered in guns, the Stompa is a walking idol to Gork and Mork. These gargantuan war machines sometimes reach the size of a Reaver Titan.
entries.zh: 与一个覆盖着枪炮的装甲板山相比，践踏巨机是对格克和摩克的行走偶像。这些巨大的战争机器有时会达到劫掠者泰坦的大小。

entries.en: Squigs are some of the most common Ork pets. As it's customary in Ork "Kultur", they can also be weaponized and thrown against an enemy.
entries.zh: 跳跳是欧克蛮人最常见的宠物。按照欧克蛮人的习俗，他们也可以被武器化并投向敌人。

entries.en: Snotlings are unable to use Ork weaponry, which resulted in them occupying the lowest strata of Ork society. Still, do not trust any Orkoid near explosive material.
entries.zh: 鼻涕精无法使用欧克蛮人的武器，这导致他们处于欧克蛮人社会的最底层。然而，不要信任任何靠近爆炸物的绿皮肤生物。

entries.en: Orks display inhuman degrees of resilience and are able to withstand seemingly fatal wounds that would render many unable to fight with little to no long-term consequences.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人展现出超人的恢复力，能够承受看似致命的伤口，这些伤口会使许多人无法战斗，但几乎没有长期后果。

entries.en: After damaging his head with a Bolter shell, Ghazghkull believes Gork and Mork provide him with the information to conquer the Galaxy and turn the stars green.
entries.zh: 在一颗爆矢枪弹头破坏了他的头部后，碎骨者相信格克和摩克为他提供了征服银河系并将星星变绿的信息。

entries.en: Ork "Kultur" above all else is based entirely around fighting. As a Warboss earns victories, he also gains respect and increases the number of boyz he commands in battle.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人的文化完全基于战斗。随着战争头目赢得胜利，他也获得了尊重，并增加了他在战斗中指挥的小子的数量。

entries.en: Skorchas are unreliable devices capable of spraying burning Promethium over an area where any unfortunate victim will be reduced to burning remains in seconds.
entries.zh: 喷火器是不可靠的设备，能够在任何不幸的受害者所在的区域喷洒燃烧的钷，几秒钟内就会将他们化为燃烧的残骸。

entries.en: A Waaagh is born when a single Warboss manages to organize a massive number of Orks and lead them to fight and conquer. They are often so large that they can raze planetary systems.
entries.zh: 当一个战争头目设法组织大量的欧克蛮人并带领他们战斗和征服时，就会诞生一个Waaagh。他们通常如此庞大，以至于可以摧毁行星系统。

entries.en: Orks dislike the lack of fighting to the point they will start seeking a bigger, meaner enemy right after the end of a battle.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人不喜欢缺乏战斗，以至于他们会在战斗结束后立即开始寻找更大、更凶狠的敌人。

entries.en: A way to stop an Ork from fighting might be to move all enemies out of his reach, but so far it hasn't been successfully tested given the rates of in-fighting among Orks.
entries.zh: 阻止欧克蛮人战斗的一种方法可能是将所有的敌人移出他的攻击范围，但到目前为止，由于欧克蛮人之间的内斗率，这种方法还没有成功过。

entries.en: Wearing an Irongob means that the wearer is a mighty warlord indeed. Many outside Ork society don't know this, but a headbutt from the wearer will be enough to teach them.
entries.zh: 戴上铁颚意味着穿戴者确实是一位强大的军阀。许多欧克蛮人社会以外的人不知道这一点，但穿戴者的头槌足以教育他们。

entries.en: Stormboyz jump attacks are completely unpredictable. Their Rokkit Packs allow them to raze the battlefield efficiently but are also prone to misfiring and landing failures.
entries.zh: 风暴小子的跳跃攻击完全无法预测。他们的火箭背包允许他们有效地摧毁战场，但也容易发生误火和着陆失败。

entries.en: Roks are hollowed-out asteroids fitted with guns, engines, and packed full of Orks itching for a fight. They can drop troops straight into battle, blasting anything that gets in the way.
entries.zh: 岩石是被挖空的小行星，装有枪炮、引擎，并装满了渴望战斗的欧克蛮人。他们可以将军队直接投入战斗，炸掉任何挡在路上的东西。

entries.en: A Deff Dread embodies the main ideals of Ork warfare: they're big, shooty and stompy. These combat walkers bring enough firepower to tip the scales of any battle in the Orks' favour.
entries.zh: 死亡无畏机甲体现了欧克蛮人战争的主要理念：他们大，他们射击，他们踩踏。这些战斗步行者带来足够的火力，可以使任何战斗都倾向于欧克蛮人。

entries.en: Gorkanauts are built with the sole purpose of being "proper killy". Equipped with a Deffstorm Mega-Shoota and the massive Klaw of Gork, they are incredibly fearsome in battle.
entries.zh: 格克机甲的建造唯一的目的就是致命。配备了死亡风暴超级射枪和格克的巨大爪子，他们在战斗中无比可怕。

entries.en: Coming in all shapes and sizes, the clanking walkers and vehicles of the Orks are designed with one common purpose in mind: to shoot, chop and krump any git in their way.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人的步行者和车辆形态各异，但设计的共同目的是：射击，砍杀和踩踏他们路上的任何敌人。

entries.en: Ork encampments are often hard to differentiate from actual battlefields. There are countless accounts of Orks charging out of strongholds that are hidden in plain sight.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人的营地往往很难与实际的战场区分开来。有无数的记录，欧克蛮人从藏在人们眼前的要塞中冲出来。

entries.en: Grukk's might and ambition pushed him to leave his planet to fight and conquer whole systems. By the time he arrived at Sanctus Reach, his Waaagh was counted in billions.
entries.zh: 格鲁克的力量和野心推动他离开他的星球去战斗和征服整个系统。当他到达圣裁者之域时，他的Waaagh已经达到了数十亿。

entries.en: Crazed Orks belonging to Kults of Speed favour warbikes. These deafening contraptions can be seen approaching in clouds of black exhaust smoke, their riders grinning maniacally.
entries.zh: 疯狂的欧克蛮人属于极速帮派，他们喜欢蛮人摩托。这些震耳欲聋的装置可以看到在黑色排气烟雾中接近，他们的骑手疯狂地咧嘴笑。

entries.en: Not wanting to be left out of the WAAAGH!, gretchin construct these small tanks to mimic their bigger Ork brethren. However, the tiny tanks have a tendency to explode.
entries.zh: 不想被WAAAGH！排除在外，地精构造这些小坦克来模仿他们更大的欧克蛮人兄弟。然而，这些小坦克有爆炸的倾向。

entries.en: Orky-tech defies the laws of physics, but some Orks, called Spannerz, seem to have an affinity for it nonetheless. These Orks will tinker with the ‘worky bitz’ to improve it.
entries.zh: 欧克科技违反了物理定律，但是一些欧克蛮人似乎仍然对它有亲和力。这些欧克蛮人会对技术部分进行修补和改进。

entries.en: A charging mob of Orks is often preceded by a vast cloud of black smoke from all the exhausts and overheating weaponry. This can help to hide their advance.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人的冲锋暴群通常在所有排气和过热武器的大量黑烟之前。这可以帮助隐藏他们的进攻。

entries.en: Gretchin may be small and individually weak, but get enough of them in one place and they can be a force to be reckoned with, striking at an enemy from all angles.
entries.zh: 地精可能小而个体弱，但是如果在一个地方有足够多的地精，他们可以成为一个不容忽视的力量，从所有角度攻击敌人。

entries.en: Ork battlecries may seem absurd to the casual listener, but they seem to work. The amount of shouting seems to compel them all to fight even harder.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人的战斗口号对于偶然的听众来说可能看起来荒谬，但是它们似乎有效。大量的喊叫似乎使他们所有人更加努力地战斗。

entries.en: Gork is the more brutally kunnin’ (or is it kunningly brutal?) of the two Ork deities, and entreating his name grants some of his strength to nearby Orks.
entries.zh: 格克是两个欧克蛮人神祇中更残忍狡猾的一个，呼唤他的名字会赋予附近的欧克蛮人一些力量。

entries.en: The rank and file of Ork armies, tides of Boyz crash against enemy forces as a green tide of howling violence, armed with sluggas and choppas that are as crude as they are deadly.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人军队的普通士兵，如绿色潮汐般的小子们对敌军发起咆哮的暴力冲击，他们手持粗糙却致命的短铳和砍刀。

entries.en: What's faster than a Warbuggy, killier than a Warbike and flies through the air like a bird? Orks don't know, so they attach rotors and rokkits to scavenged Warbikes and pilot them into battle.
entries.zh: 比战车更快，比蛮人摩托更杀人，像鸟一样在空中飞翔的是什么？欧克蛮人不知道，所以他们在收集来的蛮人摩托上装上旋翼和火箭，驾驶它们投入战斗。

entries.en: Bigger and meaner than regular orks, Nobz act as sergeant-at-arms, champions, oppressors and role models. They tend to lead by example, plunging head-first into the thick of battle.
entries.zh: 比普通欧克蛮人更大更凶的强蛮人，他们充当军士、冠军、压迫者和榜样。他们通常以身作则，头先冲入战斗的厚重中。

entries.en: With the roar of engines and the crackle of flames, Snazzwagon drivers race each other to the front lines on these lightly-built speedsters, howling as they create a devastating inferno.
entries.zh: 随着引擎的轰鸣和火焰的噼啪声，Snazzwagon驾驶员们驾驶着这些轻型赛车互相竞速，一边咆哮一边制造出毁灭性的火海。

entries.en: Orks can become addicted to the intense kickback and explosive sounds of firearms. Those fondest of these sensations will devote their time to finding reasons to pull the trigger again.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人可能会对火器的强烈反冲力和爆炸声音上瘾。那些最喜欢这些感觉的人会把时间都用来找理由再次扣动扳机。

entries.en: Tankbustas enter the battlefield with a primal desire to hunt down armoured vehicles, scavenging the greatest trophies from their prey to brag of their felled quarries.
entries.zh: 坦克破坏者带着狩猎装甲载具的原始欲望进入战场，从他们的猎物中搜寻最大的战利品，以炫耀他们击败的猎物。

entries.en: Once, Rukkatrukk Squigbuggies were used to feed Squigs to Speed Freeks on the move. It was only after a rabid Attack Squig was accidentally launched that its true potential was realised.
entries.zh: 曾经，Rukkatrukk Squigbuggies被用来给移动中的暴走团喂食跳跳。只有在一只疯狂的攻击跳跳被意外发射后，它的真正潜力才被意识到。

entries.en: These specialists prefer to rely on "kunnin' trikz" rather than fighting the opponent head-on. Kommandos are distrusted by most other Greenskins, who find their methods distinctly "un-Orky".
entries.zh: 这些专家更喜欢依赖"狡猾的把戏"，而不是直接与对手战斗。蛮人特种兵受到大多数其他绿皮人的不信任，他们发现他们的方法明显"不像欧克蛮人"。

entries.en: Sometimes, a Battlewagon bears so much weaponry it becomes a Gunwagon. These piloted beasts ravage enemy lines until an unlucky shot to its ammunition depots makes them explode spectacularly.
entries.zh: 有时，战斗堡垒装备了如此多的武器，它变成了兽人炮车。这些驾驶的野兽摧毁敌人的阵线，直到一颗不幸的子弹击中它的弹药库，使它们壮观地爆炸。

entries.en: Flames and the resulting sizzle of scorched enemies have an undeniable appeal to the Orks. Greenskins with functioning Burnas will go great lengths to reduce anything to cinders.
entries.zh: 火焰和随之而来的烧焦敌人的嘶嘶声对欧克蛮人有着无法抗拒的吸引力。拥有功能正常的喷火枪的绿皮人会走很长的路程，只为把任何东西烧成煤渣。

entries.en: Ork medicine is not an exacting kind of science, and often seems to do more harm than good. However, treated Orks have been known to get up and fight after the most severe injuries.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人的医学并不是一种精确的科学，往往似乎比好处更多。然而，经过治疗的欧克蛮人已知在最严重的伤害后起身并战斗。

entries.en: From all the ways Orks could worship their gods Gork and Mork, it's very convenient that the main method to show devotion to Gork just happens to be more fighting.
entries.zh: 在所有欧克蛮人可以崇拜他们的神祇格克和摩克的方式中，向格克表达虔诚的主要方法恰好是更多的战斗，这非常方便。

entries.en: It's theorized that Ork tech is somehow warp-infused, as it only seems to work because the Orks believe it should. That would explain why Ork weapons are useless to anyone else.
entries.zh: 有理论认为欧克蛮人的技术以某种方式融入了亚空间，因为它似乎只是因为欧克蛮人相信它应该工作。这就解释了为什么欧克蛮人的武器对其他人无用。

entries.en: Ork mechanical repairs tend to consist of nothing but a Mekboy hitting it hard with a hammer. Somehow, this seems to work.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人的机械修理通常只包括一个技师小子用锤子猛击它。不知怎么的，这似乎有效。

entries.en: Eternal fanatics of the crushin' and krumpin', Orks often outfit vehicles with a giant spiked ball on a chain that they swing in battle against enemy tanks and structures.
entries.zh: 永恒者是粉碎和压碎的狂热者，欧克蛮人经常装备车辆，用巨大的带刺的球链在战斗中对敌人的坦克和结构挥舞。

entries.en: As far as Orks are concerned, there is no such thing as too much dakka. If there’s the slightest amount of space left on a vehicle, then it clearly needs more guns!
entries.zh: 就欧克蛮人而言，没有太多的达卡。如果车辆上还有一点空间，那么它显然需要更多的枪！

entries.en: Orks like nothing more than fighting, and the rallying cry of WAAAAGH! draws them to battle from far and wide.
entries.zh: 欧克蛮人最喜欢的就是战斗，而WAAAGH！的集结号召使他们从四面八方赶来参战。

entries.en: Every Ork knows that Ghazghkull Mag Uruk Thraka is the greatest warboss ever! Just being in his presence inspires the boyz to fight as hard as they can.
entries.zh: 每个欧克蛮人都知道，加兹古尔·萨卡是有史以来最伟大的战争头目！仅仅在他的存在下，小子们就会尽全力战斗。

entries.en: Don’t make Zagstruk mad! He’ll leap into the air on his bionic legs and make ready to plunge onto his target in a devastating attack.
entries.zh: 别惹札格斯查克生气！他会用他的仿生腿跳上空中，准备对目标进行毁灭性的攻击。

entries.en: Famed Captain of the 4th Company. He has oftentimes defied the Codex Astartes, making use of tactics that clashed with Guilliman's teachings.
entries.zh: 第四公司的著名连长。他多次违抗阿斯塔特圣典，使用与基利曼教导相冲突的战术。

entries.en: Chief Librarian of the Ultramarines chapter. He possesses the unique psychic ability to foresee events before they come to pass and uses these visions to guide his brothers to victory.
entries.zh: 极限战士战团的智库馆长。他拥有独特的心灵能力，可以预见未来的事件，并利用这些预见指导他的兄弟们取得胜利。

entries.en: Marneus Calgar is the Chapter Master of the Ultramarines. He was the first known Space Marine to go through the Rubicon Primaris to become a Primaris Space Marine.
entries.zh: 马涅乌思·卡尔加是极限战士的战团长。他是第一个通过原铸之界成为原铸星际战士的已知星际战士。

entries.en: Infiltrator squads are among the most numerous and versatile of the Space Marines, capable of both disrupting key enemy targets and defending strategical positions.
entries.zh: 渗透者小队是星际战士中最多和最多样化的，能够破坏关键的敌人目标并防守战略位置。

entries.en: The Firstborn squads of Tactical Marines are heavily trained in the use of a myriad of weapons to quickly adapt to any situation in battle.
entries.zh: 战术兵的长子小队在使用各种武器方面接受了严格的训练，以便在战斗中快速适应任何情况。

entries.en: Squads of Assault Intercessors swiftly charge into battle and slay their enemies with a combination of ranged and brutal close-quarter strikes.
entries.zh: 突击仲裁者小队迅速冲入战斗，用远程和残酷的近战攻击组合杀死他们的敌人。

entries.en: Reivers are elite assault specialists with special training and wargear for rapid insertion and lightning-fast strikes. They can sow turmoil before the enemy even knows they are there.
entries.zh: 劫掠者是精英突击专家，他们接受了特殊的训练和战争装备，用于快速插入和闪电般的攻击。他们可以在敌人甚至不知道他们在那里之前制造混乱。

entries.en: Primaris Intercessor Squads are the mainstay of the new breed of Space Marines, capable of brutal firepower without compromising on their predecessor's versatility.
entries.zh: 原铸仲裁者小队是新一代星际战士的主力，能够展现出残酷的火力，而不会妨碍他们前任的多功能性。

entries.en: After the atrocities that the tyranids commited on Macragge, the Ultramarines forged the first squads specialised in battling bio-horrors.
entries.zh: 在泰伦虫族在马库拉格犯下的暴行之后，极限战士铸造了第一支专门对抗生物恐怖的小队。

entries.en: Inceptors use their speed and bulk to spearhead Space Marine attacks. Their immense firepower is enough to leave the enemy open to an attack by follow-up waves of Space Marines.
entries.zh: 先驱者利用他们的速度和体积来领导星际战士的攻击。他们的巨大火力足以让敌人对星际战士的后续攻击波开放。

entries.en: These heavy support squads are armed with Plasma Incinerators, perfect for providing covering fire and powerful enough to annihilate enemies caught in the Hellblaster's sight.
entries.zh: 这些重型支援小队装备有等离子焚化枪，非常适合提供掩护火力，足以消灭被地狱轰击者瞄准的敌人。

entries.en: Space Marines on bikes can attack at phenomenal speeds, using surprise and momentum to overwhelm their enemies.
entries.zh: 骑自行车的星际战士可以以惊人的速度进行攻击，利用惊喜和动力压倒他们的敌人。

entries.en: As the most gifted tank commander of the Ultramarines, Antaro Chronus became the first Marine to bear the title of "Spear of Macragge" since the times of the Great Crusade.
entries.zh: 作为极限战士最有天赋的坦克指挥官，安塔罗·克罗努斯成为自大远征时代以来第一个获得“马库拉格之矛”头衔的海军。

entries.en: Leading from the front with crozius in hand, the chaplain’s role is to inspire faith and fury in those fighting alongside him, as well as to perform the sacred rituals of the chapter.
entries.zh: 牧师手持克罗修斯在前线领导，他的角色是激发与他并肩作战的人的信仰和愤怒，以及执行战团的神圣仪式。

entries.en: Serving with Chaplain Kastor, Polixis was instrumental in saving planet Atari from suffering a horrible fate after it was overrun by a chaos cult uprising.
entries.zh: 在阿塔里星球被混沌教派起义占领后，波利克西斯在牧师卡斯托的帮助下，成功地挽救了阿塔里星球免受可怕的命运。

entries.en: Sergeant Allectius fought to protect Cassothea from a massive Necron attack. When his superior fell in battle, Allectius assumed Company command for the rest of the gruelling campaign.
entries.zh: 军士阿莱克修斯为保护卡索西亚免受大规模太空死灵攻击而战。当他的上级在战斗中倒下时，阿莱克修斯接管了公司的指挥权，直到艰苦的战役结束。

entries.en: A recent improvement of anti-gravitic technology in the Imperium gave way to the Impulsor, a fast-moving assault tank capable of deploying a Primaris squad into the heart of battle.
entries.zh: 帝国在反重力技术的最近改进为冲击者突击艇的出现铺平了道路，这是一种快速移动的突击坦克，能够将原铸小队部署到战斗的中心。

entries.en: Ancients are unshakable warriors from a Chapter's Honour Guard who are sworn to carry the Chapter's Standard forward, not dishonour or lose it, and protect it with their lives.
entries.zh: 旗手是战团荣誉卫队中坚定不移的战士，他们誓言将战团的旗帜向前推进，不辱没也不丢失，用他们的生命保护它。

entries.en: The Gravis power armour of Aggressor Marines is customised with a shoulder-mounted grenade launcher to increase their ability to deliver cover fire and contest rough terrain.
entries.zh: 侵略者海军陆战队的重甲定制了肩部安装的榴弹发射器，以增强他们提供掩护火力和应对崎岖地形的能力。

entries.en: Unmatched veteran marksman and instructor. No less than four Ultramarines Captains attribute their success to the teachings of Torias Telion.
entries.zh: 无与伦比的老兵狙击手和教官。不少于四位极限战士连长将他们的成功归功于军士特利昂的教导。

entries.en: Judiciars are the embodiment of the Chapter Master's will in the battlefield, in charge of keeping Space Marines in line and quieting any sign of disobedience.
entries.zh: 裁决者是战团长在战场上的意志的化身，负责维持星际战士的纪律，平息任何不服从的迹象。

entries.en: Fast, aggressive and hard-hitting, a perfectly coordinated assault from an Inceptor Squad could break the lines of even the most resilient foes.
entries.zh: 快速，侵略性强，打击力强，先驱者小队的完美协调攻击能打破甚至最坚韧的敌人的防线。

entries.en: These expert and methodical warriors enter the battlefield in richly ornamented panoplies, bearing Storm Shields capable of withstanding the most destructive strikes.
entries.zh: 这些专家和有条不紊的战士身着华丽的盔甲进入战场，携带能抵挡最具破坏力的攻击的风暴盾。

entries.en: Veteran of the Indomitus Crusade, Lucian Calsius has proved himself time and again despite being a relative newcomer to the Chapter.
entries.zh: 作为不屈远征的老兵，副官卡尔修斯多次证明了他的价值，尽管他在战团中相对较新。

entries.en: Battle-brothers who train as Devastator Centurions must endure additional intense training just to learn to handle the immense recoil of their weaponry.
entries.zh: 接受破坏者百夫长训练的战斗修士必须经受额外的激烈训练，才能学会处理他们武器的巨大后坐力。

entries.en: Not all battles can be fought with bolter and chainsword. When it comes to matters of the warp, Ultramarine Librarians are trained in countless techniques, both offensive and defensive.
entries.zh: 并非所有的战斗都可以用爆矢枪和链锯剑来进行。在处理亚空间的事务时，极限战士智库接受了无数攻击和防御技术的训练。

entries.en: Their mighty armour allows them to advance through difficult terrain with ease. Instead of heavy guns, they wield Siege Drills capable of shattering buildings and armoured vehicles.
entries.zh: 他们强大的盔甲使他们能轻松穿越困难的地形。他们手持的不是重型枪械，而是能够粉碎建筑和装甲车辆的攻城钻。

entries.en: The largest Dreadnought model ever deployed in battle. Mortally wounded Primaris Marines are interred into these machines and given another chance to serve the Emperor.
entries.zh: 这是有史以来在战斗中部署的最大无畏机甲模型。致命伤的原铸星际战士被安置在这些机器中，再次得到为帝皇服务的机会。

entries.en: The lauded Cato Sicarius is one of the greatest heroes of the Ultramarines. He's been known to perform great feats and has snatched victory from the jaws of defeat on many occasions.
entries.zh: 备受赞誉的连长西卡瑞斯是极限战士中的最伟大英雄之一。他以完成伟大壮举而闻名，多次在败局之中夺得胜利。

entries.en: This main battle tank provides armoured support to the units on the ground. It uses anti-gravitic technology developed by Belisarius Cawl.
entries.zh: 这辆主战坦克为地面单位提供装甲支援。它使用由贝利萨留斯·考尔开发的反重力技术。

entries.en: Guided by the principles of the Codex Astartes, the Ultramarines are the most disciplined and cohesive fighting force in the Imperium.
entries.zh: 极限战士由阿斯塔特圣典的原则指导，是帝国最有纪律和凝聚力的战斗力量。

entries.en: The Codex Astartes has much to say about the perils of an exhausted fighting force. To hold back and recover today means to prevail tomorrow.
entries.zh: 阿斯塔特圣典对于疲惫的战斗力量的危险有很多说法。今天保持后退并恢复意味着明天能够取得胜利。

entries.en: Not all battles can be won on the ground alone. Sometimes it is better to step back and unleash devastation in the form of flaming holy promethium.
entries.zh: 并非所有的战斗都可以仅在地面上赢得。有时候，最好退后一步，以燃烧的神圣钷的形式释放毁灭。

entries.en: Calling in the support of these distinctive gunships can swiftly turn the tide of battle in the Ultramarines’ favour.
entries.zh: 呼叫这些独特的炮舰的支援可以迅速地将战斗的潮汐转向极限战士的有利。

entries.en: Capable of swiftly learning from the actions of their enemies, the Ultramarines can turn any attack on their own into a devastating counterassault.
entries.zh: 极限战士能够迅速从敌人的行动中学习，他们可以将任何对他们自己的攻击转变为毁灭性的反攻。

entries.en: The Ultramarines have long memories, and no slight will ever go unpunished. Should an Ultramarine fall in battle, his brothers will not rest until vengeance is done.
entries.zh: 极限战士有着长久的记忆，任何轻蔑都不会被忽视。如果一位极限战士在战斗中阵亡，他的兄弟们不会休息，直到复仇完成。

entries.en: New recruits to the Ultramarines start off as lightly armoured scouts to prove their worth. Despite their junior status, they provide a vital function to the chapter’s operations.
entries.zh: 新加入极限战士的新兵首先要作为轻装甲侦查兵来证明他们的价值。尽管他们的地位较低，但他们对战团的行动提供了重要的功能。

entries.en: Space Marine Eliminators are expert marksmen who stalk the highest value targets across the battlefield and eliminate them with well-placed sniper shots.
entries.zh: 星际战士歼灭者是专业的狙击手，他们在战场上潜行，用精准的狙击手法消灭最高价值的目标。

entries.en: These veteran Space Marines serve as the Chapter Master’s personal retinue and are charged with protecting him and carrying his standard into battle.
entries.zh: 这些老兵星际战士作为战团长的私人随从，负责保护他并在战斗中携带他的旗帜。

entries.en: This title is bestowed upon the Ultramarines’ foremost tank commander. He reports directly to the Chapter Master and is an advisor in all matters to do with heavy armour.
entries.zh: 这个头衔被授予极限战士中最杰出的坦克指挥官。他直接向战团长汇报，并在所有与重型盔甲相关的事务中担任顾问。

entries.en: Whether by their adherence to the Codex Astartes or their ability to adapt to any situation, it is undeniable the Ultramarines have achieved many victories and defied impossible odds.
entries.zh: 无论是他们对阿斯塔特圣典的遵守，还是他们适应任何情况的能力，极限战士无疑取得了许多胜利，挑战了不可能的赔率。

entries.en: Since the dawn of time when tribes of proto-humans on Terra battled against one another, mastery of the higher ground has proven to be a key element in ensuring victory.
entries.zh: 自从泰拉的原始人部落在黎明时分互相战斗以来，掌握高地已被证明是确保胜利的关键元素。

entries.en: When it comes to tactical principles, the Ultramarines need look no closer than the Codex Astartes, which contains a wealth of strategic advice for any situation.
entries.zh: 在战术原则上，极限战士只需参考阿斯塔特圣典，其中包含了任何情况下的丰富战略建议。

entries.en: Vanguards are elite reconnaissance troops, who can slip behind enemy lines and wreak havoc. They were used to great effect in the Pariah Nexus campaign.
entries.zh: 先锋是精英侦查军队，他们可以潜入敌人的后方并制造混乱。他们在驱灵死域的战役中发挥了巨大的效果。

entries.en: As Captain of the 4th Company, Uriel Ventris is also the Master of the Fleet, responsible for coordinating the Chapter's warship armada when engaging in ship-to-ship combat.
entries.zh: 作为第四连的连长，乌列尔·文特里斯也是舰队之主，负责在进行舰舰战斗时协调战团的战舰舰队。

entries.en: Those with psychic powers are feared throughout the Imperium and for good reason – channelling the warp can open gateways to that realm and bring forth nightmares.
entries.zh: 拥有精神力量的人在帝国中受到恐惧，原因很简单 - 引导亚空间可以打开通往那个领域的门户，带来噩梦。

entries.en: Divining the future is beyond the ability of most psykers. But Varro Tigurius is no ordinary psyker. His visions offer glimpses of the future that can aid his brothers in battle.
entries.zh: 预测未来超出了大多数灵能者的能力。但瓦罗·提古里乌斯不是普通的灵能者。他的预见提供了可以帮助他的兄弟们在战斗中的未来的一瞥。

entries.en: The simplest use of the warp is to channel it into destructive energy. This power can take many forms, such as lightning, flame, or sheer telekinetic force.
entries.zh: 使用亚空间最简单的方法是将其引导成破坏性的能量。这种力量可以采取许多形式，如闪电，火焰或纯粹的心灵力量。

entries.en: The warp isn’t just used to destroy. By manipulating the energies of the warp, it’s possible to grant benefits that strengthen and empower oneself and one’s allies in battle.
entries.zh: 亚空间不仅用于破坏。通过操纵亚空间的能量，可以赋予加强和赋能自己和战斗中的盟友的好处。

entries.en: Marneus Calgar is known for being one of the greatest tacticians in the Imperium, able to predict enemy movements and counter them before they even have a chance to strike.
entries.zh: 马涅乌思·卡尔加以帝国最伟大的战术家之一的身份而闻名，能够预测敌人的动向，并在他们有机会攻击之前进行反击。

entries.en: Bolters are capable of firing self-propelled rounds that explode after hitting the target. Slowly throughout the millennia, the Bolter became a holy symbol of the Emperor's wrath.
entries.zh: 爆矢枪能够发射自推进的弹药，这些弹药在击中目标后爆炸。经过千年的演变，爆矢枪成为了帝皇愤怒的神圣象征。

entries.en: The greatest of the Ultramarines are chosen to bear the sacred relics of the chapter, offering a great advantage in battle.
entries.zh: 极限战士中最伟大的人被选中承载战团的神圣遗物，这在战斗中提供了巨大的优势。

entries.en: The Ultramarines possess a wealth of heavy armoured support for both the ground and air. These work in unison with the Space Marines on the ground to drive back the enemy.
entries.zh: 极限战士拥有大量的重型装甲支援，包括地面和空中。这些与地面的星际战士一起协同作战，驱退敌人。

entries.en: Even the Codex Astartes cannot deny that getting up close and personal generally yields effective results... at great danger of course.
entries.zh: 即使是阿斯塔特圣典也不能否认，亲近和个人通常会产生有效的结果...当然，这是非常危险的。

entries.en: The strict command hierarchy of the Ultramarines allows them to deploy quickly and efficiently while letting every squad perform their duties to maximum effect.
entries.zh: 极限战士严格的指挥等级制度使他们能够快速有效地部署，同时让每个小队都能发挥最大的效果。

entries.en: The Ultramarines take their oaths of brotherhood extremely seriously. If one encounters trouble, others will quickly rally around.
entries.zh: 极限战士非常重视他们的兄弟誓言。如果有人遇到麻烦，其他人会迅速集结。

entries.en: Famed Captain of the 4th Company. He has oftentimes defied the Codex Astartes, making use of tactics that clashed with Guilliman's teachings.
entries.zh: 第四连的著名连长。他经常违背阿斯塔特圣典，使用与基利曼的教导相冲突的战术。

entries.en: Primarily proficient in the use of ranged weaponry, Sternguard Veterans have a record of making every shot count, and are entrusted with the use of rare specialist ammunition in battle.
entries.zh: 擅长远程武器的肃卫老兵，每发子弹必中，他们在战斗中有权使用稀有专业弹药。

entries.en: Since the times of the Horus Heresy, the Ultramarines have been known for their sturdy leadership, from their Chapter Masters and heroes to their Captains and squad Sergeants.
entries.zh: 自荷鲁斯之乱以来，极限战士以坚实的领导力而闻名，无论是他们的战团长和英雄，还是连长和小队军士。

entries.en: Following the Ultramarine's taste for adaptability, this highly flexible all-terrain vehicle is able to both open a breach through enemy lines and swiftly engage the enemy's scouting elements.
entries.zh: 遵循极限战士的适应性，这种高度灵活的全地形载具既能在敌人阵线中打开缺口，又能迅速对敌人的侦查元素进行攻击。

entries.en: A Desolation Marine squad can provide long-range support to their battle brothers, carrying heavy weaponry that would prove unwieldy to any that hadn't crossed the Rubicon Primaris.
entries.zh: 荒凉海军队能为战斗兄弟提供远程支援，携带重型武器，对未越过原铸之界的人来说，这些武器显得笨重。

entries.en: While the Chapter's battle brothers engage the enemy in the front lines, the Stormtalon Gunship acts as both an interceptor in the skies, and a menace to the enemy's rear lines.
entries.zh: 当战团的战斗兄弟在前线与敌人交战时，风暴爪炮艇在天空中担任拦截者，同时对敌人的后方线路构成威胁。

entries.en: The return of Guilliman in one of the Imperium's darkest hours was, for many, the turning point that pushed them to fight with more zeal than ever to see the Imperium return to its former glory.
entries.zh: 基利曼在帝国最黑暗的时刻回归，对许多人来说，这是他们决定以更大的热情去战斗，期待看到帝国恢复昔日荣光的转折点。

entries.en: The Apothecarion is tasked with the recovery of fallen battle brother gene-seed. The recovered material is taken back to the Chapter, so that it may again be used in the creation of a new battle brother.
entries.zh: 药剂厅负责回收堕落的战斗兄弟基因种子。回收的材料被带回战团，以便再次用于创造新的战斗兄弟。

entries.en: The overwhelming force of an Ultramarine attack will rapidly take control of strategic targets and minimize the chances of enemy retaliation.
entries.zh: 极限战士的压倒性攻击力将迅速控制战略目标，最大限度地减少敌人反击的机会。

entries.en: Spread thin fighting wars across the vast Galaxy, the Chapter Council of the Ultramarines plays an essential role in deploying the optimal resources for each campaign.
entries.zh: 在广袤的银河系中分散作战，极限战士的战团议会在为每场战役部署最佳资源中发挥了关键作用。

entries.en: Primaris or Firstborn, recruit or Captain, the duty of an Ultramarine to the Chapter and the Imperium only ends with his last breath.
entries.zh: 无论是原铸者还是初生者，新兵还是连长，极限战士对战团和帝国的职责只有在他最后一口气时才结束。

entries.en: Imotekh is the Phaeron of the Sautekh dynasty, and ruler of dozens of tomb worlds across the galaxy. He is a strategic genius who is constantly looking for ways to expand his empire.
entries.zh: 伊莫特克是索泰克王朝的法皇，统治着银河系中的数十个墓穴世界。他是一位战略天才，不断寻找扩大帝国的方法。

entries.en: Imotekh’s strategic prowess has been honed over millions of years. He knows exactly where to place himself in battle to do the most damage and reap the greatest rewards.
entries.zh: 伊莫特克的战略才能经过数百万年的磨砺。他知道在战斗中如何定位自己，以造成最大的伤害并获得最大的回报。

entries.en: One of the galaxy’s greatest generals. Zahndrekh is known for abiding to a strict code of conduct in battle – fighting honourably and treating prisoners with respect.
entries.zh: 扎恩德雷克是银河系最伟大的将军之一。他以在战斗中遵守严格的行为准则而闻名——光明正大地战斗，尊重俘虏。

entries.en: Zahndrekh has been waging constant war on the galaxy for millennia. He has a seemingly endless supply of warriors, such that he never lets up the pressure on his opponent.
entries.zh: 扎恩德雷克已经在银河系中进行了数千年的不断战争。他拥有看似无尽的战士，以至于他从不放松对对手的压力。

entries.en: A great Cryptek, known for his powers over time itself. He opposed the biotransference process that turned the Necrontyr into undying Necrons, but has since embraced all it has to offer.
entries.zh: 一位伟大的墓穴技师，以他对时间本身的掌控而闻名。他反对将惧亡者转变为不朽的太空死灵的生物质转移过程，但自那时起，他接受了它所提供的一切。

entries.en: Orikan’s mastery over time itself lets him peer into the past and the future alike, and even ‘walk back’ time to correct the mistakes he made earlier.
entries.zh: 奥利坎对时间的掌握使他能够窥视过去和未来，甚至“倒退”时间以纠正他之前犯的错误。

entries.en: Often sent into battle in seemingly endless swarms, these small silver beetle-like constructs can break down matter into pure energy for their Necron masters.
entries.zh: 这些小型银色甲壳虫状的构造体经常被派去战斗，它们可以将物质分解为纯能量供他们的太空死灵主人使用。

entries.en: These flying constructs use their monomolecular proboscis to inject frenzied units with energy, driving them to even greater madness and destructive potential.
entries.zh: 这些飞行构造体使用他们的单分子喙向狂热单位注入能量，使他们陷入更大的疯狂和破坏潜力。

entries.en: Some Necron warriors fall victim to a curse of madness that leaves them craving flesh and blood. Draped in the skins of their enemies, they are a terrifying sight to behold.
entries.zh: 一些太空死灵武士成为疯狂诅咒的受害者，他们渴望肉和血。他们身披敌人的皮肤，是一种恐怖的景象。

entries.en: These Necron warriors carry Gauss Flayers – weapons that shoot a bright green flash of molecular disassembling energy. An enemy is reduced to its constituent atoms in seconds.
entries.zh: 这些太空死灵武士携带高斯撕裂枪——这种武器发射出一道明亮的绿色分子解构能量闪光。敌人在几秒钟内被分解为基本原子。

entries.en: The standard infantry troop for the Necrons. The great Sautekh Overlords were only able to conquer countless planets thanks to these soulless automata following their every order.
entries.zh: 太空死灵的标准步兵军队。伟大的索泰克霸主能够征服无数星球，全靠这些无灵魂的自动机遵循他们的每一个命令。

entries.en: Immortals are powerful Necrons, still able to think and act with basic sentience. Often armed with Tesla Carbines, they fire living energy that arcs from one enemy to another.
entries.zh: 不朽者是强大的太空死灵，仍然能够具有基本的知觉和行动能力。他们通常装备特斯拉卡宾枪，发射的是活的能量，从一个敌人弧形跳到另一个敌人。

entries.en: The wraith is a stealthy construct able to phase in and out of space-time thanks to its Phase Shifter device. This allows it to scout the battlefield and report back to its masters.
entries.zh: 幽冥是一种能够通过其相位转换器设备在时空中进出的隐形构造体。这使它能够侦查战场并向其主人报告。

entries.en: Each Immortal carries a spark of the living being they once were – now all they sense is the thrill of the kill and the satisfaction of obeying their masters.
entries.zh: 每个不朽者都带有他们曾经是的生物的火花——现在他们感觉到的只是杀戮的刺激和服从主人的满足感。

entries.en: Destroyers are Necrons cursed with an uncontrollable urge to destroy all life. Ophydian destroyers are able to burrow into pocket dimensions and re-emerge to ambush their prey.
entries.zh: 毁灭者是被诅咒的太空死灵，他们有无法控制的破坏所有生命的冲动。奥菲迪安毁灭者能够钻入口袋维度并重新出现以伏击他们的猎物。

entries.en: Praetorians serve as enforcers of ancient Necrontyr law. Usually a rare sight in battle, the rediscovery of many Tomb Worlds by the Sautekh kept them in the dynasty's front lines.
entries.zh: 执政官是古代惧亡者法律的执行者。通常在战斗中很少见，但索泰克对许多墓穴世界的重新发现使他们处于王朝的前线。

entries.en: Technomancers are a specialised type of Cryptek, able to repair Necron troops and canoptek constructs in the midst of battle.
entries.zh: 机械巫师是一种专门的墓穴技师，能够在战斗中修复太空死灵军队和墓穴构造体。

entries.en: An airborne unit known for its versatility, fast speed and erratic movement. A swarm of tomb blades can quickly overwhelm even the toughest defences.
entries.zh: 一种以其多功能性、快速和不规则的移动而闻名的空中单位。一群墓穴之刃可以迅速压倒即使是最坚固的防御。

entries.en: Large anti-gravitic constructs shaped like arachnids. They cruise the battlefield conducting repairs on Necron systems, while their large bodies create and deploy canoptek scarabs.
entries.zh: 大型反重力构造体，形状像蜘蛛。他们在战场上进行太空死灵系统的修复，同时他们的大身体创造并部署墓穴圣甲虫。

entries.en: Equipped with fierce short-range weaponry, Cryptothralls keep threats out of their master's way, allowing them to carry out their masterful plans without interference.
entries.zh: 配备了猛烈的短程武器，神秘奴能够将威胁从他们的主人身边排除，让他们能够毫无干扰地执行他们的高明计划。

entries.en: Deathmarks are assassins and snipers that can phase in an out of space-time at will in order to ambush their prey. Very few enemies who have met one ever live to tell the tale.
entries.zh: 死印战士是刺客和狙击手，他们可以随意在时空中进出，以便伏击他们的猎物。遇到他们的敌人很少有人能活着讲述这个故事。

entries.en: This modified version of the Doom Scythe is often used as a troop transport. As well as attacking with its Tesla weaponry, it can drop Necron troops to the heart of battle.
entries.zh: 这种改装版的毁灭之镰常常被用作军队运输。除了用其特斯拉武器进行攻击，它还可以将太空死灵军队投送到战斗的中心。

entries.en: The Psychomancer is a specialised Cryptek able to create illusions and hard-light constructs in order to unleash an enemy’s worst fears against them.
entries.zh: 精神巫师是专门的墓穴技师，能够创造幻象和硬光构造，以便将敌人的最大恐惧释放出来。

entries.en: Shockingly fast and nimble for their size, few enemies can withstand the overwhelming flurry of attacks that these Destroyers can unleash with their Hyperphase weaponry.
entries.zh: 这些毁灭者的速度和敏捷性令人震惊，他们的体型之大，很少有敌人能抵挡住他们用超相位武器释放的攻击。

entries.en: Necron warriors inevitably rise back up to fight again, but the process can take some time. This construct speeds up the reanimation process with a beam of repairing nano-scarabs.
entries.zh: 太空死灵武士总是会重新站起来战斗，但这个过程可能需要一些时间。这个构造体通过一束修复纳米圣甲虫的光线加速了复活过程。

entries.en: Specialised Crypteks with power over time itself. They can speed it up or slow it down to suit the battle, aiding their allies or hindering their opponents as needed.
entries.zh: 专门的墓穴技师，他们对时间本身有控制权。他们可以加速或减慢时间以适应战斗，帮助他们的盟友或阻碍他们的对手。

entries.en: This distinctive attack aircraft is capable of operating both in the void and within planetary atmospheres. The sound of it approaching is known to instil terror in its enemies.
entries.zh: 这种独特的攻击飞机能够在虚空和行星大气层内操作。它的接近声音被知道能在敌人中引发恐惧。

entries.en: This destroyer has mounted itself onto a repulsor chassis, and bound its limbs into heavy gauss cannons, ideal for obliterating all living beings from afar.
entries.zh: 这个毁灭者将自己安装在反击者坦克底盘上，并将其四肢绑在重型高斯加农炮上，非常适合从远处消灭所有生物。

entries.en: Elite protectors and emissaries of the nobility. They were granted the highest quality necrodermis, making them extremely hard to damage. They plough into battle with their warscythes.
entries.zh: 贵族的精英保护者和使者。他们被授予最高质量的死灵皮，使他们极难受到伤害。他们手持战镰冲入战斗。

entries.en: This mobile weapons platform is slow-moving but brings doom to all enemies. It is loaded with powerful Tesla weaponry, and once in range, it shows the true meaning of annihilation.
entries.zh: 这个移动武器平台移动缓慢，但给所有敌人带来毁灭。它装载了强大的特斯拉武器，一旦在射程内，它就会展示毁灭的真正含义。

entries.en: The superior targeting systems of Hexmark Destroyers enables them to easily unleash volleys of death with their six Disintegrator Pistols, quickly turning any living organisms into dust.
entries.zh: 巫印毁灭者的优越瞄准系统使他们能够轻松地用他们的六把分解手枪释放死亡的齐射，迅速将任何生物转化为尘土。

entries.en: These specialized Crypteks wield plasmic lances that can make even the air scream in agony. The living lightning that they wield makes short work of any enemy that gets too close.
entries.zh: 这些专门的墓穴技师挥舞电浆长枪，可以让空气都在痛苦中尖叫。他们挥舞的活雷能够迅速解决任何靠得太近的敌人。

entries.en: Individually, Necron scarabs are weak and easily dealt with, but in large numbers, they can pose a serious threat to even the most hardened enemy.
entries.zh: 单独来看，太空死灵的圣甲虫是弱小且容易处理的，但是数量众多时，他们甚至可以对最坚硬的敌人构成严重威胁。

entries.en: Once, these skeletal vehicles dragged unwilling Necrontyr to the furnaces for bio-transference. Now, they trawl the battlefield for damaged Necrons, ready to return them to the fight.
entries.zh: 曾经，这些骨架车辆将不情愿的惧亡者拖到炉子里进行生物转移。现在，他们在战场上寻找受伤的太空死灵，准备让他们重返战斗。

entries.en: Necron Lords of the Sautekh Dynasty are counted among the most aggressive and eager in attempting a new wave of expansion to restore the Necrons to their former glory.
entries.zh: 索泰克王朝的太空死灵领主被认为是最具侵略性和渴望尝试新的扩张浪潮的人，以恢复太空死灵的昔日荣耀。

entries.en: Fearsome hexapedal walkers, equipped with powerful weaponry and usually deployed against enemy tanks and armour. Their precision targeting relay can also provide data to allied units.
entries.zh: 可怕的六足步行者，装备有强大的武器，通常被部署对抗敌人的坦克和盔甲。他们的精确瞄准中继也可以向盟友单位提供数据。

entries.en: A huge construct fitted with a devastating doomsday blaster. Doomstalkers are often used as sentries to protect Necron overlords and their treasures.
entries.zh: 一个装备了毁灭性末日爆破枪的巨大构造体。毁灭者常常被用作哨兵，保护太空死灵霸主和他们的宝藏。

entries.en: Even the greatest Sautekh can succumb to the destroyer curse. These towering Skorpekhs efficiently butcher enemy lines while commanding the frenzied in brief moments of clarity.
entries.zh: 即使是最伟大的索泰克也会屈服于毁灭者的诅咒。这些高大的斯科尔佩克高效地屠杀敌人的阵线，同时在短暂的清醒时刻指挥狂热者。
