entries.en: Roughly translated as ‘the patient hunter’, Kauyon combat tactics rely upon lures to draw the enemy in, before closing the jaws of the trap upon overcommited foes.
entries.zh: 粗略翻译为“耐心的猎手”，空育战术依赖于诱饵来吸引敌人，然后在过度投入的敌人身上关闭陷阱的大门。

entries.en: The Earth Caste comprises the artisans and engineers of the T’au. It is they who construct machines and ensure the peak performance of the battlesuits for the battles to come.
entries.zh: 土氏包括塔族的工匠师和工程师。他们负责构造机器，并确保战斗服在即将到来的战斗中达到最佳性能。

entries.en: As a breath of air slips unseen and unheard through blades of grass in a night-time forest, so do the T’au filter swift and silent across the battlefield.
entries.zh: 就像夜晚森林中的草叶间无声无息地滑过一口气，塔族也在战场上迅速而沉默地过滤。

entries.en: Ethereals control access to numerous classified new technological developments of the Earth Caste, and look for the optimal time to reveal them.
entries.zh: 以太控制着对土氏的许多新技术发展的访问，并寻找适当的时机来揭示它们。

entries.en: Unification echoes through the ranks, embodying the belief that the life of any given individual of the T’au Empire is of less importance than the needs of the empire itself.
entries.zh: 统一在队伍中回响，体现了塔族帝国任何个体的生命都不如帝国本身的需要重要的信念。

entries.en: Rather than charge into hand-to-hand combat, T’au soldiery instead intensify their fire patterns and systematically lay waste to the foe.
entries.zh: 塔族兵士并非冲入近战，而是强化他们的火力模式，系统性地摧毁敌人。

entries.en: Some Fire Caste soldiers deploy as elite Pathfinders who scout the foe and mark targets for long-ranged elimination.
entries.zh: 一些火氏士兵作为精英探路者部署，他们侦查敌人并标记远程消除的目标。

entries.en: As stone resists the onslaught of the other elements in their endless quest to wear it away, so do the T’au exhibit that same unbending resilience.
entries.zh: 就像石头抵抗其他元素无尽的侵蚀，塔族也表现出同样的坚韧不屈。

entries.en: Engaging all systems, skilled battlesuit pilots can surge into battle in a blaze of deadly-accurate firepower.
entries.zh: 启动所有系统，熟练的战斗服飞行员可以在一片致命精确的火力中冲入战斗。

entries.en: The Ethereals perform a unifying role. They take counsel from senior members of each caste, but ultimately all decisions are theirs to make and responsibilities theirs to be borne.
entries.zh: 以太在统一中起到作用。他们从每个氏族的高级成员那里寻求建议，但最终所有的决定都是他们做出的，所有的责任也是他们承担的。

entries.en: The mere presence of an Ethereal reminds the warriors of the Fire Caste of their place within the Greater Good, and inspires them to even greater efforts.
entries.zh: 一个以太的存在就能让火氏的战士们想起他们在上上善道中的位置，并激励他们做出更大的努力。

entries.en: Pathfinders can infiltrate deep behind enemy lines, to scout the foe and identify the highest priority targets for long-ranged elimination.
entries.zh: 探路者可以深入敌人的后方，侦查敌人并确定长距离消除的最高优先级目标。

entries.en: Built-in saviour protocols compel the machine intelligence of T'au drones to sacrifice itself for the Greater Good in the place of its masters.
entries.zh: 内置的救世主协议强迫钛帝国无人机的机器智能为了上上善道而牺牲自己，代替它的主人。

entries.en: The steady gaze of the Ethereal reminds those of the Fire Caste that there lies within the heart of every storm a zone of silence that remains serene even as fury rages around it.
entries.zh: 以太的坚定目光提醒火氏的人们，每场风暴的心脏都有一个寂灭区，即使周围的怒火如何狂暴，它仍然宁静。

entries.en: T’au combined arms groups are called Hunter Cadres for good reason. Working in close coordination, they hunt and destroy the most dangerous enemy targets.
entries.zh: 钛帝国的联合武器组被称为猎核，有充分的理由。他们密切协调，猎杀并摧毁最危险的敌人目标。

entries.en: To make best use of their available arsenal, the Fire Caste place heavy emphasis on skilled marksmanship and fighting from a position of advantage.
entries.zh: 为了最好地利用他们可用的武器库，火氏重视熟练的射击技巧和从有利位置进行战斗。

entries.en: Swift and lethal, Razorsharks soar over enemy lines raining destruction upon enemy formations as a testament to T'au air superiority and precision tactics.
entries.zh: 敏捷而致命，剃刀鲨在敌人阵线上空翱翔，对敌人阵型进行破坏，这是钛帝国空中优势和精确战术的最好证明。

entries.en: With mechanical efficiency instilled by endless drills, the T’au maintain a punishing fire rate even when engaging the enemy at long range.
entries.zh: 通过无尽的训练，钛帝国保持了惩罚性的火力，即使在远距离与敌人交战时也是如此。

entries.en: Drones will dive into the path of incoming fire without a second thought if it means protecting T’au lives.
entries.zh: 如果这意味着保护钛帝国的生命，无人机会在没有第二次思考的情况下冲入即将到来的火力之路。

entries.en: The Greater Good demands the tireless expansion of the T’au Empire. Through diplomacy or strength of arms, new worlds and civilisations are brought into the light of the T’au’va.
entries.zh: 上上善道要求钛帝国不断扩张。通过外交或武力，新的世界和文明被带入钛帝国的光明中。

entries.en: The resulting darkness of a solar eclipse allows the usage of low-flying drop ships to deploy entire squads directly into the enemy lines.
entries.zh: 太阳食的黑暗使得低空飞行的空投船能直接将整个小队部署到敌人的阵线中。

entries.en: As advanced as T'au wargear is, it can also backfire on them. Under harsh battlefield conditions obfuscation flares can detonate prematurely, dousing the battlefield in electro-static interference.
entries.zh: 尽管钛帝国的战争装备先进，但也可能会对他们产生反效果。在严酷的战场条件下，混淆照明弹可能会过早地爆炸，使战场充满电磁干扰。

entries.en: Not all worlds are made equal. Septs were not easy for the T'au to establish. Some worlds are hot, lashed by ferocious natural phenomena and the fiery anger of their star.
entries.zh: 并非所有的世界都是平等的。钛帝国的七月并不容易建立。有些世界炎热，被猛烈的自然现象和他们星球的火热愤怒所折磨。

entries.en: To make best use of their available arsenal, the Fire Caste emphasises skilled marksmanship under pressure and the use of firearms over brute force even at close quarters.
entries.zh: 为了最好地利用他们的可用武器库，火氏强调在压力下的熟练射击技巧和在近距离内优先使用火器而不是蛮力。

entries.en: These mobile anti-grav gun turrets mount lethal railguns whose hypersonic rounds can stop even super-heavy war engines dead in their tracks.
entries.zh: 这些移动的反重力炮塔装载了致命的磁轨枪，其超音速弹头甚至可以使超重型战争机器停在原地。

entries.en: Tidewall Droneports house swarms of Tactical Drones and shield them from the enemy fire. At a command from the droneport operators, these drones are unleashed to join the battle.
entries.zh: 潮墙无人机库收容了大量的战术无人机，并将它们从敌人的火力中保护起来。在无人机库操作员的指挥下，这些无人机被释放出来参加战斗。

entries.en: Securing their colossal suits to the terrain, Stormsurge pilots stabilize their firing platforms, unleashing devastating barrages upon their foes with unparalleled precision.
entries.zh: 雷暴炮击的飞行员将他们巨大的战斗服固定在地形上，稳定他们的火力平台，以无与伦比的精确度对敌人进行毁灭性的炮击。

entries.en: This device deployed by Stealth Battlesuit operatives emits a precise signal that guides Crisis pilots to swiflty descend from a Manta to strike deep within enemy territory.
entries.zh: 由隐形战斗服操作员部署的这个设备发出一个精确的信号，指导危机飞行员从Manta迅速下降，深入敌人的领土。

entries.en: Powered by an internal microgenerator, this device projects an energy field of substantial scope and resilience able to turn aside even the heaviest incoming fire.
entries.zh: 这个设备由内部微发电机驱动，能够投射出一个大范围且弹性的能量场，能够抵挡住最重的来火。

entries.en: Worn over the eye, sub-commander El’Myamoto's structural analyser allows him to pinpoint the weak spots of even the most indomitable enemies.
entries.zh: 戴在眼上，副指挥官暗行的结构分析器让他能精确找出即使是最坚不可摧的敌人的弱点。

entries.en: Commander O’Shaserra is a master of Kauyon, laying cunning ambushes for her enemies then striking with merciless fury, spearheading these attacks from the front.
entries.zh: 指挥官欧·夏萨拉是空育的大师，她为敌人设下狡猾的伏击，然后以无情的狂怒进行攻击，亲自在前线领导这些攻击。

entries.en: Under Aun’Va’s stony gaze, the Hunter Cadres strive to achieve excellence beyond imagining, fighting tirelessly in defence of the Ethereal Supreme.
entries.zh: 在昂’瓦的石瞳注视下，猎核竭尽全力，力求超越想象的卓越，为了保卫至高以太，他们从未知疲倦地战斗。

entries.en: The T’au make extensive use of machine intelligences they call drones, which carry specialized systems to cover a broad range of battlefield roles.
entries.zh: 钛帝国广泛使用他们称为无人机的机器智能，这些无人机携带专门的系统，覆盖广泛的战场角色。

entries.en: The Ethereals perform a unifying role within the T’au Empire. On the battlefield, they evoke the elemental truths to inspire nigh-supernatural feats and tide-turning zealotry.
entries.zh: 以太在钛帝国内部起到统一的作用。在战场上，他们唤起元素真理，激发几乎超自然的壮举和潮汐转变的狂热。

entries.en: Possessed of fanatical fervour, Ghallaron the Pious leads his forces into the most ferocious war zones, in a quest to receive the boons of the Chaos pantheon.
entries.zh: 附魔战士，狂热热诚，虔诚者加拉隆率领他的军队进入最凶猛的战区，寻求混沌诸神的恩赐。

entries.en: Ghallaron's mortal followers are zealous worshippers brimming with hate, who see faith as an easy route to power in an uncaring galaxy.
entries.zh: 加拉隆的凡人追随者是充满仇恨的狂热崇拜者，他们认为信仰是在冷漠的银河中轻易获得力量的途径。

entries.en: The tales of Ghallaron's feats travel fast, with each new deed from his forces attracting more legionaries eager to join one so blessed by the Dark Gods.
entries.zh: 关于加拉隆的壮举的故事传播迅速，他的部队的每一次新行为都吸引了更多渴望加入黑暗诸神如此眷顾的人的军团战士。

entries.en: Ghallaron's forces firmly believe that by allying themselves to one so blessed by the Dark Gods, they too will receive the gifts of the Chaos pantheon.
entries.zh: 加拉隆的军队坚信，通过与黑暗诸神所祝福的人结盟，他们也将获得混沌诸神的恩赐。

entries.en: Melta Weapons emit devastatingly intense but short-ranged blasts of heat which can melt through almost any material, with greater effect the closer to the target.
entries.zh: 热熔武器发射出强烈但短程的热量爆炸，可以融化几乎任何材料，越靠近目标效果越大。

entries.en: With a preference for inflicting carnage at long range, Havocs rain down death and destruction upon the battlefield.
entries.zh: 浩劫偏爱在远距离造成大屠杀，他们在战场上带来死亡和破坏。

entries.en: Havocs wield fearsome weaponry that can tear apart infantry and light vehicles alike with astonishing ease, crippling their enemies' ability to move freely across the battlefield.
entries.zh: 浩劫挥舞着可怕的武器，可以轻易地撕裂步兵和轻型载具，削弱敌人在战场上自由移动的能力。

entries.en: These infernal walkers are fitted with a variety of powerful armaments to blast enemies from afar, and cruel appendages with which to hack and crush at close range.
entries.zh: 这些地狱步行者装备了各种强大的武器，可以从远处爆炸敌人，还有残忍的附肢，可以在近距离砍杀和压碎。

entries.en: Veterans of the Long War know precisely where to place their shots to inflict the most pain and misery on their luckless victims.
entries.zh: 万古长战的老兵精确地知道在哪里放置他们的射击，以对他们不幸的受害者造成最大的痛苦和痛苦。

entries.en: Invoking corruption and pestilence, worshippers of Grandfather Nurgle can bring wondrous diseases upon their unsuspecting enemies.
entries.zh: 唤起腐败和瘟疫，纳垢的崇拜者可以给他们毫无防备的敌人带来奇妙的疾病。

entries.en: Some Chaos worshippers make it their primary mission to smash aside all symbols of the enemy faith, in an effort to erase even the records of its existence.
entries.zh: 一些混沌崇拜者把破坏敌人信仰的所有象征作为他们的主要布道所，以努力抹去其存在的记录。

entries.en: The demagogue's infernal litany calls upon the Dark Gods to offer his foes all manner of whispered temptations, sapping their will to fight.
entries.zh: 煽动者的地狱诵读呼唤黑暗诸神给他的敌人提供各种低语的诱惑，削弱他们的战斗意志。

entries.en: Fuelled by twisted faith and undying hatred, Chaos warriors strike out with spiteful fury in an endless pursuit of bloodshed.
entries.zh: 由扭曲的信仰和不朽的仇恨驱动，混沌战士以恶意的狂怒发动攻击，无休止地追求流血。

entries.en: War Shapers are exemplary warriors that stride into battle armed with symbolic yet deadly traditional weapons, leading Kroot forces in the field.
entries.zh: 战笋塑型者是出类拔萃的战士，他们手持象征性但却致命的传统武器，领导克鲁特人的军队在战场上冲锋。

entries.en: Swift and vicious, Kroot Carnivores employ fieldcraft and predatory instinct to outwit their foes. Operating in hunting packs, where one is spotted others certainly skulk around.
entries.zh: 敏捷而凶猛的克鲁特食肉兽运用战术和捕食本能来智胜敌人。他们在狩猎群体中行动，一旦有一个被发现，其他的肯定也在附近潜伏。

entries.en: Driven into a carnivorous frenzy by the scent of blood, Kroot Hounds pounce upon their victims with frightening speed, ripping and tearing with beak-like maws and vicious talons.
entries.zh: 克鲁特猎犬被血腥的气味驱使进入食肉的狂热，他们以惊人的速度扑向猎物，用鸟嘴般的大嘴和凶猛的利爪撕裂和撕扯。

entries.en: Trail Shaper work with instinctive skill to shape the very battlefield upon which the Kroot will meet their prey and guide the routes along which the hunt will progress.
entries.zh: 塑途者凭借本能的技巧塑造战场，这是克鲁特人会遇到他们的猎物并指引狩猎进程的路线。

entries.en: Krootox make excellent living gun platforms, lumbering into battle with cannons strapped to their backs, their Kroot gunners swaying atop their steeds in primitive harnesses.
entries.zh: 克鲁托克是极好的活动炮台，他们背着大炮笨重地进入战场，他们的克鲁特炮手在原始的马鞍上摇摆。

entries.en: Flesh Shapers take the Shaper's art of guiding their kin's genetic makeup to a visceral extreme through the use of gruesome flesh-fetishes and ritualised butchery.
entries.zh: 鲜肉塑型者通过使用恶心的肉体饰品和仪式化的屠杀，将塑型者引导他们亲族的基因构成的艺术推向了极端。

entries.en: Juvenile Krootox exhibit greater aggression and agility than their elders. Used as ambushers, terror troops and skirmish cavalry, they strike fast from unexpected quarters.
entries.zh: 幼年的克鲁托克比他们的长者更具侵略性和敏捷性。他们被用作伏击者，恐怖军队和轻骑兵，他们从意想不到的地方快速攻击。

entries.en: Mounted upon chameleonic Kalamandras, Kroot Lone-spears wield explosive javelins. They excel as long-range scouts, picking off valuable enemy targets
entries.zh: 骑在变色的卡拉曼德拉斯上，克鲁特孤独的矛手持爆炸性的标枪。他们擅长长距离侦查，挑选有价值的敌人目标。

entries.en: Kroot’s quills are powerful sensory organs which, combined with the Kroot’s extremely strong senses of smell and eyesight, help make them formidable trackers and pack hunters.
entries.zh: 克鲁特人的刺是强大的感官器官，结合克鲁特人极强的嗅觉和视力，帮助他们成为强大的追踪者和群体猎手。

entries.en: When the Shapers command, Kroot and Rampagers burst from cover and charge, ploughing headlong into enemy lines and leaping into the fight while voicing shrill avian cries.
entries.zh: 当塑型者指挥时，克鲁特人和狂暴者从掩体中冲出来并冲锋，直冲敌人的阵线，跳入战斗，同时发出尖锐的鸟叫声。

entries.en: Kroot Hounds naturally predate upon weakened foes, drawn by the scent of spilled blood. They are often released in hunting packs that maul vulnerable or fleeing foes.
entries.zh: 克鲁特猎犬自然会捕食虚弱的敌人，被溢出的血腥气味吸引。他们通常在狩猎群体中被释放，撕咬脆弱或逃跑的敌人。

entries.en: Kroot Shapers possess an instinctive understanding of their species' morphing biology, and guide the genetic strands of their warpacks through the ingestion of selected prey.
entries.zh: 克鲁特塑形者本能地理解他们种族的变形生物学，并通过摄取特定猎物来引导他们战团的基因链。

entries.en: Palatine Erika is a ferociously zealous and experienced war leader, frequently sent to far-flung crusading missions. She inspires her fellow Sisters to fervent acts of bravery.
entries.zh: 宫廷官艾丽卡是一位极度狂热且经验丰富的战争领袖，经常被派往遥远的十字军任务。她激励她的战斗修女们进行热情的英勇行为。

entries.en: Appointed Canoness Superior by the grace of the Emperor himself, Junith Eruita sweeps into battle riding within the Pulpit of Saint Holline’s Basilica wreathed in holy fire.
entries.zh: 茱妮丝·伊瑞塔被帝皇亲自任命为大修女，她乘坐在圣霍林大教堂的讲坛上，身披圣火，扫荡进入战斗。

entries.en: Aggressive, brash and taciturn, Morvenn Vahl leads the Adepta Sororitas from the front in an ancient Paragon Warsuit, smiting her foes with Fidelis and the Lance of Illumination.
entries.zh: 莫雯·瓦尔激进、傲慢且沉默寡言，她在古老的楷模铠甲中领导修女会，用忠贞和光明之矛击败敌人。

entries.en: Sisters Novitiate are young recruits trained by the Schola Progenium and assigned to an Order Militant to gain combat experience and prove their mettle in the crucible of war.
entries.zh: 见习修女是由教導院训练的年轻新兵，被分配到武装修会以获得战斗经验，并在战争的坩堝中证明自己的勇气。

entries.en: Battle Sisters of the Orders Militant are skilled and devout warriors. Wherever they advance, the light of the Emperor spreads like a holy dawn and miracles manifest.
entries.zh: 武装修会的战斗修女是熟练且虔诚的战士。无论他们前进到哪里，帝皇的光辉都像神圣的黎明一样散发出来，奇迹也随之显现。

entries.en: Belief in the God-Emperor is the greatest strength of the Sisters of Battle. The force of their faith is expressed in every vengeful shot and every shouted prayer.
entries.zh: 对神皇的信仰是战斗修女最大的力量。他们的信仰力量体现在每一次复仇的射击和每一次高喊的祈祷中。

entries.en: These pious bodyguards are chosen for their martial skill and devotion to the Imperial Creed. Bullets and sorcerous witchfire alike are deflected from their warded tower shields.
entries.zh: 这些虔诚的保镖因其武术技能和对帝国信仰的忠诚而被选中。子弹和巫术火焰都会被他们的守护塔盾挡开。

entries.en: Fitted with cybernetic weaponry and subdermal stimulants as punishment for past misdeeds, their mindless bodies are energised and unleashed in a frenzied whirlwind of destruction.
entries.zh: 他们的身体被装配了赛博术武器和皮下刺激剂，作为对过去错误行为的惩罚，他们无意识的身体被激发并在狂热的旋风中释放出来。

entries.en: Preachers harness the faith of Imperial warriors in battle. Filled with a fearsome religious fervour, they incite the faithful as they bellow catechisms of faith and hatred.
entries.zh: 布道士在战斗中激发帝国战士的信仰。他们充满了可怕的宗教狂热，他们在大声疾呼信仰和仇恨的教义时激发信徒。

entries.en: Sisters Repentia charge across the battlefield filled with the need for atonement for past misdeeds, existing only to slaughter the enemies of the Emperor to redeem themselves.
entries.zh: 忏悔修女满怀赎罪之心冲上战场，为过去的罪行赎罪，她们只存在于屠杀帝皇的敌人，以此来赎回自己。

entries.en: Dominion Squads strike swift and furious, clearing and capturing strategic locations and blunting counter-attacks with vicious salvoes from their flamers and meltaguns.
entries.zh: 御天使小队迅速猛烈地攻击，清理并占领战略位置，用他们的火焰喷射器和热熔枪阻挡反攻。

entries.en: Retributors are the finest sharpshooters in their Order. They provide heavy fire support as they unleash a storm of bolts and fire upon the enemy.
entries.zh: 仇天使是他们修会中最优秀的射手。他们提供重型火力支援，向敌人释放一场弹丸和火焰的风暴。

entries.en: Wrought from the bones of an ancient saint or martyr, a Simulacrum is carried into battle by a chosen bearer to reinforce the faith of all those who look upon it.
entries.zh: 由一位古代圣人或烈士的骨骼铸成的仿生体，由一位神选者携带进入战场，以增强所有看到它的人的信仰。

entries.en: Amalia Novena stands as the embodiment of the values of the Order of Our Martyred Lady, a vengeful and fiery spirit tempered to deliver the God-Emperor's holy justice.
entries.zh: 阿玛利亚·诺维娜代表了殉教圣女修会的价值观，她是一个复仇和火热的精神，被磨练出来传递神皇的神圣正义。

entries.en: The Celestians are the finest warriors in their Order. They frequently serve as bodyguards and champions of Canonesses, willingly sacrificing themselves to protect their charge.
entries.zh: 天堂战士是他们修会中最优秀的战士。他们经常作为大修女的保镖和冠军，愿意牺牲自己来保护他们的主人。

entries.en: Missionaries live existences of constant conflict. Fighting at the forefront of the Adepta Sororitas’ holy wars, they stride into battle without fear as they intone sacred prayers.
entries.zh: 传教士过着不断冲突的生活。他们在修女会的圣战前线战斗，他们在吟唱神圣的祈祷时毫无恐惧地走进战斗。

entries.en: Some members of the Orders Militant have waged war on hundreds of battlefields. Using their experience, Sister Superiors lead their squads to battle with fervor and determination.
entries.zh: 武装修会的一些成员在数百个战场上进行过战争。他们利用自己的经验，修女长官带领他们的小队以热情和决心进入战斗。

entries.en: The Dialogus broadcasts her liturgies to her Sisters through their vox-beads and sensor arrays, using inspirational rhetoric of prayers and hymns to exalt praise to the God-Emperor.
entries.zh: 书记官通过他们的通讯珠和传感器阵列向她的修女们广播她的礼拜，使用祈祷和赞美诗的激励修辞来赞美神皇。

entries.en: The Seraphim fight in the advanced guard, firing with pinpoint accuracy while moving at great speeds and landing with incredible precision to cut down foes in a heartbeats.
entries.zh: 炽天使在先锋线上战斗，以精准的火力移动，以惊人的精确度降落，以一瞬间的心跳击倒敌人。

entries.en: Hospitallers are physical and spiritual healers possessed of medicinal expertise. They intone mantras of vigour to dull pain and salve fevered minds.
entries.zh: 医疗官是身心的治疗者，拥有医药专业知识。他们吟唱活力咒语以减轻疼痛和安抚发热的心灵。

entries.en: Obsessed with spilling the blood of the unclean, Death Cult Assassins leap twirling and spinning into the enemy’s ranks. Their every slice and stab has a ritualistic execution.
entries.zh: 死亡教派刺客痴迷于洒落不洁之物的血，他们跳跃、旋转并冲入敌人的队伍。他们的每一次切割和刺击都有一种仪式感的执行。

entries.en: Channelling all their hatred and fury towards the enemies of Mankind, these warriors storm through the enemy lines with the fervour and force of holy lightning.
entries.zh: 这些战士将所有的仇恨和愤怒都倾注在人类的敌人身上，他们如同神圣的闪电般冲过敌人的阵线。

entries.en: Martial and spiritual commanders, Canonesses are both veteran warriors and shining examples of purity. They possess impeccable leadership skills, tactical genius and immense faith.
entries.zh: 作为军事和精神的指挥官，修女长既是老兵，也是纯洁的典范。他们拥有无可挑剔的领导技能、战术天才和深厚的信仰。

entries.en: Topped with the remains of their Saints, this stave represents their heroism in service to the Emperor. Its presence in battle echoes the Saints' deeds, inspiring fellow Sisters.
entries.zh: 这根法杖顶端装饰着他们的圣人遗骸，代表着他们对帝皇的英勇服务。它在战场上的存在回响着圣人的事迹，激励着其他的修女。

entries.en: Imagifiers bear great stanchions in the image of a martyr inscribed with holy texts, and go wherever the fighting is thickest to recite litanies and inspire their fellow Sisters.
entries.zh: 持像者们举起刻有神圣文字的殉道者形象的大旗，他们走向战斗最激烈的地方，吟唱圣歌，激励他们的修女同胞。

entries.en: As Reliquant at Arms, Aestred is sworn to protect the Auto-Tapestry of the Emperor’s Judgement, which imbues with divine strength those under its presence.
entries.zh: 作为武装的圣物守护者，艾斯特雷德誓言保护帝皇的审判自动绣帷，它赋予在其存在下的人们神圣的力量。

entries.en: Subjected to terrible agony, Penitent Engines' pilots blaze a trail of destruction with their flamers before charging headlong into the foe, driven by guilt and pain.
entries.zh: 赎罪机甲的驾驶员经历了可怕的痛苦，他们用火焰喷射器留下一道毁灭的痕迹，然后在罪恶和痛苦的驱使下冲向敌人。

entries.en: Only those who experience a direct and persistent connection with the Emperor become Zephyrim. They are divine  destroyers that strike down their foes with ruthless precision.
entries.zh: 只有那些与帝皇有直接和持久联系的人才能成为风天使。他们是神圣的毁灭者，以无情的精确度击倒他们的敌人。

entries.en: Also known as the Daemonifuge, Stern is capable of manifesting strange powers seen by some as witchery, yet she is a zealous defender of the Imperial Creed with firm devotion.
entries.zh: 也被称为恶魔驱逐者的斯特恩，她能够显现出一些被人们视为巫术的奇特力量，然而她是帝国信仰的热诚捍卫者，坚定的信仰。

entries.en: Celestian Sacresants are close-combat specialists who are charged with a holy quest, such as securing sacred relics or purging sites of the unclean.
entries.zh: 洁天使圣徒是近战专家，他们被赋予神圣的任务，如保护神圣的遗物或清除不洁之物的地方。

entries.en: With shouted prayers and great swings of their maces, Sisters Dogmata demonstrate the path of righteousness and show what the Sisters should expect if they fail in their duties.
entries.zh: 修女教条官以高声祷告和他们的重锤大挥，展示了正义之道，显示了如果修女们在职责中失败，她们应该期待的是什么。

entries.en: Mortifier pilots are Sisters who fled from battle. They cannot move, speak or hear, and suffer endless shame and agony driving them to carve a path of mutilation and destruction.
entries.zh: 忏悔者的驾驶员是从战场上逃跑的修女。他们不能移动，不能说话，不能听见，他们遭受无尽的羞耻和痛苦，驱使他们开辟一条创伤和毁灭的道路。

entries.en: Saint Celestine is a living embodiment of the Emperor’s might, radiating holy light. Beneath her the faithful are filled with courage, while heretics experience naught but terror.
entries.zh: 圣女塞莱丝廷是帝皇力量的活体化身，散发着神圣的光芒。在她之下，信徒们充满了勇气，而异教徒只能感受到恐惧。

entries.en: Those who prove their worth rise to the rank of Celestians, and may be entrusted with a portion of the hallowed truth learnt by their Matriarch in the chamber of the Golden Throne.
entries.zh: 那些证明了自己价值的人升至洁天使的等级，他们可能被委以一部分由他们的修女长在黄金王座的房间中学到的神圣真理。

entries.en: This Rhino variant has an aggresive machine spirit, and is equipped with Twin-linked Heavy Flamers primed to cleanse the tainted and sinful from the Emperor's domain.
entries.zh: 这种犀牛战车型号拥有一个侵略性的机魂，装备了双联重型火焰喷射器，准备清除帝皇领域中的不洁和罪恶。

entries.en: Every flurry of notes performed by the Exorcist’s artillerist inloads impact coordinates so that volleys of thrice-blessed rockets are fired into the enemy with precision.
entries.zh: 驱魔者战车的炮手每次演奏的音符都会输入冲击坐标，使得三次祝福的火箭精准地射向敌人。

entries.en: At the centre of the Triumph is the blessed bier upon which lie the mortal remains of Saint Katherine. Wherever the Triumph goes, the Emperor’s radiance goes with it.
entries.zh: 胜利的中心是圣凯瑟琳的神圣遗体所躺的灵柩。无论胜利走到哪里，帝皇的光辉都与之同在。

entries.en: Paragon Warsuits are regarded as sacred vestments with a noble will of their own. Pilots must have immense faith for the Warsuit’s spirit to trust them.
entries.zh: 楷模铠甲被视为有自己贵族意志的神圣服饰。驾驶员必须有极大的信仰，才能让铠甲的精神信任他们。

entries.en: On the battlefield, sisters are often found delivering His justice with a prayer on their lips and righteous hatred in their eyes. Faith and fury are one and the same in battle.
entries.zh: 在战场上，修女们常常在嘴唇上祈祷，眼中充满正义的仇恨，执行他的正义。在战斗中，信仰和愤怒是一体的。

entries.en: Deliverers of the Emperor's holy justice, the Adepta Sororitas are unrelenting when facing His enemies, raining down destruction to the clarion call of impassioned prayer.
entries.zh: 作为帝皇神圣正义的传递者，修女会对他的敌人毫不留情，以激昂的祈祷声降下毁灭。

entries.en: The miracles of the God-Emperor are self-evident to those with the iron-hard conviction of true zealots. In the presence of the sisterhood, His manifestations are myriad.
entries.zh: 对于那些有铁一般坚定信念的真正狂热者来说，神皇的奇迹是不言自明的。在姐妹修会的面前，他的显现是无数的。

entries.en: The ministrations of the Sisters of the Orders Hospitaller have seen many a warrior brought back from the brink of death to return to the fray.
entries.zh: 医疗官修女的照顾使许多战士从死亡边缘回归，重返战场。

entries.en: With purifying flame did the great saints of legend purge the enemies of faith from the galaxy, and such tradition, shall be upheld as long as the sisterhood fights.
entries.zh: 伟大的圣人们用净化的火焰清除了银河系中的信仰敌人，只要姐妹修会还在战斗，这种传统就会被维持下去。

entries.en: With the Emperor watching over them, the righteous zeal of the Sisters of Battle burns ever brighter, fuelling them into miraculous feats in battle.
entries.zh: 在帝皇的守护下，战斗修女的正义热忱燃烧得更加明亮，激发他们在战斗中创造奇迹。

entries.en: The faithful stand firm against the worst horrors of the galaxy. Even as hordes of mutants and heretics charge forward, they shall lay them low with righteous fury.
entries.zh: 信徒坚定地抵抗银河系最恶劣的恐怖。即使突变体和异端的大军冲过来，他们也将以正义的愤怒将他们击倒。

entries.en: Sisters of Battle gripped with holy fervour banish worldly fears from their minds, shrug off mortal wounds, and summon preternatural strength to smite their foes.
entries.zh: 充满神圣热忱的战斗修女将世俗的恐惧从心中驱逐，忽视致命的伤口，召唤超自然的力量来击败他们的敌人。

entries.en: Believed chosen by the God-Emperor Himself, the warriors of the Adepta Sororitas enact miraculous feats on the battlefield, pushing through mortal limitations to enact His will.
entries.zh: 被认为是神皇亲自选中的修女会的战士们在战场上创造了奇迹，突破了人类的限制，执行他的意志。

entries.en: The Adepta Sororitas are upheld as the most pious of the Imperial Creed’s adherents, fighting in its name to eradicate any who threaten the purity of Mankind.
entries.zh: 修女会被视为帝国信仰最虔诚的信徒，以其名义战斗，消灭任何威胁人类纯洁的人。

entries.en: Often controlled by the Ecclesiarchy, these planets are the training grounds for members of the Adeptus Ministorum and the Adepta Sororitas.
entries.zh: 这些星球通常由国教控制，是国教教会和修女会成员的训练场。

entries.en: Saint Katherine was well-known for her fiery determination and vengeful spirit. As long as her relics wage war against mutant and heretic, so shall her deeds continue.
entries.zh: 圣女凯瑟琳以她的火热决心和复仇精神而闻名。只要她的圣物继续对抗突变体和异教徒，她的事迹就将继续。

entries.en: None can escape the Emperor’s judgement. There is no shelter that could withstand the righteous fury of His warriors, nor force that could stop their holy procession.
entries.zh: 没有人能逃脱帝皇的审判。没有任何庇护所能抵挡住他的战士的正义愤怒，也没有任何力量能阻止他们的神圣进军。

entries.en: Girded by their unshakable faith, Sororitas push through the most gruelling hardships to bring death to the Emperor’s enemies. No amount of suffering is too great for them to bear.
entries.zh: 由他们坚定不移的信仰所支持，修女们穿越最艰难的困境，给帝皇的敌人带来死亡。没有任何痛苦对他们来说太大。

entries.en: A Sister will typically make a pilgrimage to have her wargear bestowed upon her. From that day forth, Sororitas and weapon operate as one to vanquish the enemies of the faith.
entries.zh: 修女通常会进行朝圣，让她的战争装备赐予她。从那天开始，修女和武器作为一体，消灭信仰的敌人。

entries.en: Invoking the strength of the God-Emperor through hymns and prayers in the midst of battle, Sisters carve apart their enemies like the warrior-saints of legend.
entries.zh: 在战斗中，通过赞美诗和祈祷唤起神皇的力量，修女们像传说中的战士圣人一样，将敌人分割。

entries.en: It is believed that suffering is the greatest prayer a Living Saint can offer the God-Emperor, and a reminder of one's wrongs so that they might strive to correct.
entries.zh: 人们相信，受苦是活着的圣人可以向神皇提供的最大的祈祷，也是提醒自己的错误，以便他们努力去纠正。

entries.en: On the battlefield, battle-sisters loudly proclaim their faith in hymn and verse as they march to war, calling upon the Emperor to aid them in the fight against their enemies.
entries.zh: 在战场上，战斗修女们高声宣扬他们的信仰，以赞美诗和诗篇行军，呼唤帝皇在与敌人的战斗中援助他们。

entries.en: The blood of martyrs is the life force of the Imperium. So do the Sororitas tenets joyously proclaim, and so does the sacrifice of a Sister shine brightest in the darkest hour.
entries.zh: 烈士的鲜血是帝国的生命力。修女会的教条如此欢乐地宣告，一个修女的牺牲在最黑暗的时刻闪耀得最亮。

entries.en: Training and worship are inseparable disciplines to a Sister of Battle. Whilst combat drills and martial studies can hone the body and mind, only prayer can bolster the spirit.
entries.zh: 对于战斗修女来说，训练和崇拜是不可分割的纪律。虽然战斗演习和武术研究可以磨练身心，但只有祈祷才能增强精神。

entries.en: Faith is as strong as any sword. As the sanctified words of the Order’s holy tenets are roared across the halls of the shrine, the devout are infused with the Emperor’s blessings.
entries.zh: 信仰如同剑一般坚强。当修女会的神圣教义在神殿大厅中高声宣读，虔诚的人们便会被帝皇的祝福充满。

entries.en: When the Ecclesiarchy’s sacred holdings are under threat, the Adepta Sororitas are unleashed in a storm of righteous fire. They stand as their guardians and most zealous defenders.
entries.zh: 当国教的神圣领地受到威胁时，修女会将在正义之火的风暴中释放。她们是守护者，也是最狂热的防御者。

entries.en: In the Ecclesiarchy's shrines, statues are raised to exalt the Saints' legendary deeds. Many pray for their guidance, and Sisters invoke their names on the field of battle.
entries.zh: 在国教的神殿中，人们为了赞美圣人的传奇事迹而树立雕像。许多人祈求他们的指引，修女们在战场上呼唤他们的名字。

entries.en: While the shrines of the Adeptus Ministorum are built sturdily, the raging storms on the Shrine Worlds can shake their walls as well as the resolve of those within them.
entries.zh: 虽然国教教会的神殿建造得很坚固，但神殿世界上的狂风暴雨可以摇动他们的墙壁，也可以动摇他们内心的决心。

entries.en: As well protected as the Shrines can be, a heavy bombardment can still undermine the Shrine defenses and provide unique openings for a swift attack.
entries.zh: 尽管神殿可以得到很好的保护，但重炮轰炸仍然可以破坏神殿的防御，并为快速攻击提供独特的机会。

entries.en: Besides waging Wars of Faith, the Daughters of the Emperor devote themselves to a wide range of non-militant disciplines by which they can serve the God-Emperor.
entries.zh: 除了发动信仰之战，帝皇之女们还致力于广泛的非军事学科，通过这些学科他们可以为神皇服务。

entries.en: In countless Wars of Faith, Luminas has turned apparent defeat into crushing victory, courageously storming enemy firepoints and assaulting the foe’s elite warriors.
entries.zh: 在无数的信仰之战中，艾丽卡·露米纳斯已经将明显的失败转变为压倒性的胜利，勇敢地冲向敌人的火力点，攻击敌人的精英战士。

entries.en: Tales of holy rage, accounts of a martyr's stoicism, stories of miraculous defiance... All serve to inspire and steel the hearts of those adherent to the Imperial Creed.
entries.zh: 关于神圣的愤怒的故事，烈士坚忍不拔的记载，奇迹般的抵抗的故事...所有这些都激励并坚定了那些坚持帝国信仰的人的心。

entries.en: Holding high the Mace of Castigation, Judith's presence and voice inspire all around her, as she directs the Battle Sisters through the battlefield to where they are most needed.
entries.zh: 高举惩罚权杖，茱妮丝·伊瑞塔的存在和声音激励着她周围的所有人，她指导战斗修女们在战场上到达他们最需要的地方。

entries.en: "With the holy bolter we shall cleanse the mutant, the alien and the heretic. With the Emperor’s gift do we deliver our hatred of the defiler."
entries.zh: "凭借神圣的爆矢枪，我们将净化突变体、异族和异端。凭借帝皇的恩赐，我们将对污染者的憎恨传达出去。"

entries.en: Gleaming at her grip, Aveline's Thorn of the White Rose is a symbol of sacrifice, every swing a flaming reminder for her sisters to hold the line no matter the darkness they face.
entries.zh: 在她的握持下闪耀，艾维琳的白玫瑰之刺是牺牲的象征，每一次挥舞都是燃烧的提醒，让她的姐妹们无论面对何种黑暗都要坚守阵线。

entries.en: Once an ambitious and glory-seeking warrior, Aveline's path of trials and sacrifice have made her a deadly, persevering hero capable of bringing down even the most towering foes.
entries.zh: 曾经是一位雄心勃勃、寻求荣耀的战士，艾维琳的试炼和牺牲之道使她成为了一位致命的、坚韧的英雄，能够击败即使是最高大的敌人。

entries.en: Created to aid the Emperor's servants, these flying cybernetic bio-constructs assist scribe and soldier alike, relaying targeting data and carrying spare ammunition to the frontline.
entries.zh: 为了帮助帝皇的仆人，这些飞行的生物机械构造体协助书记和士兵，传递目标数据并将备用弹药运送到前线。

entries.en: When the Sisters of the Sacred Rose march to war, they do so in a state of holy grace, their hymns of salvation underscored by the crack of bolts and the roar of burning promethium.
entries.zh: 当圣洛瑟修女会出征时，她们处于神圣的恩典状态，她们的救赎赞美诗伴随着螺栓的爆裂声和普罗米修斯燃烧的咆哮。

entries.en: Faith and zealotry are weapons as potent as any blade or firearm. Ministorum Priests embody this truth, bellowing martial canticles to inspire allies and terrify foes.
entries.zh: 信仰和狂热是和任何刀剑或火器一样强大的武器。国教牧师体现了这个真理，他们大声吟唱战歌以激励盟友和恐吓敌人。

entries.en: Rhinos are the mainstay transport of the Adepta Sororitas. Blessed by Enginseers and Ministorum Priests before battle, they are durable, robust, and rarely break down.
entries.zh: 犀牛战车是修女会的主要运输工具。在战斗前被机械先知和国教牧师祝福，它们坚固、稳健，很少出故障。

entries.en: Leading squads of Zephyrim, Zephyrim Superiors are divine destroyers, figures of fathomless passion and integrity whose angelic singing drowns out the screams of the dying.
entries.zh: 领导风天使队伍的风天使队长是神圣的毁灭者，他们是无法测量的激情和正直的象征，他们的天使般的歌声淹没了垂死的尖叫。

entries.en: Soaring across the skies like a heavenly messenger, Adelaide sets alight the flame of conviction of her sisters at the break of their resolve, bursting into battle in sparking wrath.
entries.zh: 像天使的使者一样翱翔在天空中，阿德莱德在她的姐妹们的决心破裂时点燃信念的火焰，怒火中燃烧，冲入战斗。

entries.en: Castigators provide excellent fire support thanks to their wide array of weapons, smashing through enemy lines and slaughtering great swathes of enemy infantry in a matter of seconds.
entries.zh: 惩戒者战车提供了出色的火力支援，感谢他们的广泛武器，冲破敌人的阵线，在几秒钟内屠杀大片的敌人步兵。

entries.en: Even when one of their number falls, the Adepta Sororitas know that this too is part of the Emperor’s plan. A single martyr can spark a fire in a thousand souls.
entries.zh: 即使他们中的一个人倒下，修女会也知道这也是帝皇的计划的一部分。一个烈士可以在千万灵魂中点燃火焰。

entries.en: The Adepta Sororitas go to battle clad in impenetrable conviction and armed with righteous fury. Suffering is their prayer; Faith is their armor.
entries.zh: 修女会穿着坚不可摧的信念和充满正义的愤怒去战斗。苦难是他们的祈祷；信仰是他们的盔甲。

entries.en: None may escape the Emperor’s gaze, and where he sees wickedness, there will the Sacred Rose punish.
entries.zh: 无人能逃脱帝皇的注视，他在哪里看到邪恶，圣玫瑰就会在那里进行惩罚。

entries.en: Chaplain Letharius takes to the field on a Raider-pattern bike, urging his brothers to victory as he bellows his catechisms and charges headlong into the foe.
entries.zh: 牧师莱萨瑞斯骑着掠袭者战机冲上战场，高声吟诵教义，带领他的兄弟们冲向胜利，直面敌人。

entries.en: Fast-moving recon and disruption units, Scout Bike Squads operate far beyond friendly lines. They lay traps on neutral ground and seek out weaknesses in enemy defences.
entries.zh: 快速移动的侦查和破坏单位，侦查摩托小队在友军防线之外行动。他们在中立地带布设陷阱，寻找敌人防御的弱点。

entries.en: Outrider Squads conduct lightning-fast hit-and-run attacks on defended positions, and run down those who would try to escape the vengeance of the Chapter.
entries.zh: 先遣者小队对防守阵地进行闪电般的打击和撤退攻击，并追击那些试图逃脱战团复仇的人。

entries.en: Techmarines soothe the machine spirits of wounded war engines using their servo-arms and mechadendrites to warp damaged armour plates back into shape and repair burnt-out cabling.
entries.zh: 科技战士使用伺服臂和机械触须安抚受伤战机的机魂，将受损的装甲板恢复原状，修复烧毁的电缆。

entries.en: Land Speeders excel at scouting and counter-reconnaissance operations, using the high maneuverability offered by their grav-drives to spot the enemy and call in devastating strikes.
entries.zh: 兰德速攻艇擅长侦查和反侦查行动，利用重力驱动的高机动性发现敌人并呼叫毁灭性的攻击。

entries.en: Piloted by veteran warriors and outfitted with silent reactors and servos, Invictor Warsuits excel at supporting vanguard operations and protecting their battle-brothers.
entries.zh: 由老兵驾驶并配备沉默反应堆和伺服装置，英勇机甲在支援先锋行动和保护战斗修士方面表现出色。

entries.en: Heavily armed with a gatling cannon and a twin heavy stubber, the Hailstrike can annihilate entire swathes of infantry in fusillades of blistering projectiles.
entries.zh: 装备有加特林机炮和双重重型机枪，暴风打击能在炽热的弹幕中消灭整片步兵。

entries.en: Predator Annihilators excel at leading armoured spearheads, moving at high speed and firing all the while, blowing apart enemy armoured columns and dense bunker complexes.
entries.zh: 歼灭者型掠食者坦克擅长领导装甲突击，快速移动并持续开火，摧毁敌人的装甲纵队和密集的碉堡群。

entries.en: In battle, Space Marines swear mighty oaths to destroy the enemies of the Emperor and uphold the honour of their Chapter, and such vows are sacrosanct.
entries.zh: 在战斗中，星际战士发誓要摧毁帝皇的敌人，维护战团的荣誉，这些誓言是神圣不可侵犯的。

entries.en: The Space Marines are a highly flexible fighting force, able to swiftly augment their deadly infantry with rugged armoured transports whenever duty calls.
entries.zh: 星际战士是一支高度灵活的战斗力量，能够在职责召唤时迅速用坚固的装甲运输车增强他们致命的步兵。

entries.en: Ultramarines often rely on massed armoured formations during large offensives. Heavy tanks provide fire support while armoured transports relocate infantry across the battlefield.
entries.zh: 极限战士在大规模进攻中经常依靠大量装甲编队。重型坦克提供火力支援，而装甲运输车将步兵转移到战场各处。

entries.en: The Chaplain bellows his fury at the enemy, urging his brothers to surge forward and strike the enemy down with a relentless storm of precise firepower.
entries.zh: 牧师对敌人怒吼，激励他的兄弟们向前冲锋，用精准的火力风暴击倒敌人。

entries.en: A once powerful Overlord, Ramatekh woke from the great sleep with his psyche rent, his ruthless nature wholly focused on driving all living creatures into oblivion.
entries.zh: 曾经强大的霸主拉玛特克从大休眠中醒来，精神破碎，他的冷酷本性完全专注于将所有生物驱逐至虚无。

entries.en: Even lesser Necron constructs benefit from the technology known as living metal – a semi-sentient substance that can alter its molecular state to heal damage as fast as it is inflicted.
entries.zh: 即使是较低级的太空死灵构造体也受益于被称为活体金属的技术——一种半有意识的物质，可以改变其分子状态，以与受损速度相同的速度愈合损伤。

entries.en: Dynastic legions avoid these cursed beings, whose madness they fear catching, yet they can do little to stop Flayed Ones from being drawn to the scent of bloodshed.
entries.zh: 王朝军团避开这些被诅咒的存在，害怕感染他们的疯狂，但他们几乎无法阻止剥皮者被血腥气味吸引。

entries.en: Lokhust Destroyers rely on mobility and firepower to annihilate any life they encounter. Their repulsor-sled bodies allow them to fire on the move without reduction in efficiency.
entries.zh: 洛克哈斯特毁灭者依靠机动性和火力摧毁他们遇到的任何生命。他们的反击者坦克身体使他们能够在移动中射击而不降低效率。

entries.en: These hunchbacked monsters burst from their dimensional oubliettes to unleash inescapable hails of enmitic fire leaving no escape to their prey.
entries.zh: 这些驼背怪物从他们的维度地牢中爆发出来，释放出无可逃避的敌火雨，使猎物无处可逃。

entries.en: Most Necron legions are built around a core of phalanx upon phalanx of infantry. Neurally stunted and grindingly obedient, they are spent freely by their uncaring masters.
entries.zh: 大多数太空死灵军团围绕着一层又一层的步兵山阵构建。神经受损且极度服从，他们被冷漠的主人毫不吝惜地消耗。

entries.en: Lokhust Lords skim into battle driven by nihilistic hatred. Should they be wounded, nanoscarab amulets spill out a silver tide of mites to repair their rent forms.
entries.zh: 野狼领主在虚无的仇恨驱使下滑入战斗。如果他们受伤，纳米甲虫护身符会释放出银色潮汐般的螨虫来修复他们破损的身体。

entries.en: Slow-moving but deadly, Annihilation Barges serve as anti-infantry fire support platforms, and are often deployed to watch over important strategic locations.
entries.zh: 移动缓慢但致命，毁灭艇作为反步兵火力支援平台，常被部署在重要战略地点进行监视。

entries.en: As the tomb’s warriors pass through a dimensional corridor, the passage’s surface is lit with data-glyphs providing hyperlogical tactical information for the upcoming battle.
entries.zh: 当陵墓的战士们穿过维度走廊时，通道表面会亮起数据符文，为即将到来的战斗提供超逻辑战术信息。

entries.en: The Necrons have slept for sixty million years, if the Aeldari Book of Mournful Night is to be believed. Now they are waking at last, rising up to take back what once was theirs.
entries.zh: 如果相信艾达灵族的《哀夜之书》，太空死灵已经沉睡了六千万年。现在他们终于醒来，崛起以夺回曾经属于他们的东西。

entries.en: Necron nobles make no secret of the fact that they consider the vehicles of their capacious armouries to be more precious than the Necrons who pilot them.
entries.zh: 太空死灵贵族毫不掩饰他们认为宽敞军械库中的载具比驾驶它们的太空死灵更为珍贵的事实。

entries.en: Destroyers can have their corrupted engrammatic patterns reinjected into themselves to further degrade their former personalities and fuel their nihilistic butchery.
entries.zh: 毁灭者可以将其腐化的记忆模式重新注入自身，以进一步削弱其原有个性，并助长其虚无主义的屠杀。

entries.en: The ultimate military leader of the Grizzlepit Convicts, Saffa Rhiannor has spent years preparing for the day she leads the cult into the open and takes over Damnathor V.
entries.zh: 格里兹尔坑囚犯的终极军事领袖萨法·瑞安诺尔花了多年时间准备，等待那一天她将带领教派公开行动并接管达玛索五号。

entries.en: As Magus of the Grizzlepit Convicts, Uthrel Naas represents a living promise of salvation to the forlorn convicts that cram the mining pits of Damnathor V.
entries.zh: 作为格里兹尔坑囚犯的教团教主，乌瑟尔·纳斯是达玛索五号矿坑中绝望囚犯们的活生生的救赎希望。

entries.en: The strongest and most intelligent of the Grizzlepit’s Acolyte Hybrids, Vorenth earned the honour to bear the sacred wyrm-form banner into battle on the day of the cult's ascension.
entries.zh: 格里兹尔坑最强大和最聪明的混血侍僧沃伦斯获得了荣誉，在教派升天之日，携带神圣的巨龙形态旗帜进入战斗。

entries.en: Should a Patriarch or Magus dominate a region completely, the psychic shadow around them will grow darker and thicker until it hardens into a many-limbed form known as a familiar.
entries.zh: 如果虫群族长或教团教主完全统治一个地区，周围的心灵阴影会变得越来越黑暗和浓厚，直到凝固成一种多肢形态，称为熟悉者。

entries.en: Neophytes are the dedicated and fanatically loyal foot soldiers of their cult, born of the brood cycle’s third and fourth generations.
entries.zh: 新进者是他们教派的忠诚且狂热的步兵，出生于巢穴周期的第三和第四代。

entries.en: Some cultists risk their lives to deploy explosives in key spots of enemy infrastructure. Triggered remotely or by enemy activity, they bring death and freedom in equal parts.
entries.zh: 一些教徒冒着生命危险在敌方基础设施的关键位置部署炸药。通过远程或敌方活动引爆，它们带来死亡和自由。

entries.en: Neophyte hybrids are the least alien in appearance of their brood. What they lack in weaponised bio-adaptations they make up for in numbers, firepower and revolutionary fanaticism.
entries.zh: 新血教徒是巢穴中外貌最不异类的成员。他们在武器化生物适应性上的不足，通过数量、火力和革命狂热来弥补。

entries.en: When the cult signals their attack, Neophytes swarm from sewers, catacombs and shadowy barracks, overwhelming their enemies and seizing control of entire planets within hours.
entries.zh: 当教派发出攻击信号时，新进者从下水道、墓穴和阴暗的兵营中蜂拥而出，压倒敌人，在数小时内控制整个星球。

entries.en: These merciless xenotainted specialists trigger concealed explosives or lead death-or-glory strikes into the heart of the foe.
entries.zh: 这些无情的异类专家引爆隐藏的炸药或带领决死攻击深入敌人心脏。

entries.en: Acolyte Hybrids crawl up to the surface firing off volleys of pistol fire, before descending on the enemy in a riot of claws.
entries.zh: 混血侍僧爬上地面，发射一连串的手枪火力，然后在一片爪子的混乱中扑向敌人。

entries.en: The twisted experiments of Grizzlepit Biophaguses led to noticeable improvements in mining output, leading the authorities of Damnathor V to unwittingly provide increasing numbers of test subjects.
entries.zh: 格里泽尔皮特生化师的扭曲的实验显著提高了采矿产量，导致达玛索五世的当局无意中提供了越来越多的测试对象。

entries.en: An unassuming bodyguard, the Locus may be overlooked by the foe until the exact moment it abandons calm stillness for lightning-fast attack.
entries.zh: 一个不起眼的保镖，基卫可能会被敌人忽视，直到它从平静的静止状态突然转变为闪电般的攻击。

entries.en: The bulkier third-generation brothers and sisters heft the heaviest weaponry, often comprised of stolen military or mining equipment.
entries.zh: 体型更大的第三代兄弟姐妹们携带最重的武器，通常是被盗的军事或采矿设备。

entries.en: Each cult has its own variant of the coiling glyph known as the wyrm-form. The icon’s effect upon its faithful is electrifying, calling them into battle from the shadows they dwell.
entries.zh: 每个教派都有自己的巨龙形态盘绕符号变体。这个图标对信徒的影响是电击般的，召唤他们从阴影中进入战斗。

entries.en: On the bloody day of uprising, the Neophyte Hybrids prove themselves as they establish their combat roles, the most capable amongst them naturally assuming command.
entries.zh: 在起义的血腥日子里，新血教徒通过确立他们的战斗角色来证明自己，其中最有能力的人自然会担任指挥官。

entries.en: Acolyte squads are often lead by the most cunning of their kin, who loyally enact the imperatives of their Patriarch and ignite unity and zeal among the their broodbrothers.
entries.zh: 侍仆小队通常由他们亲族中最狡猾的人领导，他们忠实地执行族长的命令，并在他们的巢穴兄弟中点燃团结和热情。

entries.en: Acolytes are imbued with an echo of their Human parents’ consciousness, granting them an instinctive comprehension of Imperial technologies that aids them in their operations.
entries.zh: 侍仆们继承了他们人类父母意识的回声，赋予他们对帝国技术的本能理解，帮助他们进行操作。

entries.en: Possessed of hulking strength and the skill to manipulate complex mechanisms, Acolyte Hybrids often bear repurposed industrial tools as deadly close-quarters weapons in battle.
entries.zh: 附魔战士拥有巨大的力量和操控复杂机械的技能，混血侍僧在战斗中经常携带改装的工业工具作为致命的近战武器。

entries.en: Triggered by the approach of a hive fleet or a sudden trauma to the cult, Hybrid Metamorphs mutate, bestowing weaponised limbs and turning into devastating shock troops for the cult.
entries.zh: 受到虫巢舰队接近或教派突然创伤的触发，混合变形体会发生突变，赋予武器化的肢体，成为教派的毁灭性突击军队。

entries.en: Nexos can absorb cultists’ thoughts and experiences through physical contact, building a formidable mental map and using it to direct cult forces with prodigious skill.
entries.zh: 指挥使可以通过身体接触吸收教徒的思想和经验，构建出强大的心灵地图，并用其卓越的技能指挥教派力量。

entries.en: Vanguard organisms for the Tyranid hive fleets, Purestrain Genestealers combine the cunning of an apex predator with inhuman speed and agility, tearing their victims to bloody tatters.
entries.zh: 作为泰伦虫族虫巢舰队的先锋生物，纯种基因窃取者结合了顶级掠食者的狡猾与非人类的速度和敏捷，将受害者撕成血淋淋的碎片。

entries.en: These lumpen gene-deviants possess immense strength and resilience coupled with simplistic loyalty to the cult, often hurled into battle as line breakers or hulking bodyguards.
entries.zh: 这些笨重的基因变异体拥有巨大的力量和韧性，并对教派有着简单的忠诚，常被投入战斗作为破线者或庞大的保镖。

entries.en: Vox-hacker and information assassin supreme, the Clamavus scythes into enemy communications networks and plunders them for intelligence.
entries.zh: 作为顶级的通讯黑客和信息刺客，传教使切入敌方通讯网络并掠夺情报。

entries.en: This one-man all-terrain bipedal vehicle issued by the Astra Militarum is able to patrol rough terrain, and is often overtaken by cultist insurgents raising in storming rebellion.
entries.zh: 这种由星界军配发的单人全地形双足载具能够巡逻崎岖地形，常被教徒叛乱分子夺取并在暴风般的叛乱中使用。

entries.en: In a storm of iron-hard claws, sinewy tentacles and slashing talons, these Metamorphs serve as an inspiration to the broodkin that worship them as sainted heroes of the cult.
entries.zh: 在铁硬的爪子、肌肉发达的触手和锋利的利爪风暴中，这些变形体成为巢族的灵感来源，被崇拜为教派的圣英雄。

entries.en: A Sanctus is an inescapable assassin who can squirm through the smallest gaps. Once in position, it is only a matter of time before death is delivered to its prey.
entries.zh: 圣裁者是一个无可逃脱的刺客，能够从最小的缝隙中钻过。一旦就位，猎物的死亡只是时间问题。

entries.en: Besides the heavy power weapons wielded by most Aberrants, Hypermorphs are also blessed with a chithinous tail that whips and pierces the foe with striking speed.
entries.zh: 除了大多数畸变体使用的重型能量武器外，超变体还拥有一条甲壳尾巴，以惊人的速度鞭打和刺穿敌人。

entries.en: These light but rugged scout vehicles serve as the eyes and ears of the uprising, coordinating lethal ambushes that eliminate isolated foes or sever communication and supply lines.
entries.zh: 这些轻便但坚固的侦察载具作为起义的眼睛和耳朵，协调致命的伏击，消灭孤立的敌人或切断通讯和补给线。

entries.en: These lumbering beasts are dispatched ahead to make a bloody example of those who prove to be an obstacle to the cult.
entries.zh: 这些笨重的野兽被派遣到前线，以血腥的方式对那些阻碍教派的人进行示范。

entries.en: The occurrence of Hybrid Metamorphs is seen by many broodkin as a great blessing. Many believe that by joining them they will gain favour with the Star Children.
entries.zh: 混合变形体的出现被许多巢族视为巨大的祝福。许多人相信，通过加入他们，他们将获得星辰之子的青睐。

entries.en: Flitting through the shadows, Reductus Saboteurs lace the battlefield with booby traps and deploy powerful explosives that lay low the engines of war from the oppresors.
entries.zh: 潜伏破坏者在阴影中穿梭，在战场上布满陷阱，并部署强大的炸药，摧毁压迫者的战争机器。

entries.en: Born from the sting of a mindwyrm familiar, the Abominant is an Aberrant tainted with the Patriarch’s own gene-mass, transforming it into a mountain of mutated chitin and muscle.
entries.zh: 畸变主宰由心灵虫的刺咬而生，是一种被族长基因污染的畸变体，变成了一座变异的甲壳和肌肉山。

entries.en: Robust and versatile, the Goliath Truck is the armoured transport of choice for the Genestealer Cults, able to lay down a hail of supporting fire as the troops disembark into battle.
entries.zh: 坚固且多功能，歌利亚装甲车是基因窃取者教团的首选装甲运输工具，能够在军队下车进入战斗时提供密集的支援火力。

entries.en: Whip-fast reactions and hypersensory acuity lend the Kelermorph lethal reaction speeds and help it unleash withering volleys from its iconic liberator autostubs.
entries.zh: 迅捷的反应和超感官的敏锐使凯勒摩夫拥有致命的反应速度，并帮助它用标志性的解放者自动手枪发射毁灭性的齐射。

entries.en: A Benefictus uses the swollen mass of their brain to focus the will of the Broodmind, which they unleash in a lancing beam of incredible power.
entries.zh: 贝尼菲克图斯利用他们肿胀的大脑集中群体意志，并释放出一束极其强大的光束。

entries.en: This mining engine is designed for gouging tunnels into solid rock faces in search of minerals. However, it works just as well as an ablative shield or a bloody linebreaking weapon.
entries.zh: 这种采矿引擎设计用于在坚固的岩壁中挖掘隧道寻找矿物。然而，它同样适合作为消耗性盾牌或血腥的破线武器。

entries.en: Psychic abomination; alpha predator; parasitic demigod – the Patriarch is all of these things and worse, and the source of the bio-corruption that spawns each Genestealer Cult cell.
entries.zh: 心灵畸变体；顶级掠食者；寄生半神——族长是所有这些东西的集合体，更是每个基因窃取者教团细胞生物腐败的源头。

entries.en: Being the core battle tank of the Astra Militarum, Leman Russ Battle Tanks are often a primary target of sabotage missions and grand larceny operations alike.
entries.zh: 作为星界军的核心战斗坦克，黎曼鲁斯战斗坦克经常成为破坏任务和大型盗窃行动的主要目标。

entries.en: Genestealer Cults keep their fighting strength carefully hidden from their oppressors. When the day of ascension comes, the long-hidden Cult reveals its subterfuge and rises to attack.
entries.zh: 基因窃取者教团小心翼翼地隐藏他们的战斗力量，避免被压迫者发现。当升天之日到来时，长期隐藏的教团揭示其阴谋并发动攻击。

entries.en: The cultists infesting the myriad Imperial worlds know well that secrecy can be made into a decisive weapon of war.
entries.zh: 感染无数帝国世界的教徒们深知，保密可以成为决定性的战争武器。

entries.en: Cult forces circumnavigate the enemy via crawl-ways or abandoned service tunnels, before bursting forth in sudden ambush.
entries.zh: 教团部队通过爬行通道或废弃的服务隧道绕过敌人，然后突然发动伏击。

entries.en: When the cult throws off its cloak, those infiltrated in the defender's ranks waste no time in spilling the blood of their once comrades, now unfaithful opressors to be removed.
entries.zh: 当教团揭开伪装时，渗透到防御者队伍中的成员毫不犹豫地流下曾经战友的血，他们现在是要被清除的不忠压迫者。

entries.en: The first hints of Genestealer Cult infestation may come from inexplicable disappearances, thefts of equipment, or the appearance of sinister graffiti praising the Star Children.
entries.zh: 基因窃取者教团感染的最初迹象可能来自于无法解释的失踪、设备被盗或出现赞美星辰之子的邪恶涂鸦。

entries.en: In their hidden lairs, Biophaguses trial new bio-alchemical solutions in an attempt to bring out the latent alien power within the brood.
entries.zh: 在他们隐藏的巢穴中，生化师们试验新的生物化学解决方案，试图激发巢穴内潜在的异形力量。

entries.en: The most xeno-mutant members of the cult take a grim satisfaction in their ability to shrug off horrific damage, as a way to prove their worth and zeal to the Star Children.
entries.zh: 教团中最异形突变的成员对他们能够抵御可怕伤害感到阴暗的满足，这是他们向星辰之子证明自己价值和狂热的方式。

entries.en: Wielding hefty industrial saws and drills, sufficiently determined broodkin can carve their way through the toughest enemy defence lines.
entries.zh: 手持沉重的工业锯和钻头，足够坚定的巢族可以切开最坚固的敌人防线。

entries.en: Through genetic alchemy, skilled Biophaguses can tease out favourable mutations without triggering any undesirable degradations, rendering their subjects increasingly deadly.
entries.zh: 通过基因炼金术，熟练的生化师可以引出有利的突变而不触发任何不良退化，使他们的实验对象变得越来越致命。

entries.en: On the day of ascencion, each Magus becomes a focal point for cult forces, a potent battle psyker who can drive their brothers and sisters into frenzied violence.
entries.zh: 在升天之日，每个教团教主都成为教团力量的焦点，一个强大的战斗灵能者，能够驱使他们的兄弟姐妹进入狂热的暴力状态。

entries.en: No matter how large a Genestealer Cult grows, it is typically dominated by a single Patriarch via the synaptic link known as the Broodmind.
entries.zh: 无论基因窃取者教团发展到多大，通常都由一个通过突触链接称为巢穴心智的族长主导。

entries.en: The convicts of Damnathor V proved to be an excellent vector for the Curse. Their desire for liberation after decades of forced labour has paved the way for the cult to spread.
entries.zh: 达玛瑟五号的囚犯们证明是诅咒的绝佳载体。他们在数十年强迫劳动后的解放欲望为教团的传播铺平了道路。

entries.en: During a cult’s gestation, the Magus wages a war of honeyed words and psychic domination. An audience with a Magus can turn almost any human into a valuable agent of the cult.
entries.zh: 在教团的孕育期间，教团教主进行甜言蜜语和灵能控制的战争。与教团教主的一次会面几乎可以将任何人类变成教团的宝贵代理人。

entries.en: Those who are blessed with the blood of the Starborn will stand victorious beneath the sigils of the cult once the last shot is fired and the last body falls.
entries.zh: 那些被星降者之血祝福的人将在最后一枪射出、最后一具尸体倒下后，在教团的印章下站立胜利。

entries.en: Multitudes emerge in secret from dorms and the crannies of the merciless pits. Minutes before the revolt, the cult gathers for a final prayer, for the Day of Ascension has come.
entries.zh: 成群结队的人从宿舍和无情深坑的缝隙中秘密出现。在起义前的几分钟，教团聚集进行最后的祈祷，因为升天之日已经到来。

entries.en: Thanks to a mixture of cunning, instinct and guerrilla fieldcraft, the brood bursts from cover without the slightest warning, giving no time for their foes to register their peril.
entries.zh: 凭借狡猾、本能和游击战术的混合，巢族从掩护中突然爆发，毫无预警地让敌人措手不及。

entries.en: From duct-tangles and sewage pipes to subterranean mineworks and sappers’ runs, the Genestealer Cults employ all imaginable types of hidden ways to better ambush their foes.
entries.zh: 从管道缠结和污水管道到地下矿井和工兵通道，基因窃取者教团利用所有可以想象的隐藏方式更好地伏击敌人。

entries.en: Even as battle rages, reinforcements slip from the shadows or spill up from the dark places below, called to war by the Broodmind.
entries.zh: 即使在战斗激烈时，增援部队也会从阴影中溜出或从地下黑暗处涌出，被巢穴心智召唤参战。

entries.en: Through extending the tendrils of the Broodmind into the psyche of the enemy, Genestealer Cults win allies to their cause, infecting them with the genecurse of the cult.
entries.zh: 通过将巢穴心智的触须延伸到敌人的心灵中，基因窃取者教团赢得盟友，使他们感染上教团的基因诅咒。

entries.en: The cults project a psychic signal that not even the faithful are aware of. As their synaptic Broodmind grows, it becomes a glimmering beacon that the Tyranid hive ships home in on.
entries.zh: 教派发出一种连忠实信徒都未察觉的心灵信号。随着他们的突变心灵网络壮大，它成为泰伦虫族巢都飞船的闪亮灯塔。

entries.en: On the Day of Ascension the broodkin strike at multiple targets with uncanny cohesion. Detonations rock the population centres and transport arteries, hindering the shocked defenders.
entries.zh: 在飞升之日，巢族以惊人的协调性攻击多个目标。爆炸震撼了人口中心和交通动脉，阻碍了震惊的防御者。

entries.en: The mayhem of belligerence can cause mine tunnels to collapse, closing some pathways whilst opening new ones, which only the most attentive commanders can use to their advantage.
entries.zh: 好斗的混乱可能导致矿井隧道坍塌，封闭一些通道，同时打开新的路径，只有最细心的指挥官才能利用这些优势。

entries.en: The wreckage of battle can cause sump containments to collapse and flood subterranean halls, hampering the deployment and positioning of troops fighting underground.
entries.zh: 战斗的残骸可能导致污水池坍塌，淹没地下大厅，阻碍在地下作战的军队的部署和定位。

entries.en: The ducts and pipelines of the mines in Damnathor V are filled with toxic chemicals. Hazardous leaks are one of the many travails of mining crews in this penal colony.
entries.zh: 达玛索尔五号矿井的管道和管线充满了有毒化学品。危险的泄漏是这个惩教殖民地采矿队面临的众多困境之一。

entries.en: Echoing through dank caverns, the cult followers worship the Patriarch and the Star Children, gathering around alien idols of iron, flesh and bone.
entries.zh: 在潮湿的洞穴中回响，教派追随者崇拜虫群族长和星辰之子，聚集在铁、肉和骨头制成的异形偶像周围。

entries.en: Wild-eyed hordes of cult warriors dwell in the sewers, mine workings and rusted ducts, waylaying their oblivious victims.
entries.zh: 目光狂野的教派战士群居在下水道、矿井和生锈的管道中，伏击毫无防备的受害者。

entries.en: Breaking the enemy supply chains will bring the unbelievers down to their knees. Break their engines of war, sever their bridges and topple their fanes.
entries.zh: 切断敌人的补给链会让不信者跪地求饶。摧毁他们的战争机器，切断他们的桥梁，推翻他们的神殿。

entries.en: The Primus is a Genestealer Cult’s ultimate military commander. Their mastery of insurgent tactics transforms their followers from a rebellious mob into a lethal military machine.
entries.zh: 领军是基因窃取者教团的终极军事指挥官。他们对叛乱战术的精通将追随者从叛乱暴群转变为致命的军事机器。

entries.en: The prophetic leader guides the cult to new heights of victory as the Patriarch’s mind-altering influence spreads further over the host populace.
entries.zh: 预言领袖引导教派走向新的胜利高峰，随着虫群族长的心灵影响力进一步扩展到宿主人口中。

entries.en: It is a great honour to bear the cult’s sigil aloft for all to see. Its presence upon nearby cult warriors is electrifying, driving them to new heights of violence.
entries.zh: 举起教派的印章是极大的荣誉。它的存在使附近的教派战士充满电力，激发他们达到新的暴力高度。

entries.en: When the day of ascension comes, Patriarchs become the cult’s deadliest killer, prowling the shadows of embattled worlds to rip and slay.
entries.zh: 当升天之日来临时，虫群族长成为教派最致命的杀手，潜行在战火纷飞的世界阴影中撕裂和杀戮。

entries.en: Skilled cult agents spread disinformation and demoralising propaganda, invading the very minds of enemy personnel, rendering them puppets to the cult and recruiting new followers.
entries.zh: 熟练的教派特工传播虚假信息和令人沮丧的宣传，侵入敌方人员的思想，使他们成为教派的傀儡并招募新追随者。

entries.en: Military communications are essential to combat operations' efficiency. One broken link opens the gates for miscommunication, chaos and tactical blunders.
entries.zh: 军事通信对作战行动的效率至关重要。一个断开的链条就会打开误传、混乱和战术失误的大门。

entries.en: Devious contaminants infect their victims with xenos genetics, rendering them ill and susceptible to the sinister influence of the cult.
entries.zh: 狡猾的污染物用异形基因感染受害者，使他们生病并易受教派的邪恶影响。

entries.en: Fashioned from munition crates and fuel barrels, makeshift blockades are often assembled at seemingly random spots, later proving highly disruptive to enemy reinforcement manoeuvres.
entries.zh: 由弹药箱和燃料桶制成的临时路障通常在看似随机的地点组装，后来证明对敌军增援行动极具破坏性。

entries.en: The innovative methods of the Biophaguses extend the reach of the cult far and wide. They infect their subjects with xenos genetics, morphing their body and mind.
entries.zh: 生物学者的创新方法将教派的影响力扩展得更远更广。他们用异形基因感染受试者，改变他们的身体和思想。

entries.en: Clamavuses are masterful agents of misinformation who use their vox-interceptor arrays to hack into enemy communications networks, stealing vital intelligence.
entries.zh: 音波拦截者是误导信息的高手，他们使用音波拦截器阵列入侵敌方通信网络，窃取重要情报。

entries.en: Lhaska Szenari is a revered Jackal Alphus with the endurance to travel on her dirtcycle for days, gathering vital information and setting up deadly, war-changing shots.
entries.zh: Lhaska Szenari是一位备受尊崇的豺狼猎首，她有着在她的越野摩托上行驶数日的耐力，收集重要信息并布置致命的，能改变战局的射击。

entries.en: These fourth-generation hybrids roar through tunnels and dusty plains to gather intelligence on trade routes, military outposts, resource deposits and the like.
entries.zh: 这些第四代混血儿在隧道和尘土飞扬的平原上咆哮，收集贸易路线、军事哨所、资源储备等情报。

entries.en: Atalan Jackals harass the foe with hit-and-run strikes. They share a mental link that allows them to coordinate in hunting packs and ride in tight formations at high speeds.
entries.zh: 阿塔兰豺狼摩托手以打击和跑的方式骚扰敌人。他们分享一种心灵链接，使他们能够在狩猎群体中协调，并以高速紧密地骑行。

entries.en: Serving their gene-sect as outriders, these packs act as a swift reconnaissance and raiding force, picking off weak or isolated enemy units and harassing the foe’s flanks.
entries.zh: 作为基因窃取者教团的先遣者，这些群体充当迅速的侦察和袭击部队，挑选弱小或孤立的敌人单位，并骚扰敌人的侧翼。

entries.en: Atalan-class vehicles are standard issue work transports on almost every Imperial world. Riding these, the Jackals pose as operatives for mining corporations or aqua prospectors.
entries.zh: 阿塔兰级载具是几乎每个帝国世界的标准工作运输工具。骑着这些，豺狼们冒充采矿公司或水源勘探者的行动人员。

entries.en: Atalan Leaders roam under the blazing suns of the frontier worlds along with their mechanised gangs and fall upon the cult’s enemies like meatstarved scavengers.
entries.zh: 阿塔兰领袖在边疆世界的炽热阳光下漫游，他们的机械化帮派和像肉饿的食腐动物一样袭击教派的敌人。

entries.en: Wolfquads provide heavy support to Atalan Jackals squads, using light prospecting vehicles whose mining lasers and gear are turned from tools of progress into weapons of war.
entries.zh: 阿塔兰野狼四驱车为阿塔兰豺狼摩托手小队提供重型支援，使用轻型勘探载具，其采矿激光和装备从进步的工具变成了战争的武器。

entries.en: A utilitarian vehicle intended for geological surveying and running messages between isolated communities, the Ridgerunner excels in scouting missions for the cult.
entries.zh: 这种用于地质勘查和在孤立社区之间传递信息的实用载具，Ridgerunner在教派的侦查任务中表现出色。

entries.en: As the cult grows, its scions infiltrate the fortified compounds of the Enforcers and Adeptus Arbites to ensure the local authorities continue to overlook the cult’s operations.
entries.zh: 随着教派的增长，其后裔渗透到执行者和法务部的堡垒化复合物中，以确保当地当局继续忽视教派的行动。

entries.en: Through constant harassment tactics, Atalan Jackals can misdirect their enemies’ attention and leave them wide open to attack from an unexpected quarter.
entries.zh: 通过不断的骚扰策略，阿塔兰豺狼摩托手可以转移敌人的注意力，使他们对来自意想不到的一方的攻击毫无防备。

entries.en: Cutting supply lines and reinforcement routes is vital to ensure the insurgence's success. Valuable assets are targeted where possible, sometimes with a spectacular result.
entries.zh: 切断供应线和增援路线对确保叛乱的成功至关重要。有价值的资产在可能的情况下被定为目标，有时会有惊人的结果。

entries.en: The Jackal Alphus rides its dirtcycle to vantage points calling in strike missions with its long-range vox and dispatching any foe beneath the cross hairs of their cult sniper rifle.
entries.zh: 豺狼猎首骑着其越野摩托车到有利地点，用其远程通讯设备呼叫攻击任务，并消灭任何在他们教派狙击步枪十字准星下的敌人。

entries.en: Former Captain of the Ultramarines, Titus was suspected of heresy due to his natural resistance to the Warp. Ultimately exonerated, he now serves the chapter as a Lieutenant.
entries.zh: 曾是极限战士的连长，提图斯因其对亚空间的天然抵抗而被怀疑为异端。最终被证明无罪，他现在作为副官为战团效力。

entries.en: To Titus, combat is as natural as breathing. After countless battles against the foes of humanity, he is as adaptable as he is deadly.
entries.zh: 对于提图斯来说，战斗就像呼吸一样自然。在无数次与人类敌人的战斗后，他既能适应各种情况，又能致命攻击。

entries.en: Often fighting against impossible odds, Titus' fury burns hot as he refuses to fall, even when all seems lost.
entries.zh: 提图斯常常在绝望的情况下战斗，他的愤怒燃烧得如火一般，即使一切看似都已失去，他也拒绝倒下。

entries.en: The tribulations faced in multiple campaigns have now made of Titus what many Astartes consider an inspiring paragon of the virtues of the Ultramarines.
entries.zh: 在多次战役中所经历的磨难，使得许多阿斯塔特认为提图斯已经成为极限战士美德的鼓舞人心的楷模。

entries.en: Trained with many weapons, Titus often wields a Thunder Hammer, discharging vast amounts of disruptive energy and a deafening thunder-like sound upon each impact.
entries.zh: 提图斯接受了多种武器的训练，他常常挥舞雷霆锤，每次撞击都会释放出大量的破坏性能量和震耳欲聋的雷鸣般的声音。

entries.en: Arcadian Leontus is responsible for all Astra Militarum within the Segmentum Solar. He hails from a peerless lineage of service dating back countless generations.
entries.zh: 阿卡迪亚·莱昂图斯负责太阳星域内的所有星界军。他来自一条无与伦比的服务世系，可以追溯到无数代之前。

entries.en: Ursula Creed is her father’s daughter in many respects. A hardened general, physically imposing, Creed stands as a symbol of Cadia’s survival, exemplifying her people’s unbowed spirit.
entries.zh: 乌尔苏拉·克里德在许多方面都是她父亲的女儿。作为一位坚硬的将军，身材魁梧，克里德是卡迪亚生存的象征，体现了她的人民不屈的精神。

entries.en: As feared as he is respected, Commissar Elan Denkler keeps his troops in line with ruthless efficiency, having molded them into a disciplined war machine few other officers can match.
entries.zh: 政委艾兰·登克勒既被人畏惧又被人尊敬，他以无情的效率让他的军队保持纪律，将他们塑造成一台少有的官员可以匹敌的纪律严明的战争机器。

entries.en: Since the Great Rift's opening, the Aurora Illuminato fills Faeburn's skies, which is seen by the Vanquishers as a sign from the Emperor, bringing both nightmares and solace.
entries.zh: 自大裂隙开启以来，奥罗拉·伊卢米纳托充满了费伯恩的天空，这被征服者视为帝皇的信号，带来了噩梦和安慰。

entries.en: The tough combat medics of the Astra Militarum have dragged screaming soldiers back into service time and again, telling them that the Emperor is not ready for them that day.
entries.zh: 星界军的坚韧战斗医生一次又一次地将尖叫的士兵拉回到服务中，告诉他们那天帝皇还没有准备好接纳他们。

entries.en: Diminutive, keen-eyed and instinctively stealthy, the abhuman Ratlings serve the Astra Militarum primarily as outstanding snipers.
entries.zh: 身材娇小，眼光敏锐，本能地潜行，亚人类莱特林主要作为出色的狙击手为星界军服务。

entries.en: The Shock Troops of Cadia have trained their entire lives for military service, and they are held by many as the first and main line of defense of the Astra Militarum.
entries.zh: 卡迪亚的震撼军队为军事服务训练了一生，他们被许多人视为星界军的第一道和主要防线。

entries.en: Squads are often provided with specialist equipment and additional training, including expert vox operators who relay the Company Commander’s orders to the men on the front lines.
entries.zh: 小队经常被提供专业设备和额外训练，包括专家级的无线电操作员，他们将连队指挥官的命令传达给前线的士兵。

entries.en: These gun crews can swiftly set up their mobile heavy weapons to bolster battle lines, providing close fire support with adaptable load-outs of precise or indiscriminate firepower.
entries.zh: 这些枪手能迅速设置他们的移动重武器以增强战线，提供近距离火力支援，使用精确或无差别的火力装备。

entries.en: Heavy infantry regiments are often granted exotic armaments such as flamers or plasma guns, ensuring the regiment’s infantry are always supported by tremendous firepower.
entries.zh: 重步兵团经常被授予如火焰喷射器或等离子枪等异国武器，确保团的步兵总是得到强大的火力支援。

entries.en: Disciplined and professional, the Kasrkin are peerless soldiers, the elite of the elite. These special operatives launch precision strikes against the enemies of the Imperium.
entries.zh: 纪律严明且专业，卡斯尔金是无与伦比的士兵，是精英中的精英。这些特种作战人员对帝国的敌人发动精确打击。

entries.en: These attaché artillery officers feed targeting information to distant ordnance crews, calling upon them to deliver deadly munitions where they are most needed.
entries.zh: 这些附属炮兵官员向远处的炮兵组提供目标信息，呼吁他们在最需要的地方投放致命的弹药。

entries.en: While lacking great intelligence, these abhumans are patiently trained to understand orders. Once their strength and resilience is tamed and directed, they are nigh on unstoppable.
entries.zh: 虽然缺乏高智能，但这些亚人类被耐心训练以理解命令。一旦他们的力量和韧性被驯服和引导，他们几乎是不可阻挡的。

entries.en: The Astra Militarum, for all its extension and decentralised organisation, is built on a rigid hierarchy. A fortified chain of command exists, ensuring every soldier knows their place.
entries.zh: 星界军，尽管其扩展和分散的组织，都建立在严格的等级制度上。存在一个坚固的指挥链，确保每个士兵都知道他们的位置。

entries.en: Minka Lesk was there when Cadia fell – she remains as Cadia Stands, a testament to the indomitable Cadian will. Now a respected captain, she fights on to honour the brave souls lost.
entries.zh: 明卡·莱斯克在卡迪亚倒下时在场 - 她仍然像卡迪亚站立一样，是卡迪亚坚不可摧的意志的见证。现在是一位受人尊敬的连长，她继续战斗以纪念失去的勇者。

entries.en: Psykers in service of the Scholastica Psykana, Astropaths aid the soldiers of the Imperium with their ability to divine the shifting psychic currents amidst the swirl of combat.
entries.zh: 在灵能学会服务的灵能者，星语者用他们在战斗漩涡中洞察变幻莫测的心灵潮流的能力帮助帝国的士兵。

entries.en: Hailing from the steppes of Attila, these horsemasters are potent cavalry troops. Their mobility makes them a powerful force, whether spearheading an attack or outflanking the foe.
entries.zh: 来自阿提拉草原的这些马术大师是强大的骑兵军队。他们的机动性使他们成为一支强大的力量，无论是领导攻击还是包围敌人。

entries.en: Every regiment has a number of standards that are carried in battle by a Command Squad. Each company will have its own standard, embroidered with the names of their fallen heroes.
entries.zh: 每个团都有一些在战斗中由指挥组携带的标准。每个公司都会有自己的标准，上面绣着他们的英雄的名字。

entries.en: Commissars are ruthless officers charged with maintaining the morale, discipline and fighting spirit of their regiment. Their devotion to the Imperium is without doubt.
entries.zh: 政委是无情的军官，负责维护他们团的士气、纪律和战斗精神。他们对帝国的忠诚毫无疑问。

entries.en: Scout Sentinels' lighter armour and gyro-stabilisers assist them in swiftly traversing the roughest terrain, enabling their pilots to survey the enemy with ease.
entries.zh: 侦查哨兵的轻型盔甲和陀螺稳定器帮助他们迅速穿越最艰难的地形，使他们的驾驶员能轻松侦查敌人。

entries.en: Enginseers use arcane lore and cybernetic arrays to effect repairs upon damaged fighting war engines, priceless artefacts of technology whose spirit need only be roused once more.
entries.zh: 机械先知使用神秘的知识和赛博网格来修复受损的战斗机器，这些无价的技术遗物只需要再次唤醒它们的精神。

entries.en: Modified with extra protective panelling, Armoured Sentinels are superb front-line hunters, wielding heavy weapons across terrain too cramped for battle tanks to operate on.
entries.zh: 装甲哨兵经过额外的保护板改装，是出色的前线猎手，他们在战车无法操作的狭窄地形上挥舞重型武器。

entries.en: Amongst the largest man-portable weapons, these guns crewed by ordnance teams fire fire heavy shells and warheads, providing heavy-hitting weapons that can reach across the battlefield.
entries.zh: 这些由炮兵队操作的最大的便携式武器，发射重型炮弹和弹头，提供可以跨越战场的重型武器。

entries.en: The most obstinate of the Ogryn strain of abhumans, Bullgryns are clad in heavy armour and carry crude assault weaponrys, advancing in shield-lines from which shots bounce harmlessly.
entries.zh: Bullgryns是欧格林亚人类中最顽固的一种，他们身穿重甲，携带粗糙的突击武器，从盾牌线前进，子弹无法对他们造成伤害。

entries.en: These battle-trained psykers support the Astra Militarum with eerie foretelling, warding soldiers against the enemy’s witchcraft and unleashing tempests of their own psychic might.
entries.zh: 这些经过战斗训练的灵能者用他们的预言支持星界军，保护士兵免受敌人的巫术攻击，并释放他们自己的心灵风暴。

entries.en: The Taurox is a swift armoured transport with armoured tracks that enable it to cross difficult terrain with ease, exploiting gaps in the enemy lines before deploying its passengers.
entries.zh: 牛头怪是一种快速的装甲运输车，装有装甲轨道，可以轻松穿越困难的地形，利用敌人阵线的空隙，然后部署乘客。

entries.en: Cadian Castellans are authoritative leaders who bear a panoply of armaments and insignia, wielding their weapons as skilfully as they command the soldiers beneath them.
entries.zh: 卡迪亚堡主是权威的领导者，他们携带各种武器和标志，他们的武器使用技巧和指挥下属士兵的能力一样出色。

entries.en: A workhorse armoured troop carrier, the Chimera is a durable and practical tank, employed to ferry infantry into the harshest war zones.
entries.zh: 奇美拉装甲车是一种耐用实用的装甲运输车，用于将步兵运送到最恶劣的战区。

entries.en: The Hydra is an anti-aircraft flak tank equipped with an array of specially adapted autocannons. Once it locks on to enemy aircraft, none can escape its storm of shells.
entries.zh: 九头蛇是一种装备有特别改装的自动炮阵列的防空炮坦克。一旦它锁定敌方飞机，就没有人能逃脱它的炮弹风暴。

entries.en: Nork Deddog’s loyalty and his skills as a bodyguard are beyond question. The hulking Ogryn would rather sustain terrible wounds than permit a single scratch on those he protects.
entries.zh: 诺克·死狗的忠诚和他作为保镖的技能是毋庸置疑的。这个庞大的欧格林宁愿承受可怕的伤害，也不会让他保护的人受到一点划痕。

entries.en: Firing at incredible distance, its limited supply of storm eagle rockets release multiple warheads a moment before each rocket’s impact, leaving no escape to the panicking foe.
entries.zh: 风暴鹰火箭弹在极远的距离发射，每枚火箭弹在撞击前的一刹那释放多个弹头，让惊慌的敌人无处逃脱。

entries.en: Basilisks are self-propelled artillery tanks, armed with a fearsome earthshaker cannon, capable of unleashing relentless shelling at vast distances.
entries.zh: 巴西利斯克是自行炮坦克，装备有可怕的撼地者火炮，能在极远的距离进行无情的炮击。

entries.en: The Leman Russ is the core battle tank of the Imperial Guard, forming the spearhead of countless armoured attacks, capable of facing down almost any battlefield target.
entries.zh: 黎曼鲁斯是帝国卫队的核心战斗坦克，形成无数装甲攻击的先锋，能面对几乎所有的战场目标。

entries.en: Well-armed and heavily armoured, Valkyries are agile carrier-gunships with experienced crews that drop payloads of soldiers both at low-level or high altitudes via grav-chutes.
entries.zh: 女武神是装备精良、防护严密的运输枪舰，经验丰富的机组人员通过重力伞在低空或高空投放士兵。

entries.en: No other battle tank of the Imperial Guard possesses more raw stopping power than the Vanquisher, which offers a long range, first-hit kill ratio second to none in anti-tank weaponry.
entries.zh: 帝国卫队的其他任何战斗坦克都无法比拟征服者的原始阻止力，它提供了远程，首次命中杀伤比例在反坦克武器中无与伦比。

entries.en: Maelon Dhrost is a veteran of over one hundred and fifty gruelling years of war, every one of which has been spent fighting the scourge of Chaos that blights his native soil.
entries.zh: 梅隆·德罗斯特是一个经历了一百五十年艰苦战争的老兵，每一年都在与侵蚀他的土地的混沌的天灾进行战斗。

entries.en: The immense Rogal Dorn Battle Tank is a lumbering behemoth equally suited to anchoring a battle line or grinding forward in support of an assault.
entries.zh: 罗格尔·多恩战车是一种庞大的巨兽，同样适合锚定战线或支持突击。

entries.en: This super-heavy rolling fortress possessed of overwhelming firepower, takes the centre of the battle line to shelter Imperial Guardsmen and even smaller tanks in its lee.
entries.zh: 这种超重型滚动要塞拥有压倒性的火力，占据战线中心，为帝国卫队和更小的坦克提供庇护。

entries.en: Regiments of numerous origins and tactical roles inculcate their soldiers from an early age with the legendary doctrines of the Tactica Imperium.
entries.zh: 来自众多起源和战术角色的团队从小就灌输他们的士兵以《战术帝国》的传奇教条。

entries.en: When necessity arises, mechanised crews rouse their engines, pushing past tolerances to roll forward at speed and outmanoeuvre the foe.
entries.zh: 当需要时，机械化船员唤醒他们的引擎，推动过去的容忍度以高速前进并规避敌人。

entries.en: When need dictates, Imperial Guard soldiers are ordered to move doubletime to close with the enemy or secure an open flank.
entries.zh: 当需要时，帝国卫队士兵被命令以双倍速度接近敌人或保护开放的侧翼。

entries.en: Via area denial bombardments or delayed blast shells, tank crews can paralyse enemy advances, pinning down the swiftest foe.
entries.zh: 通过区域拒绝轰炸或延迟爆炸弹壳，坦克船员可以使敌人的进攻瘫痪，固定下最快的敌人。

entries.en: Many light infantry regiments specialise in stealth and scout tactics, reconnaissance missions and unorthodox warfare, using the environment to their best advantage.
entries.zh: 许多轻步兵团专门从事隐身和侦查战术，侦查任务和非正统战争，最大限度地利用环境。

entries.en: All Cadians – no matter their age, gender or station – must know how to fight, and be capable of facing with unwavering courage all the horrors that proliferate in the 41st Millennium.
entries.zh: 所有卡迪亚人 - 无论年龄，性别或地位 - 都必须知道如何战斗，并有能力以坚定的勇气面对41世纪繁殖的所有恐怖。

entries.en: The brutish ripper guns added to the raw power and muscle of the hulking, abhuman Ogryns lunged upon the enemy result in a shock troop able to deliver devastating charges.
entries.zh: 野蛮的撕裂者枪加上欧格林的原始力量和肌肉，对敌人发动攻击，结果是一支能够发动毁灭性冲锋的冲锋军。

entries.en: Wise Astra Militarum commanders gather talented second officers, advisers, tacticians and front-line strategists to perfect just as many strategic responses as the situation demands.
entries.zh: 明智的星界军指挥官聚集了有才华的二级军官，顾问，战术家和前线战略家，以完善与情况要求一样多的战略反应。

entries.en: With their officer’s clarion call in their ears, soldiers lose all sense of doubt, faith shielding their souls from malevolence and marching at full pace to fire upon their enemy.
entries.zh: 在他们的军官的号角声中，士兵们失去了所有的疑虑，信仰保护他们的灵魂免受恶意，并全速前进以向敌人开火。

entries.en: Attrition often forces fragmented regiments to merge their formations, learning new skills to fight together and continue to wage the Emperor’s wars.
entries.zh: 消耗经常迫使碎片化的团队合并他们的队伍，学习新的技能一起战斗并继续进行帝皇的战争。

entries.en: With the power to summarily execute any soldier or officer found wanting, Commissars are feared, brooding figures that can turn the Guardman's fear into a deadly advantage.
entries.zh: 政委有权立即处决任何被发现不合格的士兵或军官，他们是令人恐惧的，沉思的人物，可以将卫队的恐惧转化为致命的优势。

entries.en: The searing touch of thermal weaponry can flush enemies out of their cover and spread destruction. From handheld to heavy flamers, there is no hiding from the flames.
entries.zh: 热武器的灼热触感可以将敌人从他们的掩体中冲出来并散播破坏。从手持到重型火焰喷射器，无处可藏。

entries.en: Though Cadia fell, the mantra 'Cadia stands' lives on. For Cadia does indeed still stand, as long as a single Cadian soldier continues to fight.
entries.zh: 尽管卡迪亚倒下了，但“卡迪亚站立”的口号仍在继续。只要有一个卡迪亚士兵继续战斗，卡迪亚确实仍然站立。

entries.en: In the face of overwhelming odds, pinpoint shelling from attached artillery tanks and rapid advances by armoured squadrons can turn the tide of battle with crushing results.
entries.zh: 面对压倒性的优势，来自附属炮兵坦克的精确炮击和装甲中队的快速进攻可以以压倒性的结果改变战斗的潮流。

entries.en: Where sheer volume of heavy ordnance is concerned, few can compete with the Astra Militarum. Siege formations shell targets into oblivion as foot soldiers advance to secure victory.
entries.zh: 在重型炮弹的数量上，很少有人可以与星界军竞争。围攻队伍将目标炮击成废墟，步兵前进以确保胜利。

entries.en: The Astra Militarum is the shield of Mankind. Only by its sacrifice and heroism are the worlds of the Imperium kept safe.
entries.zh: 星界军是人类的盾牌。只有通过它的牺牲和英勇，帝国的世界才能保持安全。

entries.en: Mechanised regiments enable more troops to enter the fight even under heavy enemy fire, conditions in which footslogging Imperial Guardsmen would otherwise soon perish.
entries.zh: 机械化团队使更多的军队能够在重型敌火下进入战斗，这是步行的帝国卫队否则很快就会死亡的条件。

entries.en: Soldiers continuing to uphold the lineage of the bastion world yearn to visit destruction on those responsible for the fall of Cadia.
entries.zh: 继续维护堡垒世界血统的士兵渴望对卡迪亚陨落的责任者进行破坏。

entries.en: The sanctioned use of a Deathstrike – designated ‘Ordnance Extremis’ – is often an excessive measure to combat most heinous enemies, a catastrophe delivered from half a world away.
entries.zh: 对死亡打击的批准使用 - 指定为“极端炮弹” - 通常是对抗最邪恶敌人的过度措施，是从半个世界之外传递的灾难。

entries.en: Siege warfare, as practised by the Astra Militarum, is amongst the most dehumanising, miserable and filth-ridden modes of fighting there is.
entries.zh: 由星界军实施的围城战，是最丧失人性，最痛苦，最肮脏的战斗方式之一。

entries.en: A war scholar, polyhistor and martial tactician, the Lord Commander Solar’s razor-sharp intellect and energetic leadership belie his extensive command experience of more than a century.
entries.zh: 作为战争学者，博学者和军事战术家，太阳指挥官领主的敏锐智力和充满活力的领导力掩盖了他超过一个世纪的丰富指挥经验。

entries.en: Ursula has restlessly demanded swift redeployment in the wake of victory after victory, forging her own legend as a strategist of incredible intuition and ruthless determination.
entries.zh: 乌尔苏拉在一次又一次的胜利后，不安地要求迅速重新部署，以其惊人的直觉和无情的决心，铸造了自己作为一名战略家的传奇。

entries.en: Once orders have been given and plans are in motion, Commissar Denkler joins the fight where the battle is thickest, setting an inspirational example for those under his command.
entries.zh: 一旦下达了命令并且计划正在进行中，政委登克勒就会在战斗最激烈的地方加入战斗，为他的指挥下的人设立鼓舞人心的榜样。

entries.en: A bodyguard of legendary repute, Nork displays an uncommon level of mental aptitude. In the rare instances when his charge is wounded, allied soldiers may even look to Nork for orders.
entries.zh: 作为享有盛誉的保镖，诺克展现出了不寻常的心智能力。在他的保护对象受伤的罕见情况下，盟军士兵甚至可能会向诺克寻求命令。

entries.en: Unbroken by the fall of her homeworld, Minka Lesk's indomitable faith and the memory of her fallen comrades drive her forward to fight for Cadia no matter the cost.
entries.zh: 明卡·莱斯克对她的家园的陨落未曾屈服，她坚不可摧的信念和对阵亡同志的记忆驱使她无论代价如何都要为卡迪亚战斗。

entries.en: Trained for rapid response, Shock Troopers are deployed to the battlefield at crucial moments, bringing discipline and firepower exactly when and where it’s needed.
entries.zh: 震荡兵接受了快速反应的训练，他们在关键时刻被部署到战场，带来了恰到好处的纪律和火力。

entries.en: To many Astra Militarum officers, the best defence is overwhelming firepower. Enemies raiding Imperial outposts often find themselves gunned down before they can even glimpse the walls.
entries.zh: 对许多星界军官来说，最好的防御是压倒性的火力。敌人经常在他们能看到城墙之前就被枪杀。

entries.en: The Departmento Munitorum is responsible for munitions, supplies, recruitment, training and support, both medical and technical.
entries.zh: 军务部负责弹药，供应，招募，训练和支持，包括医疗和技术。

entries.en: The first light of dawn offers a moment of opportunity. The rising sun blinds the unprepared, giving cunning commanders the perfect moment to advance their troops into position.
entries.zh: 黎明的第一缕阳光提供了一个机会。升起的太阳使未准备好的人失明，给狡猾的指挥官提供了将军队推进到位的完美时刻。

entries.en: The shock of a planetary invasion can leave defenders scrambling, as indiscriminate orbital fire and the chaos of multiple open fronts lead to extreme consequences on any frontline.
entries.zh: 行星入侵的震惊可以让防御者手忙脚乱，因为无差别的轨道火力和多个开放战线的混沌导致任何前线都会产生极端后果。

entries.en: As the demands of war grow, factories roar into overdrive, pushed to their limits to churn out munitions and war machines at an accelerated pace, at the risk of perilous breakdowns.
entries.zh: 随着战争需求的增加，工厂咆哮着进入超负荷运转，被推到极限，以加速产出弹药和战争机器，冒着危险故障的风险。

entries.en: Clad in an intimidating greatcoat, Tempestor Prime Hektor Thenmann is a veteran of countless missions who marshals his elite soldiers into the perfect position for the task at hand.
entries.zh: 身披威吓人心的大衣，暴风主宰赫克托尔·森曼是无数布道所的老兵，他将他的精英士兵调整到完成任务的最佳位置。

entries.en: Deployed by Tempestus Aquilon Squads, these automaton servo-sentries provide additional firepower as the assault is pressed home.
entries.zh: 由忠嗣暴风兵阿奎隆小队部署，这些自动机器人伺服哨兵在攻击进行时提供额外的火力。

entries.en: Fanatically dedicated to the act of following their orders, Tempestus Scions complete missions so dangerous that they would be deemed suicidal for a regular Guardsman.
entries.zh: 忠嗣暴风兵狂热地致力于执行他们的命令，完成的布道所如此危险，以至于对于普通卫兵来说，他们会被认为是自杀。

entries.en: Guided by a Tempestor Sergeant, a full unit of Scions can change the tide of a war with a single strike, gravchuting from the ramps of Valkyries, or bursting from their Taurox Primes.
entries.zh: 在风暴兵军士的指导下，一个完整的暴风裔兵单位可以通过一次攻击，从女武神的坡道上空降，或者从他们的牛头怪首领中爆发出来，改变战争的潮汐。

entries.en: Deployed amidst battle, these Scions are issued medi-packs that contain all the necessary drugs, dressings and surgical tools to get a wounded Tempestus Scion back in the fight.
entries.zh: 在战斗中部署，这些暴风裔兵被发放医疗包，包含所有必要的药物，敷料和手术工具，以使受伤的暴风裔兵重新投入战斗。

entries.en: Hand-picked for their violent nature, Tempestus Aquilons deploy by grav-drop, descending from the skies to land precisely where their destructive firepower is most keenly required.
entries.zh: 由于他们的暴力本性，忠嗣暴风兵阿奎隆被精选出来，通过重力投放部署，从天空降落到他们的破坏火力最为急需的地方。

entries.en: Only the exceptional can stand out among the Tempestus Aquilons. Vitus Gryf has earned such honour, guiding her scions through countless successful counter-xeno operations.
entries.zh: 只有杰出的人才能在风暴水鹰中脱颖而出。维图斯·格里夫就赢得了这样的荣誉，他引导她的子嗣成功地进行了无数次反异形行动。

entries.en: Thick armoured plates, quad track units and a supercharged engine allow the Taurox to go anywhere, hurtling across ruined cities and rubble-strewn wastelands with equal speed.
entries.zh: 厚重的装甲板，四轨单位和超级发动机使牛头怪能够去任何地方，以同样的速度冲过废墟遍布的城市和瓦砾满地的荒地。

entries.en: In the ancient, harsh training camps based on long-established Imperial worlds, the orphaned offspring of the Imperium are transformed into ruthless soldiers and efficient killers.
entries.zh: 在古老的，严酷的训练营中，基于长期建立的帝国世界，帝国的孤儿后代被转化为无情的士兵和高效的杀手。

entries.en: Valkyries possess the speed and armour to deliver the Tempestus Scions where they are needed. Afterwards, they hover over the battlefield raking enemy troops with heavy weapons fire.
entries.zh: 女武神拥有将忠嗣暴风兵送到他们需要的地方的速度和盔甲。之后，他们在战场上徘徊，用重型武器火力扫射敌军。

entries.en: The regiments of the Militarum Tempestus depend upon their Taurox Primes to deliver the fury of the Imperium across all manner of hazardous war zones and almost impossible conditions.
entries.zh: 卫队暴风兵的团队依赖他们的牛头怪首领，将帝国的愤怒传递到所有类型的危险战区和几乎不可能的条件。

entries.en: The Tempestor Prime commands the finest human soldiers in the galaxy. Its ranks boast the elite Scions of the Militarum Tempestus, who launch blistering strikes with ruthless efficiency.
