entries.zh: 暴风主宰指挥着银河系中最优秀的人类士兵。它的队伍拥有卫队暴风兵的精英，他们以无情的效率发动猛烈的攻击。

entries.en: Quick to anger and with a especially vehement hatred of Chaos, even for a Space Marine, Chairon is a relentless warrior who has vowed to avenge his fallen brothers.
entries.zh: 对混沌尤其痛恨，甚至超过一般星际战士的快速愤怒，Chairon是一位无情的战士，他发誓要为他的堕天使兄弟报仇。

entries.en: Clad in thick Gravis armour, Heavy Intercessors are immovable defenders who secure ground and lay down volleys of heavy fire that keep all but the most persistent enemies at bay.
entries.zh: 身穿厚重的重甲，重装仲裁者是不可动摇的防御者，他们确保了地面的安全，并发射了大量的重火力，使所有除最坚持的敌人都保持在远离。

entries.en: Thanks to their heavier Mk X power armour, Eradicators stride unharmed through waves of incoming fire before bringing their own destructive weaponry to bear at close range.
entries.zh: 得益于他们更重的Mk X动力盔甲，根除者在接受大量火力攻击的同时毫发无伤，然后在近距离使用他们自己的破坏性武器。

entries.en: Members of their Chapter’s elite 1st Company of Veterans, these inexorable warriors advance relentlessly with blades held high – the very image of noble knights of myth.
entries.zh: 作为他们战团精英第一连队老兵的成员，这些无法阻挡的战士们高举剑前进，他们就像神话中的贵族骑士一样。

entries.en: These peerless assassins are deadly marksmen who haunt the shadows of the battlefield unseen by the enemy. Their sophisticated scopes ensure they never fail to make the kill.
entries.zh: 这些无与伦比的刺客是致命的射手，他们在战场的阴影中潜伏，敌人看不见他们。他们精密的瞄准镜确保他们永远不会错过杀戮。

entries.en: Trained to be a paragon of duty, Gadriel embodies the Ultramarines values of strict adherence to discipline, tactical prowess, and dedication to the Emperor’s service as dictated in the Codex Astartes.
entries.zh: 受训成为职责的楷模，Gadriel体现了极限战士对严格遵守纪律、战术才能和奉献给帝皇的服务的价值观，这些都是阿斯塔特圣典所规定的。

entries.en: Serving aboard the battle barge Resilient, Valtus was a 2nd company veteran before being fatally wounded and interred as a Redemptor Dreadnought.
entries.zh: 在战斗驳船Resilient上服役，Valtus在致命伤后被安葬为救赎者无畏机甲，之前他是第二连队的老兵。

entries.en: The Codex Astartes explains in detail the strategic value of overwhelming firepower applied to key targets at the optimal time in order to eliminate threats and create tactical openings.
entries.zh: 阿斯塔特圣典详细解释了在最佳时间对关键目标施加压倒性火力的战略价值，以消除威胁并创造战术机会。

entries.en: As the warring armies close upon one another and vicious firefights erupt, the Codex lays out strategies for swiftly seizing the initiative and combining versatility with firepower.
entries.zh: 当交战的军队接近彼此，猛烈的火战爆发时，圣典为迅速抓住主动权并将多功能性与火力结合起来提供了策略。

entries.en: The Codex Astartes leaves no doubt that the killing blow in most engagements must be delivered with a decisive close-quarters strike. It presents plentiful tactical means to achieve this end.
entries.zh: 阿斯塔特圣典毫不含糊地指出，在大多数交战中，致命一击必须以决定性的近战攻击来进行。它提供了丰富的战术手段来实现这一目标。

entries.en: Azrael is arguably the greatest to ever hold the title of Supreme Grand Master. Deeply committed to his Chapter’s secret agenda, the hunt for the Fallen is never far from his mind
entries.zh: 阿兹瑞尔无疑是至高大导师头衔的最伟大持有者。他深深地致力于他的战团的秘密议程，对堕天使的追捕从未离开他的脑海。

entries.en: Belial was promoted to Grand Master of the Deathwing after facing none other than Ghazghkull Thraka and, outnumbered thousands to one, stalling the Orks and saving Piscina IV.
entries.zh: 贝利亚在面对碎骨者·斯拉卡，并在被欧克蛮人以千倍之多的数量包围后，成功阻止了他们并拯救了皮斯希娜IV，因此被提升为死翼大导师。

entries.en: Asmodai is the Dark Angels’ Master Interrogator-Chaplain and Master of Repentance. His talents for torture and interrogation first made themselves known during the Macharian Heresy.
entries.zh: 阿斯莫德是黑暗天使的审讯者大教士和赎罪星的主人。他在马加利亚异端战争期间首次展现出他的折磨和审讯才能。

entries.en: Most of the wars the Dark Angels partake in have little or nothing to do with the Fallen, though they scour every battlefield for signs of sedition, corruption and Human augmentation.
entries.zh: 黑暗天使参与的大部分战争与堕天使几乎或完全无关，尽管他们在每个战场上都在寻找背叛、腐败和人类增强的迹象。

entries.en: These warrior-medics stride through volleys of gunfire and vicious melees to aid their wounded brothers and recover the progenoid glands of those who cannot be saved.
entries.zh: 这些战士医生在枪火和恶战中行走，以帮助他们受伤的兄弟们并回收那些无法被拯救的人的原始腺。

entries.en: An experienced officer of the 5th Company, Sergeant Taaman is adept at the unexpected yet brutally effective strikes Reivers are known for, sowing fear and confusion amongst the foe.
entries.zh: 作为第五连的经验丰富的军官，军士塔曼擅长出其不意但却极其有效的攻击，这也是劫掠者所知名的，他在敌人中播下恐惧和混乱。

entries.en: Regardless of their battlefield tasks, when the Ravenwing fight they strike at precise moments, gunning into action in a burst of thunderous acceleration.
entries.zh: 无论他们在战场上的任务如何，当鸦翼战斗时，他们会在精确的时刻攻击，以雷鸣般的加速冲入战斗。

entries.en: The Dark Angels’ organisation largely follows that of the Codex Astartes, with its third through tenth companies organised alongside Codex lines.
entries.zh: 黑暗天使的组织大致遵循阿斯塔特圣典的模式，其第三至第十连沿着圣典线进行组织。

entries.en: Spearheading devastating offences and shattering enemy assaults, Aggressors are walking ceramite strongpoints who lay down torrents of devastating fire at close-quarters.
entries.zh: 侵略者是步行的陶钢要塞，他们在近距离发动破坏性的火力，领导破坏性的进攻并粉碎敌人的攻击。

entries.en: The Ravenwing Black Knights are the 2nd Company’s greatest warriors, elite fighters who style themselves after the monster-hunting knights of old Caliban
entries.zh: 鸦翼黑骑士是第二连的最伟大的战士，他们是精英战士，他们的风格仿照古老的卡利班的怪物猎人骑士。

entries.en: On every tier of the Chapter’s organisation, the Dark Angels have a vast array of ancient rites and traditions –such as the Feast of Malediction– led by their Chaplains.
entries.zh: 在战团组织的每一层，黑暗天使都有大量的古老仪式和传统，如诅咒之宴，由他们的牧师领导。

entries.en: Company Veterans are elite warriors and highly experienced fighters. They are their Captain’s bodyguard, closest advisors and the core of his command squad.
entries.zh: 连队老兵是精英战士和经验丰富的战士。他们是他们的连长的护卫，最亲密的顾问和他的指挥组的核心。

entries.en: Masters of the Interromancy Discipline, Dark Angels Librarians contribute to the Hunt both on the battlefield as well as on interrogations, inscribing heretics on the Book of Salvation.
entries.zh: 作为干扰术学派的大师，黑暗天使的智库在战场上以及审讯中都为狩猎做出了贡献，他们在救赎之书上记录异教徒。

entries.en: Though none in the 2nd Company bar the Grand Master and Black Knights are aware, the Ravenwing’s primary role in the Chapter is to hunt down the Fallen amongst the ravaged enemy forces.
entries.zh: 虽然在第二连中，除了大导师和黑骑士外，没有人知道，但鸦翼在战团中的主要角色是在被破坏的敌军中追捕堕天使。

entries.en: The Ravenwing Champion is gifted a deadly Blade of Caliban – an ancient power sword as old as the Chapter itself, and tasked with cutting down the most formidable opponents
entries.zh: 鸦翼勇士被赠予一把致命的卡利班之剑 - 一把与战团同样古老的能量剑，他的任务是击败最强大的对手。

entries.en: Captains have spent centuries with their Chapter. They expect nothing but utter dedication from those they command.
entries.zh: 连长在他们的战团中度过了几个世纪。他们期望他们所指挥的人无条件的奉献。

entries.en: Deploying to the battlefield via teleport strike or armoured transport, Deathwing Terminators unleash devastating firepower before closing in to annihilate their foes in melee combat.
entries.zh: 通过传送攻击或装甲运输部署到战场，死翼终结者在接近敌人以进行近战战斗之前释放出毁灭性的火力。

entries.en: The Inner Circle Companions are some of the most skilled and sinister warriors. They arrive unannounced to guard heroes of the Unforgiven or pursue secret quests.
entries.zh: 内环伴侣是最熟练和最阴险的战士。他们无声无息地出现，保护戴罪者的英雄或追求秘密的任务。

entries.en: The Interrogator-Chaplains’ hatred for the Fallen runs deep. Dour individuals, their minds are set to a single purpose: right the terrible wrongs of their Chapter’s past.
entries.zh: 审讯者教士对堕天使的仇恨深深地烙印在他们的心中。他们是严肃的人，他们的心中只有一个目标：纠正他们战团过去的可怕错误。

entries.en: As Keeper of the Unseen Ritual, Lazarus is responsible for collating knowledge of Caliban’s ancient orders, much of which is held only by the Inner Circle.
entries.zh: 作为看不见的仪式的掌匙人，拉扎勒斯负责整理卡利班古老秩序的知识，其中大部分只有内环成员才知道。

entries.en: With a larger chassis and superior anti-gravity engines than the standard Land Speeder the Vengeance can mount heavier weaponry while keeping pace with the fastest ground vehicles.
entries.zh: 复仇星的底盘更大，反重力引擎比标准的兰德速攻艇更强大，可以装备更重的武器，同时与最快的地面载具保持同步。

entries.en: Those machines that have served the Dark Angels the longest, or with greater accomplishments, have their venerable machine spirits fortified by the Techmarines' rites of great honour.
entries.zh: 那些为黑暗天使服务时间最长，或有更大成就的机器，其尊贵的机魂被科技战士的荣誉仪式加强。

entries.en: Members of the Dark Angels' elite 1st Company of Veterans, each of these vastly experienced Space Marines has fought to preserve the Imperium across uncounted worlds.
entries.zh: 黑暗天使精英第一连队的成员都是老兵，这些经验丰富的星际战士在无数世界上战斗，保护帝国。

entries.en: Company Champions meet the foe’s greatest warriors in single combat to defend the honour of their Chapter and to free up their commanders to lead and coordinate the strike force.
entries.zh: 连队冠军与敌人的最强战士进行单挑，以捍卫他们战团的荣誉，并让他们的指挥官有空间领导和协调打击力量。

entries.en: Equipped with heirloom wargear, Deathwing Knights teleport into the heart of the thickest fighting, their strikes breaking the enemy’s back in one fell swoop.
entries.zh: 装备着传世战争装备的死翼骑士，传送到最激烈的战斗中心，他们的攻击一举打破敌人的防线。

entries.en: The Ravenwing Ancient carries one of the company’s sacred standards, and beneath its shadow the black-armoured warriors of the Ravenwing bring death to the foe.
entries.zh: 鸦翼骑手携带公司的神圣标志，鸦翼的黑色盔甲战士在其影子下将死亡带给敌人。

entries.en: Mounted in a Land Speeder outfitted with additional auspex scanners and vox-casters, it is a Talonmaster’s role to direct the Ravenwing’s fire.
entries.zh: 装备了额外感知器扫描器和通讯器的兰德速攻艇，利爪星大师的角色是指导鸦翼的火力。

entries.en: To this day, only the Deathwing, select Masters, the Interrogator-Chaplains and Librarians of the Chapter have any real knowledge of the Unforgiven’s past and its hidden knowledge.
entries.zh: 至今，只有死翼，选定的大导师，审讯者教士和战团的智库才真正了解戴罪者的过去和其隐藏的知识。

entries.en: Upon each Darkshroud there is a mysterious statue that survived Caliban’s destruction and became imbued with energies that can obscure nearby battle-brothers from enemy sight.
entries.zh: 每个暗影罩上都有一个神秘的雕像，它在卡利班的毁灭中幸存下来，并被赋予了可以使附近的战斗修士从敌人视线中消失的能量。

entries.en: Strikemasters serve as the Deathwing’s Lieutenants. They have carried out deeds of enormous bravery on countless battlefields, honing their skills as warriors and leaders.
entries.zh: 突击大师作为死翼的副官。他们在无数战场上进行了巨大的勇敢行为，磨练了他们作为战士和领导者的技能。

entries.en: As Grand Master of the Librarius and Keeper of the Keys, Ezekiel can open all portals on the Rock, save but a handful, and has the ability to read the intentions of any individual.
entries.zh: 作为智库馆的大导师和掌匙人，以西结可以打开巨石上的所有门户，除了少数几个，并有能力读取任何个体的意图。

entries.en: The most formidable fighter of his company, the Deathwing Champion wields a halberd of Caliban. His wide swings strike down multiple foes as he seeks out the most worthy opponents.
entries.zh: 他是他的连队中最强大的战士，死翼勇士挥舞着卡利班之戟。他的广泛挥舞击倒了多个敌人，他寻找最有价值的对手。

entries.en: Air-to-air interceptors, Nephilim Jetfighters perform lightning-fast warfare manoeuvres. These pilots continually push the Techmarines for enhancements and modification to their craft.
entries.zh: 空对空拦截者，涅菲里姆战斗机执行闪电般的战争动作。这些飞行员不断向科技战士推动他们的飞机进行增强和改装。

entries.en: As time went by, the number of warriors who witnessed what befell on Caliban dwindled to none but a handful of ancients interred within Dreadnought sarcophagi.
entries.zh: 随着时间的推移，目睹卡利班发生的事情的战士数量减少到只有几个被安置在无畏机甲石棺中的古老人物。

entries.en: The Dark Talon possesses strange armaments dating back to the Dark Age of Technology, and is designed to snatch up the Ravenwing’s prey.
entries.zh: 黑暗利爪星拥有追溯到黑暗科技纪元的奇特武器，并设计用来捕获鸦翼的猎物。

entries.en: Sammael rides to war on the jetbike Corvex, a relic from the Dark Age of Technology. Upon this ancient mount, the Ravenwing’s commander charges with the Raven Sword.
entries.zh: 萨麦尔骑着喷气摩托克维克斯进入战争，这是来自黑暗科技纪元的遗物。在这个古老的座驾上，鸦翼的指挥官带着暗鸦之剑冲锋。

entries.en: Led by a Knight Master, the arrival of Deathwing Knights upon a battlefield is portentous, for they are rarely deployed without great need or the prospect of the Fallen’s presence.
entries.zh: 在骑士长的领导下，死翼骑士出现在战场上是不祥的，因为他们很少在没有大需要或堕天使出现的前景下被部署。

entries.en: Clad in advanced armour plating and armed for any battlefield situation, the Repulsor not only transports its passengers safely, it also provides superb fire support.
entries.zh: 穿着先进的盔甲板，装备了任何战场情况的武器，反击者坦克不仅可以安全地运送乘客，还可以提供出色的火力支援。

entries.en: Strikemasters have the onerous duty of managing the gaols deep within the Rock, where the most treacherous prisoners are held and the most dangerous relics secured.
entries.zh: 突击大师肩负着管理巨石深处的繁重职责，那里关押着最危险的囚犯和最危险的遗物。

entries.en: After Horus’ rebellion failed, the Imperium was left in a state of turmoil. The Inner Circle was formed during that time, a closed network of the Dark Angels’ most senior warriors.
entries.zh: 荷鲁斯的叛乱失败后，帝国陷入了混乱。在那个时候，内环成立了，这是一个由黑暗天使最高级别的战士组成的封闭网络。

entries.en: A number of Deathwing accompany most Dark Angels strike forces, not only for their outstanding martial might, but also so that they can undertake secret missions.
entries.zh: 大多数黑暗天使打击力量都会有一些死翼陪伴，不仅因为他们出色的武力，还因为他们可以执行秘密任务。

entries.en: Scout teams are often sent to seek for the Fallen. The hunt has never ceased and never will until all are captured, though the Unforgiven can fight for decades with no sign of them.
entries.zh: 侦查队经常被派去寻找堕天使。这场狩猎从未停止，直到所有人都被捕获，尽管戴罪者可以战斗几十年也没有他们的迹象。

entries.en: The stalwart descendants of the Lion are renowned for their unshakeable resolve, enduring tenacity and strict fire discipline in battle.
entries.zh: 狮子的坚定后裔以他们在战斗中的坚定决心，持久的坚韧和严格的火力纪律而闻名。

entries.en: Though most Dark Angels have little idea what it is they are searching for, those of the Inner Circle understand the subtle clues that might aid them in hunting the Fallen.
entries.zh: 尽管大多数黑暗天使对他们在寻找什么没有什么概念，但内环的人们理解可能帮助他们狩猎堕天使的微妙线索。

entries.en: Even for a Chapter as famously stubborn as the Dark Angels, some warriors are known for their intractable nature. Utterly persistent, even death is not enough to stay their wrath.
entries.zh: 即使对于像黑暗天使这样著名的固执战团，也有一些战士以他们的顽固性格而闻名。他们坚持不懈，即使死亡也无法阻止他们的愤怒。

entries.en: The Dark Angels have had no home world since Caliban was shattered. The Rock is all that is left of that world, a voidborne hunk of solid rock fitted with enormous engines.
entries.zh: 自从卡利班被破坏以来，黑暗天使就没有家园。巨石是那个世界的全部遗留，一个装有巨大引擎的空间岩石块。

entries.en: The STC for the Nephilim Jetfighter was discovered on the hunt for the Fallen Baelor the Imposter. The technology – named the Lionheart engine – was used to modify older designs.
entries.zh: 在寻找堕天使贝洛尔·冒名者的过程中，发现了涅菲里姆战斗机的STC。这项技术——被命名为狮心引擎——被用来修改旧设计。

entries.en: Through rigorous training and countless battles endured, the Deathwing have learned to begin their sweeping fire patterns immediately upon their arrival from teleportation.
entries.zh: 通过严格的训练和无数次的战斗，死翼已经学会了在从传送中到达后立即开始他们的扫射火力模式。

entries.en: The Fallen’s existence is a persistent stain on the Dark Angels' honour. For the Unforgiven to be redeemed, their traitorous brethren must be hunted down and made to repent.
entries.zh: 堕天使的存在是黑暗天使荣誉上的一个持久污点。为了让戴罪者得到救赎，他们的叛逆兄弟必须被追捕并被迫悔改。

entries.en: Symbolizing the defiance for which the Dark Angels are famed, the Standard of Devastation has flown above numerous last stands, often found atop piles of enemy dead.
entries.zh: 毁灭战旗象征着黑暗天使的抗争，它飘扬在无数的最后阵地之上，经常被发现在敌人的尸体堆上。

entries.en: The enemies of the Emperor must be dug out of every bolthole and tainted strongpoint, driven from their heretical fastnesses and subjected to the merciless judgement of the Unforgiven.
entries.zh: 帝皇的敌人必须从每一个藏身之处和被污染的据点中挖出来，从他们的异端堡垒中驱逐出来，并受到戴罪者无情的审判。

entries.en: Cutting down the last of their foes and giving no mind to their own hurts, the Unforgiven press relentlessly on toward victory.
entries.zh: 戴罪者在割下最后一个敌人并不在乎自己的伤害，他们坚决地向胜利前进。

entries.en: Many foes have charged the Dark Angels’ lines, only to be met by an unbreakable wall of ceramite, while the Dark Angels channel all their focus and aggression to smash the foe.
entries.zh: 许多敌人冲向黑暗天使的阵线，只是被一个坚不可摧的陶钢墙阻挡，而黑暗天使将所有的注意力和侵略性都集中在击败敌人上。

entries.en: The Dark Angels march to war with sombre determination. Merciless and relentless, they systematically slaughter their enemies until nothing remains but corpses and blazing wreckage.
entries.zh: 黑暗天使以严肃的决心走向战争。他们无情且坚决，他们系统地屠杀他们的敌人，直到只剩下尸体和燃烧的残骸。

entries.en: The Dark Angels wage entire wars to secure individuals who might have knowledge of the whereabouts of the Fallen, or who may have acquired a fragment of the Dark Angels’ secrets.
entries.zh: 黑暗天使为了保护可能知道堕天使下落的人，或者可能获得黑暗天使秘密的一部分的人，而发动整场战争。

entries.en: Boarding infested space hulks, carrying out unsupported alpha-strikes or attacking the most horrific enemies, the Dark Angels will go to any lengths to carry out their secret missions.
entries.zh: 登上被感染的太空废船，执行无支援的阿尔法打击，或者攻击最恐怖的敌人，黑暗天使将不惜任何代价来执行他们的秘密任务。

entries.en: Black-clad huntsmen and masters of the art of lightning warfare, the Ravenwing race before their Chapter like thunder before a storm.
entries.zh: 身着黑色猎装，是闪电战艺术的大师，鸦翼在他们的战团前面疾驰，就像暴风雨前的雷声。

entries.en: Undeniable is their loyalty. Undeniable is their zeal. Undeniable is their fury. Among the Adeptus Astartes it is them who have stood the longest, bled the most and wavered least.
entries.zh: 他们的忠诚无可否认。他们的热忱无可否认。他们的愤怒无可否认。在阿斯塔特修会中，他们是最长久的站立者，流血最多的人，动摇最少的人。

entries.en: Azrael is a beacon of inspiration to those who follow him, and is paid enormous respect for his ability as a strategist, orchestrating his forces to maximum advantage.
entries.zh: 阿兹瑞尔是那些跟随他的人的灵感之源，他的战略才能赢得了极大的尊重，他能将自己的力量最大化。

entries.en: Belial’s combat technique has no great style, flourish or artifice. Instead it is driven by ruthless killing efficiency and well-honed strength. Each parry and thrust is a decisive act.
entries.zh: 贝利亚的战斗技巧没有什么大的风格，繁花或工匠。相反，它是由无情的杀戮效率和磨练的力量驱动的。每一次挡招和刺击都是决定性的行动。

entries.en: Asmodai does not suffer fools of any kind. His interests lie only in the Chapter’s goals and in battle. Such is Asmodai’s motivation, many of his actions border on the indefensible.
entries.zh: 阿斯莫德不容任何类型的愚人。他的兴趣只在战团的目标和战斗中。阿斯莫德的动机如此，他的许多行动都在无法辩解的边缘。

entries.en: Sammael is a master of high-speed warfare, able to react to changing battlefield situations in the blink of an eye and deploy the Ravenwing to wherever they are most needed.
entries.zh: 萨麦尔是高速战争的大师，能在眨眼间应对变化的战场情况，并将鸦翼部署到最需要他们的地方。

entries.en: Usually at the forefront of battle, Ezekiel is a master of Interromancy. His warp-whispers claw away the sanity of his enemies, while his blade rends their flesh.
entries.zh: 以西结通常在战斗的最前线，他是干扰术的大师。他的亚空间低语像爪子一样剥去敌人的理智，而他的剑则撕裂他们的肉体。

entries.en: Enemy commanders are oblivious of the explosive value of the knowledge they hold. The Librarians of the Dark Angels are adept at scanning the minds of their foes for any clues.
entries.zh: 敌人的指挥官对他们所持有的知识的爆炸价值一无所知。黑暗天使的智库擅长扫描敌人的思想寻找线索。

entries.en: The Unforgiven act without hesitation or mercy should they receive the merest hint that their foes have gleaned knowledge of their hidden secrets.
entries.zh: 一旦戴罪者收到敌人已经获得他们隐藏秘密的最微小暗示，他们就会毫不犹豫或怜悯地行动。

entries.en: The Dark Angels swiftly agreed that what transpired on Caliban was to be kept secret at all costs, and were sworn to silence to prevent being declared Excommunicate Traitoris.
entries.zh: 黑暗天使迅速同意，卡利班发生的事情必须不惜一切代价保密，并发誓寂灭，以防被宣布为异端审判。

entries.en: The Unforgiven honour successful warriors through ancient and obscure rituals, rewarding them –if deemed ready– with advancement into the inner mysteries of the Chapter
entries.zh: 戴罪者通过古老和晦涩的仪式来荣誉成功的战士，如果他们被认为已经准备好，就会奖励他们进入战团内部的神秘之处。

entries.en: Even after winning glorious victories, Chaplains give each combatant their own specific penance, whether it be battle drills, hymnals or rites of atonement.
entries.zh: 即使在赢得辉煌胜利后，牧师也会给每个战士他们自己的特定赎罪，无论是战斗训练，赞美诗还是赎罪仪式。

entries.en: What may look as mere rites and ceremonies often conceal the truth of the Chapter through circles of metaphor and allegory, where crucial information of The Hunt is secretly conveyed.
entries.zh: 看起来像是仪式和典礼的东西，往往通过隐喻和寓言的圈子，隐藏了战团的真理，其中包含了狩猎的关键信息。

entries.en: Larger than the heaviest class of Imperial warship, The Rock is fitted with a vast range of formidable defensive weapons, cavernous docking bays and wide-reaching comms arrays.
entries.zh: 巨石比帝国最重型的战舰还要大，装备了各种强大的防御武器，巨大的停靠湾和广泛的通讯阵列。

entries.en: Used by the Imperium to power voidships, hive cities and more, Plasma Generators are advanced reactors that generate power through nuclear fusion, harnessing high-temperature plasma.
entries.zh: 等离子发电机被帝国用来为虚空舰，巢都城市等提供电力，它们是通过核聚变产生电力的先进反应器，利用高温等离子体。

entries.en: Unlike most Chapters, the Unforgiven do not possess a home world. Instead, The Rock navigates the galaxy as The Hunt demands, often exposing itself to the calamities of outer space.
entries.zh: 与大多数战团不同，戴罪者没有拥有一个家园。相反，巨石在狩猎的要求下在银河系中导航，经常暴露自己于外太空的灾难。

entries.en: While heavily protected, the lack of a large gravitational field and an atmosphere normally found in planetary fortresses allows for voidcrafts to be used in an assault against orbital stations.
entries.zh: 虽然受到重度保护，但缺乏大型重力场和通常在行星堡垒中找到的大气层，使得虚空舰可以用来攻击轨道站。

entries.en: The magnetic fields of stars can help conceal orbital stations from enemy sensors; however, once located, stellar flares can also make them vulnerable to a well-timed attack.
entries.zh: 星星的磁场可以帮助从敌人的传感器中隐藏轨道站；然而，一旦被定位，恒星耀斑也可以使它们在良好的攻击时机下变得脆弱。

entries.en: There’s not a tougher or more belligerent Ork than Mozrog Skragbad. Boasting a craggier hide than a rok squig’s, he is the epitome of what the average Beast Snagga aspires to become.
entries.zh: 没有比莫兹罗格·斯夸格巴德更强硬或更好战的欧克蛮人。他的皮肤比岩石跳跳还要坚硬，是所有豢兽师向往成为的典范。

entries.en: Mozrog and his squigosaur steed Big Chompa can weather the worst any foe throws at them. The few enemies that survive Big Chompa's jaws are teared by Mozrog's his kustom punch‑dagger.
entries.zh: 莫兹罗格和他的跳跳龙坐骑大嘴能够抵挡任何敌人对他们的攻击。少数幸存的敌人在大嘴之颚的撕咬后，会被莫兹罗格的定制拳刺撕裂。

entries.en: Ferocious and foul‑tempered, beastboss Morgrim possesses cybork enhancements and a wired‑in targetin’ squig to bring down even the largest prey one‑on‑one.
entries.zh: 凶猛且脾气暴躁的野兽头目摩格林拥有改造人增强和一个内置的瞄准跳跳，可以一对一击败甚至最大的猎物。

entries.en: Beastbosses must constantly prove themselves the biggest and baddest fighters, seeking out and pulverising the foe’s most dangerous champions in gory displays of superiority.
entries.zh: 野兽头目必须不断证明自己是最大最坏的战士，寻找并粉碎敌人最危险的冠军，以血腥的优越性展示。

entries.en: There isn’t a problem that Beast Snaggas don’t think can be fixed with a squig. As for the nimble grots that fight alongside them, they adhere to such statement the best they can.
entries.zh: 没有豢兽师不认为可以用跳跳解决的问题。至于那些和他们一起战斗的灵活地精，他们尽可能地坚持这样的声明。

entries.en: Big, brutal, and belligerent Beast Snaggas excel in softening up their prey, dragging them down, then ripping them bodily to bits.
entries.zh: 大型、残暴、好战的豢兽师擅长软化他们的猎物，将他们拖下来，然后将他们撕成碎片。

entries.en: Thanks to the spirited – if inexpert – surgery by painbosses' grot orderlies, lucky fell orks may eventually get back on their feet for more krumpin'
entries.zh: 多亏了痛苦头目的地精医生们的精神饱满——尽管不熟练的手术，幸运的欧克蛮人可能最终会站起来继续战斗。

entries.en: Often announcing an imminent stampede of Beast Snaggas, the fist-shells of their thump guns pour upon enemy lines, with their fierce blast making up for the shooter's lack of accuracy.
entries.zh: 豢兽师的重击炮的拳头炮弹常常预示着即将到来的踩踏，倾泻在敌人的阵线上，他们的猛烈爆炸弥补了射手的精确度不足。

entries.en: Beast Snagga Nobz easily lead their packs of boyz into the fight, a task merely consisting on bellowing louder than the foe and rushing faster than fellow Orks to get krumpin' first.
entries.zh: 豢兽师强蛮人轻易地带领他们的小子群体进入战斗，这项任务只需要比敌人大声吼叫，比其他欧克蛮人更快地冲进去先开始战斗。

entries.en: Accostumed to the ways of their tribe, even the nimblest of Grots will try their luck at riding squigs into battle, many a Grot meeting their end chomped by the very squig they ride.
entries.zh: 习惯了他们部落的方式，即使是最灵活的地精也会尝试骑跳跳进入战斗，许多地精在被他们骑的跳跳咬死之前结束了他们的生命。

entries.en: Runtherds possess a deep understanding of how to rear, train and herd the squigs and runts that keep Ork society functioning, not knowing nor caring where their knowledge comes from.
entries.zh: 矮精监军对如何饲养、训练和驯养保持欧克蛮人社会运转的跳跳和小家伙有深刻的理解，他们不知道也不关心他们的知识来自哪里。

entries.en: The average Ork has as much time for military organisation as they do for washing regularly. Combat structures are as rough‑and‑ready as they are instinctive.
entries.zh: 普通的欧克蛮人对军事组织的时间和他们定期洗澡的时间一样多。战斗结构就像他们的本能一样粗糙且随时准备。

entries.en: Should a Rig be wrecked, the draught Tramplasquig will find itself set loose amidst the bellowing of war, and will run amok stomping any fool in the way of the untethered beast.
entries.zh: 如果一个钻塔被摧毁，那么践踏跳跳将会在战争的吼声中找到自己，它会在解除束缚的野兽的路上踩踏任何傻瓜。

entries.en: This wild‑eyed wanderer knows the secrets of breeding the best and baddest runts, and sells his peculiar services to the highest bidder.
entries.zh: 这个野眼的流浪者知道如何繁殖最好和最坏的小家伙，并将他的特殊服务卖给出价最高的人。

entries.en: Leading the packs of Squighob boys into the fray, these Nobz ride thick‑skulled smasha squigs, employing their muscle, weight and momentum to squash their foes to a paste.
entries.zh: 这些强蛮人带领跳跳猪小子的群体冲入战斗，他们骑着厚头骨的砸击跳跳，利用他们的肌肉、重量和动力将敌人压成糊状。

entries.en: With their mounts snorting and saddlegitz hanging on for dear life, Squighog Boyz thunder into the fight, flinging rokkit‑propelled stikkas with enough force to pierce plate armour.
entries.zh: 跳跳猪小子在他们的坐骑噴鼻息和鞍座吊带紧紧抓住的情况下，冲入战斗，用足够的力量投掷火箭推进的刺叉，足以穿透板甲。

entries.en: Highly respected in Beast Snagga society, Wurrboys employ their pseudo‑shamanic powers to glean visions they believe are sent by Gork and Mork, guiding them to the best prey.
entries.zh: 在豢兽师社会中，战争小子受到高度尊重，他们利用他们的伪萨满力量来获取他们认为是由格克和摩克发送的视觉，引导他们找到最好的猎物。

entries.en: When a Beastboss wishes to ride a Squigosaur, he must first beat it within an inch of its life to teach it respect, all without getting devoured in the process.
entries.zh: 当一个野兽头目希望骑跳跳龙时，他必须首先将它打到生命垂危以教育它尊重，而不被在过程中吞噬。

entries.en: Weirdboyz have little or no control over their dubious yet powerful gifts. When Waaagh! energy starts flowing, a great portion of that energy flows straight into nearby Weirdboyz.
entries.zh: 灵能小子对他们那些不确定但强大的能力几乎无法控制。当Waaagh!能量开始流动时，大部分能量直接流入附近的灵能小子。

entries.en: Welded, lashed and nailed together from enemy wrecks and scavenged scrap, the Hunta Rig's open metal deck ushers chanting mobs of Beast Snagga Boyz to ride along on the hunt.
entries.zh: 焊接、捆绑和钉在一起的敌人残骸和回收的废料，狩猎战车的开放式金属卡组引领着豢兽师小子的吟唱暴群一起狩猎。

entries.en: Whilst, fulfilling both roles of Meks and Painboyz, Painbosses prefer to work on squigs than on Orks and, frankly, most of their Beast Snagga patients would prefer it that way too.
entries.zh: 虽然兼任技师和痛苦小子的角色，痛苦首领更喜欢在跳跳上工作，而不是在欧克蛮人上，坦白说，他们的大部分豢兽师病人也更喜欢这样。

entries.en: The Kill Rig’s stikka kannon fires rokkit‑harpoons big enough to wrangle battle tanks, yet it is the Wurrboy atop his wurrtower that both enemies and Beast Snaggas fear the most.
entries.zh: 杀戮战车的刺叉炮能发射足够大的火箭鱼叉来操纵战斗坦克，然而，敌人和豢兽师最害怕的是站在灵能塔上的战争小子。

entries.en: Often reinforced with the salvaged parts of their latest prey, Snakebite's Battlewagons' are one of the few 'propa' know-wotz they tolerate; as long as it gets te boyz krumpin' faster
entries.zh: 蛇咬的战斗堡垒经常用他们最新猎物的回收部件进行加固，这是他们能容忍的少数'propa'蛮人科技之一；只要能让小子们更快地进行Krumpin'。

entries.en: Squiggoths can grow in size indefinitely. The larger they get, the more prized. Kitted out with armour, guns and bellowing passengers, these giant specimens are walking bastions.
entries.zh: Squiggoths的大小可以无限增长。它们越大，越受欢迎。装备了盔甲、枪和吼叫的乘客，这些巨大的样本就像行走的堡垒。

entries.en: Using jingling bells, tasty fungal treats and an array of Painboy‑brewed serums, Zodgrod manages to propagate superior grots, snots and a variety of squig breeds.
entries.zh: 使用叮当作响的铃铛、美味的真菌零食和一系列痛苦小子研制的血清，Zodgrod成功地繁殖出优秀的地精、鼻涕虫和各种跳跳品种。

entries.en: Revelling in the rush of venting their built‑up powers, Weirdboys seek out the press of battle, intentionally supercharging their tortured brains and unleashing supernatural forces.
entries.zh: 沉醉在释放他们积累的力量的冲动中，灵能小子寻找战斗的压力，故意超充他们的受折磨的大脑，释放超自然的力量。

entries.en: Painbosses augment themselves with piston‑driven supa‑legz, monowheels and the like to deliver high‑speed doktorin’ and surgical care.
entries.zh: 痛苦首领用活塞驱动的超级腿、单轮车等增强自己，以提供高速的医疗和手术护理。

entries.en: The typical Snakebite is gnarled, weather‑worn and garbed in beast‑hide leather. They are as traditional as Orks come, favouring low‑tech wargear over anything needlessly fiddly.
entries.zh: 典型的蛇咬者是粗糙的、风化的，穿着野兽皮革。他们是欧克蛮人中最传统的，喜欢低科技战争装备，而不是任何不必要的繁琐东西。

entries.en: Successful hunt leaders are never short of a kunnin’ plan to flush out the prey. They ransack whatever the prey values, luring the quarry with no bolthole or gear to fall back on.
entries.zh: 成功的狩猎领导者总是有一个狡猾的计划来冲出猎物。他们洗劫猎物珍视的一切，没有藏身之处或装备可以依赖。

entries.en: Obsessed with being the first to make a kill, some Beast Snaggas will press their Painbosses to bionikaly enhance their wounded Squighogs for an edge during the hunt.
entries.zh: 痴迷于首先杀死猎物的豢兽师会催促他们的痛苦首领用生物技术增强他们受伤的Squighogs，以在狩猎中获得优势。

entries.en: For most Beast Snaggas, the life of a squig-riding nomad who lives off the land, hunts huge horrible monsters and clobbers anything that crosses his path has great appeal.
entries.zh: 对于大多数豢兽师来说，一个骑跳跳的游牧生活，靠土地生活，狩猎巨大的恶心怪物，痛击任何阻挡他们道路的东西，都很有吸引力。

entries.en: Even the densest Orks can wrap their heads around the concept of gathering in massive mobs, bellowing while charging headlong at the enemy, then beating the foe to a bloody pulp.
entries.zh: 即使是最笨的欧克蛮人也能理解聚集在大型暴群中，向敌人冲锋，然后将敌人打成血肉模糊的概念。

entries.en: Spying the largest or most dangerous threats on the battlefield, Beast Snaggas chase them down with gleeful enthusiasm, mobs racing each other to claim the kill.
entries.zh: 豢兽师在战场上发现最大或最危险的威胁，他们兴高采烈地追赶他们，暴群互相竞赛，争夺杀戮的荣誉。

entries.en: Beast Snaggas have many tales of the times they took on the biggest prey, clobbering them with so many blows that what was left was a crumpled mass of broken hide and squished innards
entries.zh: 豢兽师有很多关于他们挑战最大猎物的故事，他们用如此多的打击击败他们，剩下的只是一堆破碎的皮肤和挤压的内脏。

entries.en: Numbers; brawn; swarming runts and squigs; solid and reliable weapons and armour – these are what the more down‑to‑earth Orks believe win wars.
entries.zh: 数量；肌肉；蜂拥的小鬼和跳跳；坚固可靠的武器和盔甲 - 这些是更接地气的欧克蛮人认为能赢得战争的东西。

entries.en: Some Imperial scholars claim that the power of the Waaagh! is the way in which Orks interact with the warp. Accurate or not, Oddboys act as a focal point for such tempestuous energy
entries.zh: 一些帝国学者声称，Waaagh!的力量是欧克蛮人与亚空间互动的方式。无论是否准确，怪客小子都是这种暴风骤雨般能量的焦点。

entries.en: It isn’t that Snakebites cannot use technology, but they employ know‑wotz only when they have to and won’t consider devices proppa until they’ve built up a patina of rust and oil.
entries.zh: 并非蛇咬不能使用技术，而是他们只在必要时才使用知识，而且不会认为设备是合适的，直到它们积累了一层锈和油的光泽。

entries.en: A seemingly immortal bladefighter of superlative skill and egregious ego, Lucius has funnelled lifetimes of experience into raising his swordsmanship to supernatural superiority.
entries.zh: 卢修斯是一位看似不朽的剑术战士，技艺超群，自我感觉过度，他将一生的经验都融入到他的剑术中，使其达到超自然的优越地位。

entries.en: Arrogant slaughterer and swordmaster supreme, Lucius seeks out the most skilled of the foe's champions, followed by the Faultless to whom he promises untold sensations.
entries.zh: 傲慢的屠杀者和至高无上的剑术大师，卢修斯寻找敌人中最有技艺的冠军，然后是他向他们承诺无尽感觉的无瑕者。

entries.en: Possessed of an infernal arrogance and physical perfection, Xarahan prides itself upon its martial prowess, seeking nothing but to test itself against the greatest champions.
entries.zh: Xarahan拥有地狱般的傲慢和物理完美，他以自己的武术实力自豪，只寻求与最伟大的冠军对抗。

entries.en: Towering over the mortals it leads to battle, Xarahan shares the Dark Prince's gifts through visions of excess and obsession. But such power is not given without a price.
entries.zh: Xarahan高高地站在他引领的凡人之上，通过过度和迷恋的视觉分享黑暗王子的礼物。但这种力量并非没有代价。

entries.en: Leading the Callous Blades to uncounted victories with towering arrogance, Lord Kaphrael singles out the enemy's champions, inflicting a gory demise upon his chosen foes.
entries.zh: 以傲慢的态度，领导冷酷之刃取得无数胜利，Kaphrael领主挑选出敌人的冠军，对他选定的敌人施以血腥的死亡。

entries.en: Lord Kaphrael views the battlefield as an exhibition arena, dominating through martial prowess and an inexhaustible supply of sadistic imagination and bio-stimmulants.
entries.zh: Kaphrael领主将战场视为展览场，通过武术实力和无尽的虐待想象力和生物刺激剂来统治。

entries.en: Known to mortals as the handmaidens of Slaanesh, these daemons are a mixture of the beautiful and the monstrous, made all the more disturbing by the visceral clash of both.
entries.zh: 这些恶魔被凡人称为色孽的侍女，她们是美丽和怪物的混合体，由于两者的剧烈冲突，使得她们更加令人不安。

entries.en: Consumed by an obsessive desire to experience sensation in all its forms, Infractors hurl into battle with great sweeps and violent thrusts of their razor-sharp blades.
entries.zh: Infractors被一种强烈的欲望所消耗，这种欲望是要体验所有形式的感觉，他们用他们锋利的剑大力挥舞，猛烈地冲入战斗。

entries.en: Tormentors echo the tactically adaptable squads that were once the mainstay of the Emperor's Children Legion before the horrors of the Heresy, striking with salvoes of explosive bolts.
entries.zh: 折磨者回应了在异端恐怖之前曾是帝皇子女军团主力的战术适应性小队，用爆炸螺栓的齐射进行攻击。

entries.en: Leading the Daemonettees, Alluresses delight in the carnage of battle, weaving around enemies' clumsy blows as they shrill and sigh their delight amidst swift-taloned slaughter.
entries.zh: 领导恶魔女郎的Alluresses在战斗的屠杀中找到乐趣，他们在敌人笨拙的攻击中穿梭，他们在快速利爪的屠杀中尖叫和叹息。

entries.en: The Glittering Myriad have carved a reputation for blindingly swift armoured assaults. Their Infractors are rampantly deployed into the battlefield, ready to indulge in violence.
entries.zh: 闪耀无数已经树立了盲目快速的装甲攻击的声誉。他们的Infractors被大量部署到战场上，准备沉溺于暴力。

entries.en: Among the myriad warbands of the Emperor's Children, few revel in the enemy's agony as the Konstrictus do, leaving the battlefields as gouged victims crawl around fleshy bonfires.
entries.zh: 在帝皇子女的无数战队中，很少有人像Konstrictus那样沉醉于敌人的痛苦，他们让战场变成了被切割的受害者在肉体篝火周围爬行。

entries.en: Infractors vie with each other to carve the most visceral trail of destruction, viewing the battlefield as a stage gifted by Slaanesh with beings who exist only to be sliced apart.
entries.zh: Infractors互相竞争，看谁能在战场上刻画出最生动的破坏轨迹，他们将战场视为一个由色孽赠予的舞台，上面的生物只存在为了被切割。

entries.en: Clad in garish power armour and clutching over-ornamented guns, Tormentors are aggressive front-line troops who revel in the gory deaths they inflict upon their enemies.
entries.zh: 身穿花哨的动力盔甲，手握过度装饰的枪，折磨者是喜欢在他们的敌人身上制造血腥死亡的侵略性前线军队。

entries.en: Chaos Spawn of Slaanesh hurl themselves into battle with reckless abandon, quivering with delight as they tear their opponents apart with mutant claws and sinuous tentacles.
entries.zh: 色孽的混沌魔物疯狂地投入战斗，当他们用突变的爪子和弯曲的触须撕裂对手时，他们会颤抖着欢喜。

entries.en: These hedonistic worshippers of Slanesh are inured to most stimuli and seek to unleash the most cacophonous destruction to stir their jaded senses.
entries.zh: 这些沉溺于色孽的崇拜者对大多数刺激都已经麻木，他们寻求释放最嘈杂的破坏，以激发他们麻木的感官。

entries.en: The Threnodic Choir orchestrate their battles with wailing harmonies that can destabilise tectonic plates, rendering the enemy an easy target for their endless sound barrage.
entries.zh: Threnodic Choir用哀嚎的和声指挥他们的战斗，这种和声可以破坏构造板，使敌人成为他们无尽声音弹幕的容易目标。

entries.en: Granted power by daemonic patrons, the Flawless Blades strive to entertain their malefic masters with peerless swordplay and by inflicting vile and visceral death upon their foes.
entries.zh: 由恶魔赞助者赋予力量，无瑕之刃努力以无与伦比的剑术和对敌人造成邪恶而生动的死亡来取悦他们的邪恶主人。

entries.en: Blastmasters focus a throbbing bass note into an explosive crescendo that can burst eyeballs, rupture organs and deliquesce the hardened armour of tanks.
entries.zh: 音波枪专注于将低沉的音符聚焦成爆炸性的增强，可以破裂眼球，撕裂器官，融化坦克的坚硬盔甲。

entries.en: Debased suits of Terminator armour offer Emperor's Children the raw power to bludgeon their way through swarms of lesser foes and the ability to endure apocalyptic attacks.
entries.zh: 堕落的终结者装甲为帝皇的孩子们提供了原始的力量，以粗暴的方式穿越虫群的小敌人，并有能力承受末日般的攻击。

entries.en: Leading Infractor squads seething with cocktails of stimulants, Obsessionists only care that their next fight is more bloody, extreme and sensationally wanton than the last.
entries.zh: 领导充满兴奋剂的Infractor小队的Obsessionists只关心他们的下一场战斗比上一场更血腥，更极端，更疯狂。

entries.en: Tormentors obsess over their ranged weapons. Most fetishise their boltguns, taking gratification in having mastered the symbolic weapon and raised its use to an art form
entries.zh: 折磨者痴迷于他们的远程武器。大多数人都喜欢他们的爆矢枪，他们在掌握了这种象征性武器并将其使用提升到艺术形式的过程中得到了满足。

entries.en: These chimerical daemon beasts manifest with arachnid, equine and reptilian traits. Their instincts for hunting down anything that promises to scream and hurt are preternatural.
entries.zh: 这些奇异的恶魔兽具有蜘蛛，马和爬行动物的特征。他们寻找任何有可能尖叫和疼痛的东西的本能是超自然的。

entries.en: Noise Marines served amongst Traitor Legions and Renegade Chapters, but they are most widespread amongst the Emperor's Children where they originated and were known as Kakophoni.
entries.zh: 噪音战士在叛乱军团和叛逆战团中服役，但他们在帝皇的孩子们中最为广泛，他们起源于此并被称为Kakophoni。

entries.en: Envied and feared in equal parts, Veldras' speed and razor-sharp blades have claimed more heads than entire regiments, seeking nothing but the exhilarant joy of bloodshed.
entries.zh: Veldras的速度和锋利的刀片引来了羡慕和恐惧，他们的头颅比整个团队还要多，他们寻求的只是流血的喜悦。

entries.en: Leading the Fiend packs, Blissbringers dissect their prey with oversized claws and immense strength, exposing nerves and organs to more invasive abuse.
entries.zh: 领导恶魔群体的狂喜带来者用超大的爪子和巨大的力量解剖他们的猎物，暴露神经和器官以进行更多的侵入性虐待。

entries.en: Leading squads of Noise Marines, Disharmonists orchestrate riotous destruction by saturating the war zone with bursts of shattering noise and thrumming waves of aural destruction.
entries.zh: 领导噪音战士小队的Disharmonists通过在战区中饱和爆炸的噪音和震动的声波来组织暴乱的破坏。

entries.en: Ostentatious show-offs, Flawless Blade Champions dazzle and delight their fellow hedonists with displays of excessive bladework, haughty vigour and exposing themselves to danger.
entries.zh: 无瑕的利刃勇士是炫耀的炫耀者，他们以过度的剑术，傲慢的活力和将自己暴露于危险中来使他们的同类享乐者感到惊艳和愉快。

entries.en: The Sorcerers of the Emperor's Children delight in nothing but toying with their foes, for each gruesome kill they make is an offering to Slaanesh and promises a reward of power.
entries.zh: 帝皇的孩子们的巫师们除了玩弄他们的敌人外，别无所乐，因为他们每一次残忍的杀戮都是对色孽的奉献，并承诺有力量的回报。

entries.en: Known by his horrific, storming assaults in his baroque armour, Malgarash has honed his skills in his heavy weapons through millennia of pitiless, unstoppable slaughter.
entries.zh: 以他在华丽盔甲中的恐怖，猛烈的攻击而闻名，Malgarash通过千年的无情，无法阻挡的屠杀来磨练他的重武器技能。

entries.en: Eager and impetuous of spirit, Emperor's Children Chaos Rhinos roar with barely contained anticipation as they thunder into the midst of battle to unload their cargo of warriors.
entries.zh: 渴望并急躁的精神，帝皇的孩子们的混沌犀牛战车在他们冲入战斗中央时几乎无法抑制的期待，以卸下他们的战士货物。

entries.en: Terminator Champions arrogantly lord their power over others. Paranoia often takes root in those with power, leading them to obsessively re-establish their elite status.
entries.zh: 终结者勇士傲慢地将他们的力量凌驾于他们之上。在那些拥有权力的人中，常常会产生偏执，使他们痴迷于重新确立他们的精英地位。

entries.en: Lords Kakophonist direct their excruciating aural barrages in atonal dirges, weakening physical matter by shaking chemical and atomic bonds with eldritch vibration.
entries.zh: Kakophonist领主们在不和谐的挽歌中直接他们痛苦的听觉攻击，通过奇异的振动来削弱物理物质，摇动化学和原子键。

entries.en: The Konstrictus are glorious artisans and Turyan is no exception. The Prismatic Pyre erected on the sites of their victories is comprised of the eyeballs of those they leave alive.
entries.zh: Konstrictus是辉煌的工匠师，Turyan也不例外。他们在胜利地点上建立的棱镜火焰由他们留下的活人的眼球组成。

entries.en: Lords Exultants possess sensory enhancements, allowing them to experience the thrill of battle on a higher level, driving them to slaughter their foes in exquisitely lurid fashion.
entries.zh: Exultants领主拥有感官增强，使他们能够在更高的层次上体验战斗的刺激，驱使他们以极其鲜艳的方式屠杀他们的敌人。

entries.en: Obsessed with lethal sonic destruction, Varius sculpted his entire body to further his art. With his band of Noise Marines, he conducts an orchestra of discordant slaughter.
entries.zh: 痴迷于致命的声波破坏，Varius塑造了他的整个身体以进一步他的艺术。他带着他的噪音战士团队，他指挥着一支不和谐的屠杀乐团。

entries.en: Survivor of the Long War, this former Kakophoni's senses are so dulled that it hears none but the most devastating sounds, now cursed to rejoice in the most faint stimuli only.
entries.zh: 这位万古长战的幸存者，曾是Kakophoni的一员，他的感官如此迟钝，只能听到最具破坏性的声音，现在只能在最微弱的刺激中欢乐。

entries.en: Maulerfiends of the Emperor's Children possess a ravenous appetite for carnage and are empowered by the agonies inflicted upon them.
entries.zh: 帝皇子嗣的重拳恶魔对杀戮有着贪婪的欲望，并通过被施加的痛苦得到力量。

entries.en: Heldrakes soar the skies, picking enemy aircraft apart with obsessive precision and malicious glee, only to descend and slaughter the enemy on the ground once the skies are clear.
entries.zh: 地狱魔龙在天空中翱翔，用强迫性的精确和恶意的快乐将敌方飞机拆解，只有在天空清晰后才会降落并屠杀地面上的敌人。

entries.en: Only the most debased and skilled warriors achieve daemonhood, and only a scant few are blessed with winged daemonic forms that long to inflict the most exquisite of agonies.
entries.zh: 只有最堕落和最熟练的战士才能成为恶魔，只有少数几个被赐予翅膀的恶魔形态，渴望施加最精致的痛苦。

entries.en: These tracked monstrosities purr and thrum with pleasure as they unleash booming volleys of destruction, stopping only to disgorge bands of warriors into the midst of the fighting.
entries.zh: 这些履带怪物在发射毁灭性弹幕时咕噜咕噜地满足，只在将战士们吐出到战斗中间时停下。

entries.en: Where the Emperor's Children indulge, the power of Slaanesh empowers those in its thrall. Only those who prove themselves the deadliest will gain the approval they seek.
entries.zh: 在帝皇子嗣沉溺之处，色孽的力量赋予其奴隶力量。只有证明自己最致命的人才能获得他们寻求的赞许。

entries.en: The daemons of Slaanesh are not bound by the laws of reality, fading in and out of existence at will.
entries.zh: 色孽的恶魔不受现实法则的束缚，可以随意消失和出现。

entries.en: Emperor's Children warbands have claimed multiple bases, building fortresses and tributes to their greatness and luring tides of warp-spawned entities ready to spread violence.
entries.zh: 帝皇的孩子们的战队已经占领了多个基地，建造堡垒和对他们伟大的赞美，吸引亚空间产生的实体的潮汐，准备传播暴力。

entries.en: Their ingrained desire for sensation in all its forms sees the Emperor's Children move rapidly across the battlefield as they attempt to satiate their hunger for fresh experience.
entries.zh: 帝皇子嗣对所有形式的感觉有着根深蒂固的渴望，他们在战场上迅速移动，试图满足他们对新体验的渴望。

entries.en: The Emperor's Children revel in every sensation - even ones that would slay lesser mortals outright
entries.zh: 帝皇子嗣在每一种感觉中都感到欢乐 - 即使是那些会直接杀死凡人的感觉

entries.en: Through Slaanesh's favour, these warriors have defied death more than once and each time have been agonisingly resurrected to offer more souls to their patron.
entries.zh: 通过色孽的恩宠，这些战士已经多次挑战死亡，并每次都被痛苦地复活，以供更多的灵魂给他们的主人。

entries.en: The Emperor's Children are consummate raiders, eager to satiate their lust for sensation amid battle and falling upon their foes with impossible swiftness and inhuman grace.
entries.zh: 帝皇子嗣是出色的掠袭者，渴望在战斗中满足他们对感觉的欲望，并以不可能的迅速和非人的优雅袭击他们的敌人。

entries.en: The armoured transports of the Emperor's Children are a testament to the debased nature of those who ride within them.
entries.zh: 帝皇子嗣的装甲运输工具是那些乘坐其中的人堕落本性的见证。

entries.en: Masters of mechanised assaults, the Emperor's Children leap from their daemonically tainted vehicles to fall upon the foe with blade, bolter and bizarre cocktails of stimms.
entries.zh: 机械化攻击的大师，帝皇子嗣从他们的恶魔污染的载具中跳出，用剑，爆矢枪和奇异的刺激剂混合物袭击敌人。

entries.en: The Emperor's Children traverse the battlefield with their pupils dilated by exotic stimm cocktails, flesh scarred and sculpted by self-inflicted tortures
entries.zh: 帝皇子嗣的学生在战场上行走，他们的瞳孔被异国的刺激剂鸡尾酒扩大，肉体被自我施加的折磨留下疤痕和雕塑。

entries.en: Only the most debased champions of Slaanesh may gain the Dark Prince's favour. Yet none hold it for long, for there's always another who seeks to wrest it from their rivals.
entries.zh: 只有最堕落的色孽冠军才能获得黑暗王子的恩宠。然而，没有人能长久保持它，因为总有另一个人试图从他们的竞争对手那里夺走它。

entries.en: The audible noise that enemies detect is like the growl of a hungry god, so deep and powerful that the ground trembles, while eyes, eardrums and internal organs judder and rupture.
entries.zh: 敌人检测到的可听噪音就像饥饿的神的咆哮，如此深沉和强大，以至于地面都在颤抖，而眼睛，耳膜和内脏都在颤抖和破裂。

entries.en: With a desire for perfection and superiority, some Emperor's Children warlords strike desperate pacts with daemonic powers, wagering their souls for power beyond measure.
entries.zh: 带着对完美和优越的渴望，一些帝皇子嗣的战将与恶魔力量达成绝望的契约，为了无法衡量的力量而赌上他们的灵魂。

entries.en: Consumed by their own pride, the Emperor's Children seek to prove their prowess in myriad forms of combat, seeking out enemy champions to gruesomely humble in single combat.
entries.zh: 被他们自己的骄傲所消耗，帝皇子嗣寻求在各种形式的战斗中证明他们的实力，寻找敌方冠军以在单挑中残忍地羞辱。

entries.en: Some warriors appear specially favoured by the Dark Prince, their boons of power a reward for committing ever viler deeds in honour of their patron.
entries.zh: 一些战士似乎特别受到黑暗王子的宠爱，他们的力量的恩赐是为了向他们的主人献上更邪恶的行为的回报。

entries.en: Consumed by their obsessive desire for revenge, the Emperor's Children surge into oncoming fusillades.
entries.zh: 被复仇的强烈欲望所吞噬，帝皇的子嗣冲向即将到来的密集射击。

entries.en: Some Emperor's Children warriors demonstrate exquisite fighting form. Those who lock swords with these obsessive warriors do so at their peril.
entries.zh: 一些帝皇的子嗣战士展示出精湛的战斗形态。那些与这些痴迷战士交锋的人，都是在冒着生命危险。

entries.en: Wherever the Emperor's Children tread, reality is torn asunder and through the veil pour the daemons of Slaanesh, their lithe forms at once repulsive and alluring.
entries.zh: 无论帝皇的子嗣走到哪里，现实都会被撕裂，而色孽的恶魔们从帷幕中涌出，他们的身形既令人反感又吸引人。

entries.en: When the Emperor's Children march to war, a barrage of sensations fills the arena. Air shivers in fearful expectation, and the land rifts as fortifications shatter into pieces.
entries.zh: 当帝皇的子嗣出征，感官的冲击充满了战场。空气在恐惧的期待中颤抖，土地在防御工事破碎成片时裂开。

entries.en: The puissant champions of excess have inflicted deaths beyond count. The more extravagant and luridly violent the kill, the greater the Dark Prince's appreciation.
entries.zh: 过度的强大冠军已经造成了无数的死亡。杀戮越是奢侈和鲜艳暴力，黑暗王子的欣赏就越大。

entries.en: Essence-drums boil with narcotic rapture, distilling torment brewed from pain, each elixir tailored for transcendent violence, speed and ecstasy.
entries.zh: 精华鼓沸腾着麻醉的狂喜，提炼出从痛苦中酿造的折磨，每一种药剂都为超越暴力、速度和狂喜而定制。

entries.en: Pain is but the first note. The Emperor's Children armaments are as much weapons as they are instruments for a symphony of agony to please the Dark Prince.
entries.zh: 痛苦只是第一音符。帝皇之子的武器既是武器，也是为了取悦黑暗王子的痛苦交响乐的乐器。

entries.en: The throne hums with echoes of worship and woe. Lured by their egomaniacal desires, warband members flock to it, seeking to to claim it and exert their will over those beneath them.
entries.zh: 王座上充满了崇拜和悲哀的回声。被他们的自我狂妄欲望吸引，战队成员们纷纷向它涌来，试图夺取它并对他们下面的人施加他们的意志。

entries.en: A discordant climax engulfs the battlefield, enrapturing the Emperor’s Children in ecstatic abandon while interlopers unfit to grasp such exquisite ruin are staggered.
entries.zh: 不和谐的高潮吞没了战场，使帝皇之子在狂喜的放纵中陶醉，而那些无法理解如此精致废墟的闯入者则被震撼。

entries.en: An early release of the stimm substances might prove toxic to the foot soldier, but the lack of chemical stimmuli shall surely drive the motivation of the Dark Prince followers down.
entries.zh: 早期释放的刺激物质可能对步兵有毒，但缺乏化学刺激物质肯定会降低黑暗王子追随者的动力。

entries.en: When the daemonic energies burst out of control, no mortal soul is safe from the rapacious excess of empyric energy.
entries.zh: 当恶魔能量失控爆发时，没有一个凡人的灵魂能够安全地逃脱出帝国能量的贪婪过度。

entries.en: Phoenix Lord of the Warp Spiders, Lhykhis embodies Khaine's willingness to risk all to defeat the foe. Fearless of the Warp, Lhykhis traverses its helish depths with precision.
entries.zh: 次元蜘蛛的凤凰领主，Lhykhis体现了凯恩冒险一切以击败敌人的决心。对亚空间无所畏惧，Lhykhis以精准的方式穿越其地狱般的深渊。

entries.en: Lhykhis strikes like an ambush predator from the Empyrean, sowing murderous bloodshed amongst their foes before vanishing again into the web of the Warp.
entries.zh: Lhykhis如伏击的掠食者从神域出击，在敌人中播下杀戮的血腥，然后再消失在亚空间的网中。

entries.en: The ritual armament of the Warp Spider is the death spinner, an exotic and highly advanced weapon that extrudes a cloud of razor-sharp monofilament wire and hurls it to the enemy.
entries.zh: 次元蜘蛛的仪式武器是织亡者，这是一种异国情调且高度先进的武器，它挤出一团锋利的单丝线云并将其投向敌人。

entries.en: The Warp Spiders take their name from the tiny crystalline arachnoids that crawl throughout a craftworld’s infinity circuit and Dome of Crystal Seers.
entries.zh: 次元蜘蛛的名字来源于在方舟世界的永恒回路和水晶先知之穹中爬行的微小晶体蜘蛛。

entries.en: Armed with their signature Spinneret rifle, Orian braves the Warp to attack the enemy before fading away in the blink of an eye, lascerating foes with lethal accuracy one at a time.
entries.zh: Orian手持他们的标志性喷丝步枪，勇敢地穿越亚空间攻击敌人，然后在眨眼之间消失，一次用致命的精确度割伤敌人。

entries.en: Rapid target acquisition is the speciality of the Warp Spiders, materialising into realspace and slaying their unsuspecting foes in a storm of monofilament threads.
entries.zh: 次元蜘蛛的特长是快速目标获取，他们在现实空间中物化并在单丝线的风暴中杀死毫无防备的敌人。

entries.en: Farseers have become adept at reading future events, seeing the many strands of fate ahead of their people and the consequences of following each one
entries.zh: 先知已经变得擅长阅读未来事件，看到他们的人民前方的许多命运线索以及遵循每一个线索的后果。

entries.en: These sleek skimmers offer a perfect compromise between the speed of a jetbike and the heavier Aeldari armament, evincing incredible grace as their seated gunners blast the enemy.
entries.zh: 这些流线型的滑翔机提供了喷气摩托的速度和艾达灵族更重型武器之间的完美折衷，他们坐在炮手的座位上对敌人进行爆炸，显示出令人难以置信的优雅。

entries.en: Expert combatants and battle seers, these mounted Farseers flow around weapon blasts and blade thrusts with a natural grace that makes their foes seem predictable and slow.
entries.zh: 作为专家战士和战争先知，这些骑着喷气摩托的先知们以自然的优雅避开武器爆炸和刀剑的攻击，使他们的敌人显得可预测且缓慢。

entries.en: Autarchs have long trodden the Path of the Warrior, and apply their strategic brilliance and sublime martial skill to their command of the Asuryani warhosts.
entries.zh: 司战长久以来走过战士之道，并将他们的战略才华和卓越的武术技巧应用于他们对阿苏里亚尼战队的指挥。

entries.en: Ahnakh-Yth, the Weaver, who once watched over the Asuryani from her cosmic web, created the warp spiders who protect the Infinity Circuit from the intrusions of the Great Enemy.
entries.zh: Ahnakh-Yth，织者，曾经从她的宇宙网中监视阿苏里亚尼，创造了保护永恒回路免受大敌侵扰的次元蜘蛛。

entries.en: The Aeldari have already seen how best to lay low each enemy and strike in the sure knowledge the foe cannot evade their terrible fate.
entries.zh: 艾达灵族已经看到了如何最好地击败每个敌人，并在确定敌人无法逃避他们可怕命运的情况下进行攻击。

entries.en: Farseers deliver prophetic orders, guiding their warriors to strike at crucial junctures of fate and causality. Their every pronouncement spells the doom of their foes.
entries.zh: 先知们发出预言性的命令，引导他们的战士在命运和因果关系的关键节点进行攻击。他们的每一次宣告都预示着他们敌人的灭亡。
